# @ccch1mneyyy/dsh-media DSH Go 的主机侧媒体插件，版本 `0.3.0`。提供生成图片、用一句话编辑图片、后台生成视频；服务密钥留在 Host credentials，原件保存到当前工作区。设置命名空间保持 `dsh-media`，媒体结果使用冻结的 `meta["dsh-go/media"]` v1。 0.3.0 声明兼容 DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` 与 `0.2.2-rc.1`，验证使用各版已有 runtime 锁，不重新解析生产依赖。实际验证范围与未验证项见 `VERIFICATION.md`。模型可用性、审核、配额和最终费用由供应商决定。App 内置的是设置与媒体展示入口，主机插件仍单独安装；本次不发布 npm、不预装或自动启用插件，也不调用真实付费服务。 ## 支持范围 | 服务 / profile | 图片与编辑 | 视频 | 取消 | |---|---|---|---| | OpenAI / `openai-gpt-image` | GPT Image 2、2.5 Sunburst / Flare；单参考图编辑 | 无 | 同步请求停止等待不等于供应商停止计费 | | Gemini OpenAI 兼容 / `openai-compatible` | Gemini 2.5 Flash Image，单张、显式 `b64_json` | 无 | 同上 | | 火山方舟 / `ark-image`、`ark-video` | Seedream 5.0 Pro；单参考图编辑 | Seedance 2.5 文生 / 单首帧图生 | 仅 queued，真实 DELETE 后再查询确认 | | 阿里云百炼 / `ali-wan-image`、`ali-video` | Wan 2.7 Image；单参考图编辑 | Wan 2.7 文生 / 单首帧图生 | 仅 PENDING，真实取消请求后再查询确认 | | 硅基流动 / `silicon-image`、`silicon-video` | Qwen Image；Qwen Image Edit 2509 单参考图编辑 | Wan 2.2 T2V / I2V | 当前官方接口未提供取消；停止本地等待可能继续收费 | 确切模型 ID、地址、参数白名单与官方资料在 `data/models.json`。本版本只开放有文档依据的子集，不代表供应商完整能力。Seedream Lite 已停止新购，因此使用官方列出的 Pro 替代型号；不会发送 Pro 不支持的 Lite 组图字段。[方舟下线公告](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/ark/model-deprecation-notice?lang=en) 没有启用且凭据已配置的服务时，不注册生成工具或系统提示。`edit_image` 只在配置了支持编辑的模型时出现。原生服务只接受目录中核实的 HTTPS 主机和路径；OpenAI 兼容服务可配置 HTTPS API 根路径，仍执行公网地址与下载安全校验。 ## 配置 三步即可开始： 1. **添加服务**：从服务商预设中选择图片或视频（火山方舟、阿里云百炼、硅基流动、OpenAI、Gemini）。服务 ID、请求协议、API 根地址、返回格式和模型 ID 会按预设自动带入，无需手动拼写。图片与视频分别建一个服务；同一服务商的图片和视频可以共用同一个凭据。 2. **填 API Key**：新版 App 会为每个服务自动生成凭据名（例如方舟图片和视频都用 `DSH_MEDIA_ARK_API_KEY`，同一服务商复用同一个），只需要在服务详情里保存一次 Key；也可以在「高级」里改成任意已配置的 env 风格凭据名来引用已有 Key。旧版四个固定槽 `DSH_MEDIA_SLOT_1_API_KEY` 至 `DSH_MEDIA_SLOT_4_API_KEY` 仍可用，但仅为兼容保留，新版设置不需要在这里重复填写。 3. **启用**：分别选择图片默认服务和模型、视频默认服务和模型，检查费用保护后启用。`generate_image` / `edit_image` 使用图片默认值，`generate_video` 使用视频默认值；类型默认值解析不到时回落旧版通用 `defaults.serviceId` / `defaults.modelId`，再回落首个可用候选。 预设来自 `data/models.json` 的 `presets[]`，App 通过服务的目录元数据读取；旧版 App 忽略该字段，现有配置与旧版通用默认值保持原行为。 例如方舟图片与视频服务（只有引用，不含 Key）： ```yaml services: - id: ark_image enabled: true provider: ark baseUrl: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com profile: ark-image models: doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628 keyRef: DSH_MEDIA_ARK_API_KEY - id: ark_video enabled: true provider: ark baseUrl: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com profile: ark-video models: doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 keyRef: DSH_MEDIA_ARK_API_KEY defaults: imageServiceId: ark_image imageModelId: doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628 videoServiceId: ark_video videoModelId: doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 budget: dailyCny: '20' unknownPriceHoldCny: '20' limits: maxImages: 1 ``` 百炼两个 profile 的根地址都是 `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com`，也支持目录声明的北京工作空间地址。硅基流动为 `https://api.siliconflow.cn`；OpenAI 为 `https://api.openai.com/v1`。Gemini 兼容根地址为 `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`，`responseFormat: b64_json`。其他 profile 的 `responseFormat` 留空；预设已包含上述值。 ## 使用与恢复 普通对话可要求“画一张蓝色的猫”“用这张参考图把背景改成夜晚”“生成一个 5 秒视频”。生成模式沿用普通用户消息参数头，不新增命令或自定义会话事件。视频可用参数依模型决定；硅基流动当前只开放尺寸映射，不猜测秒数或分辨率字段。首帧图生视频省略 `aspect`。 `generate_image` / `edit_image` 完成后返回实际文件和 v1 元数据。`generate_video` 立即返回 `rid` 和后台 job：真实 `ctx.jobs` 跟踪排队、运行、终态，完成通知叫醒 Agent，再调用 `get_media_result(job_id)` 获取最终媒体卡片。插件不调用 `jobs.wait`，不自行伪造会话事件。v1 没有独立 cancelled 状态，确认取消使用 `status: failed` 和 `error.code: cancelled`；未确认远端取消使用 `remote_may_continue`。 Host 重启后，原会话可调用 `resume_media(rid)` 继续查询已保存的供应商 task ID。恢复不新建供应商任务，不再次预留费用；仅接受原 session、工作区、服务端点、凭据引用和模型身份。已完成的本地索引可直接复用。此版本是**显式恢复**，尚不自动重建全部 jobs；POST 已受理但响应丢失、没有 task ID 时不能自动找回，也绝不重试创建。 图片原件写入 `/generated//`，视频为原始 MP4（上限 300 MiB）。视频宽高、时长、编码从文件头读取，不冒充完整解码验证。支持目录校验的 MP4 编码不等于每台 Android 都能硬解。Host 私有索引与预算账本位于 `/media/dsh-media/`，包含 prompt 与任务恢复身份，不应纳入公开诊断包。 参考图限当前可写工作区内的普通 PNG / JPEG / WebP 文件，最多一张、10 MiB。拒绝符号链接、命名管道和工作区外路径。每次审批列出实际路径与目标服务；内容在审批前读取并固定，审批后文件身份改变则拒绝提交，不上传替换后的文件。 ## 费用保护的实际含义 当前没有足够可靠、覆盖所有输入计费项的报价，因此**每次图片、编辑、视频均须单次明确同意**，卡片不显示虚构估价。默认每天本地预算 ¥20、每次未知价请求预留 ¥20；默认设置一天只容纳一次此类预留。日期按上海时区。 预留是本地记账护栏，**不是供应商实际金额的硬上限**。实际账单可能高于预留。调低未知价预留会放行更多请求，不会降低供应商价格。账本在提交前持久化不确定状态，接受后的失败、超时、取消或断网均保留预留；本插件不声称退款。明确尚未提交的请求才释放预留。账本的内部 `basis: estimate` 记录本地预留结算，不是经过核实的供应商报价。 方舟和百炼仅排队时可能取消。取消请求与状态变化可能竞争，只有后续查询明确 cancelled / CANCELED 才显示已取消；运行中、查询失败、供应商不支持时都提示服务端可能继续生成并收费。付费 POST 不自动重试。 ## English `@ccch1mneyyy/dsh-media` is a Host-side DeepSeek Harness plugin. It keeps credentials on the Host, saves original media in the current workspace and emits DSH Go media metadata v1. The settings namespace remains `dsh-media`. Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` or `0.2.2-rc.1` peers are required; the DSH Go manifest declares app `1.0.2` or later. It supports OpenAI / Gemini-compatible images, Ark Seedream / Seedance, Alibaba Wan and SiliconFlow Qwen / Wan. Editing uses one workspace image. Video generation runs as a real background job; `get_media_result` retrieves its media result after the completion notice. `resume_media(rid)` explicitly resumes a saved provider task in its original session without submitting again. Provider cancellation is confirmed only when the API reports it; SiliconFlow cancellation is unavailable. All currently bundled prices are unknown. Every generation requires explicit one-time approval. The default CNY 20 daily ledger and CNY 20 per-request hold limit local reservations, **not actual provider bills**. Accepted or uncertain submissions retain their hold. Validation uses each supported runtime version’s existing pinned dependency graph; see `VERIFICATION.md` for current evidence. No paid-provider or Android App installation/media-viewer validation is claimed. The package is prepared for publication but this change does not publish or preinstall it. Version 0.3.0 also publishes provider presets in the plugin catalogue. The App builds a service from a preset, writes any env-style credential name such as `DSH_MEDIA_ARK_API_KEY`, reuses one key for the image and video services of the same provider, and keeps separate image/video defaults. The four fixed slots remain for compatibility only, and a legacy `serviceId`/`modelId` default keeps its exact previous behavior.

简体中文 · English

DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端。手机上直接跑，也能遥控你电脑上的 DSH。


Trendshift 全语言日榜 #1 · 2026-10-30


Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。


下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

 

感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱，我将尽快适配 iOS 和鸿蒙！大家 Star 点得越多，我适配得越快哦 hhh

第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。


本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。


插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。


原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。


分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。


横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。


主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。


中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。


手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。敏感操作默认交还给你；放宽应用规则或解除限制前，请先了解风险。


## 可以做什么 DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。 - **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。 - **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。 - **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。 - **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。 - **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。 - **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。 功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。 ## 安装 安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。 1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。 2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。 3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。 仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。 本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。 ## 数据与权限 模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。 “发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。 ## 风险提示与免责声明 DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 无关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。使用前请了解： - **AI 并非万无一失**：回答、代码和操作可能出错，也可能被网页、消息或文件中的恶意指令误导。请核验重要结果；医疗、法律、投资等高风险决策不应仅依赖 AI 输出。 - **工具会产生真实影响**：本机或远程主机上的命令、文件修改及手机操控可能导致数据丢失、隐私泄露、账号、资金或设备损失。免确认、放宽应用规则或解除限制会减少保护；确认与拦截机制不能保证消除所有风险。建议保留默认保护，只授予必要权限，不在存有支付或银行信息的设备上解除限制。详见[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。 - **第三方服务与费用**：模型、远程主机和插件等按各自条款运行；相关数据处理、服务可用性和费用取决于你选择的服务与配置。本机运行不等于模型离线，也不代表数据不会离开设备。 - **使用前做好防护**：备份重要数据，只连接可信主机、安装可信插件，留意模型用量与费用；不要让 AI 无人值守地处理不可逆或高风险任务。 - **无担保与责任范围**：在适用法律允许的范围内，本软件按“现状”提供，不保证准确性、持续可用性或满足特定用途；相关无担保及责任限制见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 第 15–17 条。本声明不排除或限制依法不得排除或限制的责任，也不减损你依法享有的权利。 ## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。
开源吗？
开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。再发布和 fork 时的署名要求见[授权范围与再发布](#授权范围与再发布)。
## 从源码构建 以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。 先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git cd dsh-go bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh source tooling/env.sh flutter --version java -version bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon ``` 工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。 产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。 构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时： ```bash bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64 DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon ``` 未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。 只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行： ```bash DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all ``` ## 目录 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `app/` | Flutter 界面与 Android Kotlin 平台实现 | | `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 | | `packages/dsh_remote/` | DSH Remote 的 Dart 客户端 | | `runtime/` | Linux 运行时打包、引擎补丁与 App 桥接 | | `sdk/plugin-kit/` | 原生插件作者工具包；在仓库中使用，未发布到 npm | | `examples/plugins/` | 插件示例 | | `docs/guide/`、`docs/plugins/` | 用户指南与插件开发文档 | | `docs/assets/` | 本页用到的展示图、桌宠动图和社群二维码 | | `tooling/` | 工具链、APK 构建与诊断脚本 | | `services/`、`site/`、`infra/` | 配套分享服务、网站和部署材料 | ## 参与贡献 问题反馈和改进建议可提交到 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues)。代码、文档和翻译贡献请先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件作者可以从[插件教程](docs/plugins/README.md)和 [SDK](sdk/plugin-kit/README.md)开始。 安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告，避免在公开 Issue 中提交漏洞细节或凭据。 ## 社区 - **论坛**：[forum.dshtui.com](https://forum.dshtui.com) - **QQ 群**：`1132118290`（[点此加群](https://qm.qq.com/q/OEy2RqZnqY)） - **微信群**：扫下方二维码，过期请加 QQ 群

  

QQ 群号 1132118290，电脑上可直接点此加群。微信群二维码每周更新，过期请加 QQ 群。

## 友情链接 - **[DSH-TUI](https://dshtui.com/)**：同一作者的作品，面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端界面。手机上用 DSH Go，电脑上就用它——像素鲸鱼、实时状态、时间回溯，装上即开工（[GitHub](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI)）。 ## 授权范围与再发布 代码以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 开源，欢迎 fork 学习、自用和二次开发。请尊重原作者和项目来源： - **改造前请提前联系作者**：如需基于本项目进行改造、二次开发或衍生产品发布，请先通过 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues) 或[社区](#community)联系原作者 ccch1mneyyy，说明用途与计划。 - **fork 请标注主仓库与作者**：基于本仓库改造并发布时，请在仓库说明、应用「关于」页和发布页面清楚标注主仓库 与原作者 [ccch1mneyyy](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy)，并按适用许可证保留版权、许可及修改声明。 - **禁止未授权商业化套皮**：不得未经授权将本项目的品牌标识、Deepy、鲸娘等受保护素材用于套皮售卖、收费分发或其他商业产品；不得违反适用许可证，删除应保留的版权与许可声明、闭源分发衍生代码，或冒充原作者、官方版本。 - **名称与素材另有限制**：DSH Go 的名称、标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘形象不在 AGPL 授权范围内，以修改版身份发布时请换成自己的名称和素材，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。 **许可说明**：AGPL-3.0 允许符合其条款的修改、再发布和商业使用；上述提前联系及署名位置是作者的协作请求，不是对代码许可证追加的限制。品牌与素材须遵守各自的授权条件；本说明不改变 `sdk/`、`examples/` 及第三方内容的许可。 ## 许可证与致谢 本项目采用 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE)；`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 保持 **MIT**。第三方代码和素材以各自声明为准。 - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：DSH Go 运行和连接的就是它。 - [DSH-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI)：吉祥物 Deepy 小鲸鱼和鲸娘来自这里。 Phase 相关代码经作者许可使用。DeepSeek Harness、PiPilot、DS Bot、DSH Remote 及其他第三方组件、素材保留各自的许可证和署名。具体来源和条款见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 DSH Go 的名称、标识、Deepy 小鲸鱼和鲸娘等形象不在 AGPL 授权范围内，使用条款见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。 远程连接参考了 [ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 的项目和服务器，感谢作者李国宝。

DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，与 DeepSeek 没有关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。DeepSeek 名称与标识归其所有者所有。

简体中文 · English

DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端。手机上直接跑，也能遥控你电脑上的 DSH。


Trendshift 全语言日榜 #1 · 2026-10-30


Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。


下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

 

感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱，我将尽快适配 iOS 和鸿蒙！大家 Star 点得越多，我适配得越快哦 hhh

第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。


本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。


插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。


原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。


分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。


横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。


主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。


中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。


手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。敏感操作默认交还给你；放宽应用规则或解除限制前，请先了解风险。


## 可以做什么 DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。 - **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。 - **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。 - **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。 - **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。 - **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。 - **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。 功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。 ## 安装 安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。 1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。 2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。 3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。 仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。 本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。 ## 数据与权限 模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。 “发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。 ## 风险提示与免责声明 DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 无关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。使用前请了解： - **AI 并非万无一失**：回答、代码和操作可能出错，也可能被网页、消息或文件中的恶意指令误导。请核验重要结果；医疗、法律、投资等高风险决策不应仅依赖 AI 输出。 - **工具会产生真实影响**：本机或远程主机上的命令、文件修改及手机操控可能导致数据丢失、隐私泄露、账号、资金或设备损失。免确认、放宽应用规则或解除限制会减少保护；确认与拦截机制不能保证消除所有风险。建议保留默认保护，只授予必要权限，不在存有支付或银行信息的设备上解除限制。详见[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。 - **第三方服务与费用**：模型、远程主机和插件等按各自条款运行；相关数据处理、服务可用性和费用取决于你选择的服务与配置。本机运行不等于模型离线，也不代表数据不会离开设备。 - **使用前做好防护**：备份重要数据，只连接可信主机、安装可信插件，留意模型用量与费用；不要让 AI 无人值守地处理不可逆或高风险任务。 - **无担保与责任范围**：在适用法律允许的范围内，本软件按“现状”提供，不保证准确性、持续可用性或满足特定用途；相关无担保及责任限制见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 第 15–17 条。本声明不排除或限制依法不得排除或限制的责任，也不减损你依法享有的权利。 ## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。
开源吗？
开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。再发布和 fork 时的署名要求见[授权范围与再发布](#授权范围与再发布)。
## 从源码构建 以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。 先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git cd dsh-go bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh source tooling/env.sh flutter --version java -version bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon ``` 工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。 产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。 构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时： ```bash bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64 DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon ``` 未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。 只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行： ```bash DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all ``` ## 目录 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `app/` | Flutter 界面与 Android Kotlin 平台实现 | | `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 | | `packages/dsh_remote/` | DSH Remote 的 Dart 客户端 | | `runtime/` | Linux 运行时打包、引擎补丁与 App 桥接 | | `sdk/plugin-kit/` | 原生插件作者工具包；在仓库中使用，未发布到 npm | | `examples/plugins/` | 插件示例 | | `docs/guide/`、`docs/plugins/` | 用户指南与插件开发文档 | | `docs/assets/` | 本页用到的展示图、桌宠动图和社群二维码 | | `tooling/` | 工具链、APK 构建与诊断脚本 | | `services/`、`site/`、`infra/` | 配套分享服务、网站和部署材料 | ## 参与贡献 问题反馈和改进建议可提交到 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues)。代码、文档和翻译贡献请先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件作者可以从[插件教程](docs/plugins/README.md)和 [SDK](sdk/plugin-kit/README.md)开始。 安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告，避免在公开 Issue 中提交漏洞细节或凭据。 ## 社区 - **论坛**：[forum.dshtui.com](https://forum.dshtui.com) - **QQ 群**：`1132118290`（[点此加群](https://qm.qq.com/q/OEy2RqZnqY)） - **微信群**：扫下方二维码，过期请加 QQ 群

  

QQ 群号 1132118290，电脑上可直接点此加群。微信群二维码每周更新，过期请加 QQ 群。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH Toolbox

DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的可选工具箱。提供模型选择器增强、工作区单列表快捷切换、请求身份改写，以及默认关闭的统一运行配置模块：LLM、命令、Android 应用共用原下拉框、编辑窗口和运行按钮。Android 仅在存储上独立，不再有单独设置页。运行配置移植自 `@xiaoso/dsh-run-config@0.2.4`，详见[接管与回退指南](<docs/run-config.md>)。

这个包刻意保持通用：客户端功能注册表已为后续模块（例如消息编辑/回滚）预留位置。

## 新增能力

- **按提供方、模型名称或模型 ID 搜索。** 多个空格分隔的词按“与”关系组合；`@provider` 把某个词限定在提供方字段。
- **持久化自定义分组。** 一个模型可以属于多个组；分组顺序和折叠状态保存在本机。
- **虚拟“未分组”视图**，用于收纳未被任何自定义分组引用的模型。
- **不可删除的“全部”视图**，以及宿主原有的提供方视图。
- **提供方标题显示数量并支持折叠**；排列为“折叠图标 → 名称 → 数量”，点击整行（名称、图标或数量）即可折叠。模型行缩进到分组名所在的一列，展开后形成清晰的“分组 → 模型”两级层次，折叠图标只占左侧空槽。打开菜单时默认只展开当前选中模型所在的提供方，其余提供方折叠。
- **自定义分组折叠控件位于标签栏**，不再在列表上方重复显示分组名称和数量。
- **设置标签页**，在「模型分组」管理分组并控制模型分组增强，在「请求身份改写」管理规则，在「运行配置」启用接管和 AI 管理，在「手机访问」配置手机访问期间全局停用的插件，并在「其它设置」控制工作区单列表快捷切换以及基础数据导入、导出和重置（不含运行配置库、手机访问配置及其开关）。
- **请求身份改写**：按 URL 子串匹配改写 `User-Agent`（可附加静态请求头），同时覆盖模型发现与对话请求；默认零规则、零副作用，可在设置页增删改、排序并一键验证。关闭身份改写后，相关规则、测试和诊断设置会隐藏，重新开启后恢复。
- **兼容 `dsh-model-search`**：如果该插件已经提供搜索框，DSH Toolbox 会复用它，而不是再注入一个重复的搜索框。
- **工作区单列表快捷切换**：工作区标题栏的搜索与视图选项之间新增列表图标；点击切换到原生“单列表”，再次点击恢复之前的“按工作区”或“按工作区树”。原生视图菜单仍可使用；按钮状态跟随菜单选项同步。该功能可在「其它设置」独立关闭或重新启用。

## 刻意不做的事

- 不修改、添加、删除或重排宿主模型记录。
- 不修改 `app.asar`，不直接改写 profile 文件；设置保存和手机模式的插件开关通过宿主公开管理接口持久化。
- 不把模型配置上传到任何地方。
- 不替换 React 渲染的模型行。原生行保留自己的点击处理器，因此选择模型仍会执行 DSH 自己的切换逻辑。
- 不会把一个模型物理复制到多个 DOM 分区。一个模型可以在配置中属于多个组，但当前视图只显示它一次；在 React 持有列表的前提下，这是唯一安全的做法。

## 环境要求

- 带 Web GUI 和 `0.2.1-rc.2` 所用客户端 slot API 的 DeepSeek Harness Desktop Next。
- 开发和运行需要 Node.js 22+；DSH 版本范围为 `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0-0`。

直接依赖为 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 与 `zod`。运行配置通过宿主 storageDomain 服务存储，启用后按需加载宿主 tools／llm 模块；这些宿主包声明为 optional peer，并关闭本仓库的自动 peer 安装，避免产生宿主副本。缺失依赖不影响其它 toolbox 功能。`jsdom`、`react`、`react-dom` 是 DOM 测试依赖。客户端通过宿主加载器复用 React，运行 UI 按需使用宿主 primitives，不捆绑宿主副本。

## 开发

```powershell
cd packages/dsh-toolbox
pnpm install
pnpm run check
pnpm test
```

`client.js` 由 `src/` 中可读的 ES 模块生成，因为 DSH Web 加载器为每个插件提供一个经典脚本入口。修改 `src/` 后：

```powershell
pnpm run build
pnpm run check
```

这个构建只是有意保持很小的本地转换，不是通用打包器：它会重写相对导入/导出，包装每个源模块，并生成 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂。`client.js` 过期时，`pnpm run check` 会失败。

## 安装到 profile

当前工作区的 `desktop` profile 已通过 `plugin_manager` 以 `link:` 方式安装本包；安装结果 `application=applied`、`warnings=[]`。修改 `src/` 并重新构建后，需要重新加载客户端 bundle（禁用/启用 bundle，或重启 DSH）才能看到最新界面。

在其他 profile 中，使用与其他本地插件相同的 Loader 路径把它作为本地 bundle 安装。bundle patch 为：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-toolbox
      name: dsh-toolbox
```

客户端声明为：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
    "client": {
      "platform": "web",
      "immediately": true,
      "inject": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

manifest 同时把 slots、插件设置页和 locale 客户端包列为 inject，确保本模块应用前这些服务和界面已经存在。

## 使用

1. 打开输入区的模型下拉菜单。
2. 在工具箱搜索框中输入。搜索覆盖提供方名称、提供方 ID、显示名和模型 ID。存在查询词时搜索整个目录，而不只是当前分组；清空后回到当前分组。
3. 使用标签页：
   - **全部**：所有模型；默认只展开当前选中模型所在的提供方。
   - **自定义分组**：仅显示该组的模型。
   - **未分组**：未分配给任何自定义分组的模型（启用时显示）。
   - **提供方**：宿主原有的提供方分区。
4. 提供方标题的排列为“折叠图标 → 名称 → 数量”。点击名称、图标或数量任一位置都能展开/折叠该提供方；数量表示该提供方中有多少模型匹配。
5. 自定义分组的折叠按钮位于标签栏右侧（齿轮左边），不再在列表上方显示重复的“分组名 + 数量”行。
6. 点击模型菜单的齿轮打开 **插件 → dsh-toolbox** 详情内的配置页；也可从账号菜单进入 **设置 → DSH Toolbox**。设置页不依赖旧版“内置插件”页签。
7. 该标签页顶部有五个子页签：**模型分组** / **请求身份改写** / **运行配置** / **手机访问** / **其它设置**，默认打开上次停留的子页签。
8. 在「模型分组」子页签中：
   - 创建、重命名、删除、拖拽或用箭头排序分组。
   - 选择一个分组，然后搜索并勾选模型来分配成员。
   - 使用“加入全部结果”/“移出全部结果”进行批量修改。
   - 设置默认打开视图，以及是否显示虚拟“未分组”分组。
   - 清理已经无法解析的模型 key。
9. 在「模型分组」子页签中可关闭或重新启用模型分组增强；在「其它设置」子页签中可关闭或重新启用工作区单列表快捷切换。关闭后会清理当前页面上对应的增强，重新启用后重新扫描宿主结构。「其它设置」还可复制/下载基础数据 JSON，粘贴/选择 JSON 导入，或恢复基础数据默认值；这些操作不包括运行配置库及其宿主开关。旧版模型配置 JSON 仍可导入，但只改模型分组。

删除分组只删除分组成员关系，绝不会删除模型，也不会修改宿主的模型目录。

## 手机访问期间停用插件

入口：**插件 → DSH Toolbox → 手机访问**。默认关闭、名单为空。选择第三方插件条目并保存后，手机直接打开 DSH 网页时可全局停用；最后一个手机页面离开后恢复。电脑端同样受影响，原本关闭的插件不会被自动打开。

正常离开宽限 5 秒；手机页面可见时每 20 秒发送心跳，无心跳默认 120 秒恢复（可设 60–600 秒）。锁屏、切换后台和断网也可能触发超时。停用/卸载 Toolbox 前，应先关闭这个功能，保存并等待恢复记录清空。配置与恢复记录不包含在基础数据备份或重置中。详见[手机访问规则与限制](<docs/mobile-mode.md>)。

## 工作区单列表快捷切换

展开工作区侧栏后，点击搜索图标右侧、视图选项左侧的单列表图标，可切换到原生的“分组方式 → 单列表”；再次点击恢复进入单列表前的分组方式。若插件首次加载时已经是单列表且没有保存过此前的分组方式，默认恢复“按工作区”。原生视图选项菜单仍保持可用，排序和归档筛选等状态不受影响；侧栏折叠时不注入该按钮。

本功能针对 DSH Desktop Next `0.2.1-rc.2` 的原生工作区结构与视图 store；宿主更新后若结构不再匹配，会停止注入而不是改写未知控件。按钮只通过宿主自身的 `setGroupBy` action 切换视图，上一种分组方式存放在插件独立键 `dsh-toolbox:workspace-last-group-by:v1`，不会改写宿主视图持久化 JSON 的其他字段。

## 请求身份改写（User-Agent）

部分第三方中转站按**客户端指纹**放行，只接受官方 CLI 的 `User-Agent`，其余客户端一律 401。宿主在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的模型发现与对话请求里先合并 provider `headers`、最后才写入自己的归属 UA，所以**任何 header 层插件都改不掉 UA**。本模块包装 `globalThis.fetch`，位于所有 header 合并之后，因此能同时覆盖模型发现（`{baseURL}/models`）与对话请求。

要点：

- **默认没有任何规则**：新装或未配置时不改写任何请求。`identity.enabled` 默认为 `true`，但 `rules` 为空，等价于零副作用。
- **匹配**：`urlPattern` 是大小写不敏感的子串；多条命中时取最长的 pattern（最具体优先）。只改写 `http:` / `https:`。
- **保留头**：`authorization`、`proxy-authorization`、`x-api-key`、`api-key`、`cookie`、`set-cookie`、`host`、`content-length`、`connection`、`transfer-encoding` 永远不被覆盖；保存时丢弃并在界面提示。
- **未命中零副作用**：包装把原始参数直接转交原生 fetch（引用相同），不重建 `Request`、不复制 body、不缓存 `Response`，SSE 流式行为不变。命中且带 body 时按 Node 约束补 `duplex: 'half'`。
- **热生效**：每次请求都重新读取配置引用，改规则不需要重启。
- **可还原**：停用或卸载后下一次请求即恢复宿主 UA；若另一个插件在本插件之上又包了一层 fetch，卸载只把本插件变为透明，不强行覆盖外层。

### 配置位置

DSH 0.2.x 的设置命名空间由**插件条目 id**决定，没有独立注册命名空间的接口，因此配置落在本插件条目 `dsh-toolbox` 的 `identity` 段（volatile settings），而不是 `docs/request-identity.md` 最初建议的独立 `dsh-toolbox:identity:v1`。它保存在 profile patch 的用户层，与浏览器 `localStorage` 里的分组配置互不影响。

```yaml
dsh-toolbox:
  identity:
    enabled: true
    diagnostics: false
    rules:
      - id: agentrouter
        enabled: true
        urlPattern: agentrouter.org
        userAgent: claude-cli/1.0.60 (external, cli)
        headers: []
        note: AgentRouter 只放行官方 CLI 指纹
```

### 设置页

`设置 → DSH Toolbox` 的「请求身份改写」卡片支持：总开关、规则增删改与上下排序、单条启用/停用、保留头提示、从 provider 一键生成规则（取 `baseURL` 的 host）、诊断日志开关，以及「测试」按钮。测试会真实发一次**不带凭据**的 `GET`，显示状态码、响应前 200 字符，以及宿主原始 UA 与改写后 UA——这两者在包装内就地抓取，因此能自证。

判定方式：直连仍返回 `unauthorized client detected` 表示仍被指纹拦截；返回 `未提供令牌` / `无效的令牌` 说明已进入上游鉴权层，UA 改写已生效。

### 宿主接口

静态客户端没有 `host.call` 通道，因此通过两个同源 HTTP 路由读写：

- `GET|POST /api/dsh-toolbox.identity`：读取/写入身份配置；响应包含 `revision`、`providers` 与命中统计。
- `POST /api/dsh-toolbox.identity-test`：执行一次真实探测。

两个路由只接受 **loopback Host**，且带 `Origin` 时必须与 Host 相同（防 DNS rebinding 与跨站写入）。

### 生效时机

宿主半侧在 DSH 启动时加载，修改插件宿主代码后需重启 DSH；客户端 bundle 需重新加载（禁用/启用 bundle 或刷新页面）。设置页在宿主半侧未就绪时会明确提示，而不是静默失败。

## 分组语义

- **全部**视图是虚拟的，不能删除。
- 自定义分组按 `order` 排序；拖拽和箭头按钮会重新编号。
- 一个模型可以被多个自定义分组引用。
- “未分组”是虚拟的，只包含未被任何自定义分组引用的模型。
- 打开菜单时只展开当前选中模型所在的提供方；没有选中模型或选中模型不在当前视图时，展开第一个有匹配的提供方。
- 搜索时忽略提供方折叠以展示全部匹配结果；清空搜索后恢复之前的折叠状态。
- 当提供方标题被设置隐藏时（自定义分组且 `preserveProviderGroups=false`），提供方折叠会被禁用，避免出现没有标题可点开、模型却被隐藏的情况。
- 失效的模型 key 会保留并标记为“模型已不存在”，直到你明确清理。这样即使提供方修改了 ID，也不会静默丢失配置。
- 折叠自定义分组会持久化其 `collapsed` 标志；折叠按钮在标签栏。提供方折叠只在当前会话内有效。

## 数据与限制

插件的本地数据保存在带命名空间的 `localStorage` key 中：

- `dsh-toolbox:v1`：分组配置，JSON 版本 1。
- `dsh-toolbox:catalog:v1`：最近一次观察到的模型目录，供模型菜单关闭时的设置页使用。
- `dsh-toolbox:workspace-last-group-by:v1`：上次使用的工作区分组视图。
- `dsh-toolbox:settings-tab:v1`：上次打开的设置子页签。
- `dsh-toolbox:features:v1`：模型分组和工作区单列表快捷切换的独立全局开关。

「其它设置」的基础数据文件（格式仍为 v1）包括上述五项及宿主保存的 `dsh-toolbox.identity` 规则；不包括运行配置库、接管与 AI 开关、运行时命中统计、宿主 provider 凭据。运行配置页签导出时投影为 `groups` 以兼容旧版，不改变本地记忆。旧版完整数据文件缺少功能开关时按默认开启兼容；旧版模型配置 JSON 不包含也不修改功能开关。自定义身份请求头**值**会被导出，应像敏感配置一样保管。完整数据导入/重置需要宿主身份路由可读可写；失败时尽力回滚并在无法确认恢复时提示人工核对。完整文件上限 8 MiB；旧版模型配置 JSON 保持 256 KiB 导入上限且不触及其它数据。已有损坏的本地配置不会被静默替换为默认值导出。

模型配置的旧版导入校验严格，且在任何写入之前执行：

- 最大 256 KiB。
- 最多 64 个分组。
- 每组最多 5,000 个模型 key。
- 分组名称最多 80 个字符。
- 未知字段、重复分组 ID、保留 ID、错误类型和更高版本的配置都会被拒绝。
- 模型 key 会被规范化、去重并限制长度；导入失败会保留原有配置。

目录缓存只是便利设施。插件永远不会重写宿主的模型配置或凭据。

请求身份改写的配置**不**放在 `localStorage`，而是 profile patch 的 `dsh-toolbox.identity` 段。服务端与设置页使用同一套校验：

- 最多 32 条规则，每条最多 16 个自定义头。
- `urlPattern` 200 字符、`userAgent` 300 字符、头名 64 字符、头值 1024 字符、备注 200 字符。
- 头名必须是合法 HTTP token；头值不得含控制字符；`urlPattern` / `userAgent` 不得含控制字符。
- 规则 id 不区分大小写且必须唯一；界面会从 pattern 自动生成并去重。
- 保留头在保存时被丢弃（不是拒绝），并在界面提示具体名字。

## 扩展点

`src/features.js` 中包含功能注册表：

```js
export const features = [settingsPanelFeature, modelGroupsFeature, workspaceFlatToggleFeature, runConfigFeature]
```

每个功能拥有自己的 `id` 和 `apply(ctx, helpers)` 清理逻辑；feature 的 `inject` 元数据不是自动依赖调度，额外服务须在 feature 内通过子作用域注入。纯客户端模块可以追加，涉及宿主的能力则需相应宿主入口：

```js
export const features = [settingsPanelFeature, modelGroupsFeature, workspaceFlatToggleFeature, runConfigFeature, messageEditFeature]
```

宿主入口导出 `Config` 的 `identity` 和默认关闭的 `runConfig` volatile 段。请求身份改写和运行配置使用独立生命周期；设置写入使用字段级 mutation，不互相覆盖。运行配置存储仍为 `task_runner` v1，独立于浏览器基础数据。

## 兼容性与失效模式

增强只针对原生菜单的稳定部分：

- 模型面板 `[role="menu"][id$="-models"]`；
- 提供方分区 `section[data-menu-group]`；
- 模型行 `button[role="menuitemradio"]`；
- 带 `data-provider-id` 和 `data-model-id` 的提供方/模型身份 span。

当 React 打开、刷新或过滤列表时，`MutationObserver` 会重新应用视图。如果宿主的 DOM 结构发生变化，控制器只记录一次诊断信息，并保持原生菜单不变。它从不替换菜单或 React 节点，并在菜单关闭或插件销毁时移除所有注入节点、监听器、样式和隐藏属性。

`dsh-model-search` 兼容采用检测方式（`[data-dsh-model-search]`、`[data-dsh-plugin="dsh-model-search"]`、`.dms-wrap`、`.dms-input`、`[class*="dms-"]`），不导入或调用该插件的私有 API。

## 手动验收清单

- [ ] 打开模型菜单；分别按提供方、显示名和模型 ID 搜索。
- [ ] 确认列表上方不再有“全部模型/分组名 + 数量”的重复标题行。
- [ ] 确认提供方标题顺序为“折叠图标 → 名称 → 数量”，点击名称、图标、数量都能折叠且弹窗不关闭。
- [ ] 默认只展开当前选中模型所在提供方；其余提供方显示标题和数量但折叠。
- [ ] 搜索其他提供方的模型时结果可见；清空后恢复原有折叠状态。
- [ ] 创建两个分组；把同一个模型放进两个组；切换标签页。
- [ ] 使用标签栏折叠按钮折叠自定义分组；重新打开菜单确认状态保存。
- [ ] 拖拽调整分组顺序；重新打开菜单确认顺序。
- [ ] 选择一个模型，确认宿主模型切换仍然有效。
- [ ] 删除一个分组；确认宿主模型目录中没有模型消失。
- [ ] 导出、恢复默认、导入；确认非法 JSON 会保留旧配置。
- [ ] 打开 设置 → DSH Toolbox，重复一次分组编辑。
- [ ] 如果安装了 `dsh-model-search`，确认只出现一个搜索框。
- [ ] 禁用插件，确认原生菜单恢复原样。
- [ ] 在设置页用「从 provider 生成」创建一条 `agentrouter.org` 规则并保存。
- [ ] 点「测试」：显示状态码与改写前后的 UA；不再出现 `unauthorized client detected`。
- [ ] 在 `agentrouter` provider 上点「获取可用模型」，返回模型列表。
- [ ] 选该 provider 的模型发一句话，流式输出正常、不卡顿。
- [ ] 关闭总开关或删除规则后，下一次请求恢复宿主 UA。
- [ ] 未配置规则的其它 provider 行为与安装前完全一致。
- [ ] 停止插件（重启宿主）后 `globalThis.fetch` 恢复为原生函数。

## 许可证

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Qdrant Memory Bundle for DeepSeek Harness

A Host Bundle under the existing npm name. Candidate `0.2.0-rc.1` retains
Legacy MCP by default and adds explicitly selected Owner modes. It contains
no memory engine, embeddings or Python code. The Python Runtime owns writes,
scope, ledger and recovery. The private `native/` directory is canonical source
included by the reviewed packer; it is not a second npm publication.

The Bundle declares one patch layer: a single `qdrant-memory` MCP server entry.
In Legacy and Unified Owner mode, DSH exposes four tools as `mcp__qdrant-memory__qdrant_memory_search`,
`..._add`, `..._update` and `..._delete`. Explicit operations only. The
default configuration never captures conversation turns automatically.

## Candidate storage modes

| `mode` | Explicit tools | Automatic memory | Storage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legacy` (default) | Four existing MCP tools | Rejected if enabled | Existing prepared launcher profile |
| `native-owner` | None from this Bundle | Opt-in | Authenticated HTTPS Owner |
| `unified-owner` | Four official HTTP MCP tools | Opt-in | The same HTTPS endpoint and token for both paths |

Select a mode in this Bundle's configuration before enabling
`auto_capture.enabled`, `auto_recall.enabled` and `memory_injection.enabled`.
Recall needs both the recall and injection switches. Legacy needs no Owner
token. Owner modes require an absolute `QDRANT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_PYTHON`,
`QDRANT_MEMORY_DSH_OWNER_URL` with exact HTTPS `/mcp`, and a provisioned
`QDRANT_MEMORY_DSH_OWNER_TOKEN`. For a private CA, configure
`QDRANT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_CA_FILE` for Python and `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` at Host
startup for the official Node MCP client. Never put tokens in profile YAML.

One trusted identity owns one DSH profile. Do not share an Owner-enabled Host
among independently authorized users. Grants come from the Owner policy,
never model content or a supplied user/agent/scope field. Do not install this
Bundle alongside the old overlay or the private Native bundle.
Owner modes refuse activation while an existing `qdrant-memory` MCP route
still exposes tools, before opening another connection.

Changing mode does not migrate any data. Legacy and remote Owner data remain
separate until an operator explicitly previews, backs up, verifies and approves
a migration. No migration is performed by this package. Disable and stop the
old connection before changing storage targets. Incompatible embedding spaces
must be resolved through the Runtime's explicit migration workflow.

Capture writes a content-free activation watermark in the durable DSH Session.
First enable excludes earlier turns; disable/re-enable establishes a new
boundary. HMR retains the enabled boundary for receipt recovery. Backfill is
not provided. Recovery drains batches of eight with a sixteen-turn live queue;
it currently reads the full individual Session log once per recovery pass.

Prepare the candidate tarball with `python scripts/pack_dsh_bundle.py
--output-dir dist/dsh-bundle` from the repository root. Direct `npm pack` of
this source directory omits the canonical Native module and is not a release
artifact. Publication requires approved Runtime 0.6.1 public-wheel, protected
Cloud and Desktop acceptance. When approved, publish this candidate under
`next`, keeping `latest=0.1.6`; this task does not publish either package.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`, enforced by `engines.dsh`. Earlier Hosts
  remain on Bundle 0.1.6 until explicitly upgraded.
- Node.js 24.9.0 or newer. This is a compatibility boundary of candidate 0.2.
- `pnpm` on `PATH` for `dsh plugin --profile <name> add`: the official DSH
  plugin manager forwards installation to pnpm.
- Network access for the first launcher download and for backend preparation
  (private Python, Runtime wheel and CPU model artifacts, about 250 MB).
- Free disk space for the managed root: programs, models and host profiles.

No system Python, uv/uvx, Ollama or Qdrant Server is required. The managed
root defaults to `qdrant-memory-managed` under the platform data directory
(`~/Library/Application Support` on macOS, `%LOCALAPPDATA%` on Windows,
`$XDG_DATA_HOME` or `~/.local/share` on Linux). Set an absolute
`QDRANT_MEMORY_MANAGED_ROOT` before starting DSH to use another location.

## Prepare the backend first

The DSH MCP probe is temporary and must never run installation or downloads.
Prepare the shared backend explicitly, once:

```sh
npx -y @cnkang/qdrant-memory-launcher@0.1.0-rc.8 prepare dsh
```

Preparation downloads the private Python environment, the Runtime wheel and a
verified CPU embedding model. It may take several minutes. Wait for
`{"ready":true,"host":"dsh"}`. The DSH profile is separate from WorkBuddy and
Hermes profiles. Preparation never deletes existing memory data.

## Install into one profile

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle
```

If the npm registry has not served this package yet, install the release
tarball instead. Download `cnkang-qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle-0.1.6.tgz` from
the repository release and run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./cnkang-qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle-0.1.6.tgz
```

Verify the layer without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config
```

The output contains one `# == @cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle` section with
the `cnkang-qdrant-memory-mcp` row. Then boot the profile. The four
`mcp__qdrant-memory__*` tools appear after discovery. Wait for preparation to
finish before you ask the agent to save a fact. Until the backend is ready,
tool calls report that no operation succeeded. Writes are never queued.

The first connection authorizes downloads and creation of the private DSH
profile. Do not enable this Bundle and a Qdrant Memory overlay in the same
profile. One profile has one owner for embedded storage.

## Update

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> update @cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle
```

Disconnect the profile before an upgrade. FastEmbed 0.9.0-to-0.9.1 upgrades require an authorized export and
re-embedding into a new profile/collection; keep the previous launcher and data
until verification. See [pipeline upgrade guidance](https://github.com/cnkang/qdrant-memory-mcp/blob/main/integrations/managed/README.md#package-integrity).
For upgrades within the same pipeline, program versions install alongside
earlier versions. Profile, ledger and collection files remain in place. After
an upgrade, run `prepare dsh` again to refresh shared programs and the model
cache. A profile never migrates or resets itself. Incompatible data fails
closed.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove @cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle
```

Removal edits the profile manifest. A running profile keeps its loaded
Bundle set: stop or restart the profile to close the active MCP connection
and release the storage writer lease. Removal does not delete the managed
root, the prepared profile or any memory. Never delete a `.provision.lock`
file or Runtime data locks while a process may still own them.

## Recovery

- A connection indicator or four discovered tools do not mean the backend is
  ready. If a call reports preparation pending or failed, no operation
  succeeded. Fix preparation before retrying.
- After an interrupted write, search for the affected memory and check its
  exact ID before repeating the operation. Never repeat an uncertain write
  unless a repeat is safe for that operation.
- A busy-profile error means another process owns the profile. Close that
  connection normally. Never remove locks to force a second writer.
- An interrupted installation can leave a provisioning lock. Confirm that
  the installer and its child processes have stopped, then inspect only that
  program's `.provision.lock`. Never reset a profile to bypass ownership.

## License

MIT. See `LICENSE`. Third-party attributes are listed in the shared launcher
package.

# Qdrant Memory MCP

**One Memory. Multiple Agents. No Lock-in.**

The [Codex plugin candidate](plugins/qdrant-memory/README.md) adds guided local
setup, read-only native-memory import and verified JSON/Markdown handoff. It is
versioned independently and does not add a second Runtime. See the
[executed validation and limits](docs/codex-plugin-verification.md). Exports remain
readable without this plugin or a subscription; native adoption is verified
separately from file creation.

Durable, portable, and permission-aware memory for AI agents — distributed as
an MCP adapter over the Qdrant Memory Runtime.

For shared production deployments, read the [deployment security guide](docs/shared-deployment-security.md). Owner-only database write credentials are required independently of MCP grants. Configure destination protection and shared doctor before deployment. See the [Owner support record](docs/universal-owner-status.md) for support limits.

## One Memory, Multiple Agents — opt-in shared owner

The distribution adds an opt-in single-owner service and stdio bridge. Install Runtime 0.6.1 to use them. See [shared integration guide](integrations/shared/README.md). Private defaults are unchanged. Native Provider automatic shared extraction is deferred.

<!-- mcp-name: io.github.cnkang/qdrant-memory -->

A [WorkBuddy connector](integrations/workbuddy/README.md) and a
[DeepSeek Harness bundle](integrations/dsh/bundle/README.md) reuse this stdio
MCP, the managed launcher and the canonical Skill.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Persistent, scoped memory for AI agents through four explicit **stdio MCP** tools.
This repository distributes the existing [Python Runtime](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory).
Its metadata-only wheel contains no Python business implementation. The console
script points directly to `qdrant_memory.standalone:main` and depends on
`hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory[mcp]==0.6.1`.

See [0.3.2 release notes](docs/releases/0.3.2.md) for the Runtime pin and upgrade guidance.

Before using an exact-version installation command, confirm that version on
the [PyPI release page](https://pypi.org/project/qdrant-memory-mcp/0.3.2/).
If unavailable, these package commands cannot run yet. Use the
[published 0.3.1 guide](https://github.com/cnkang/qdrant-memory-mcp/blob/v0.3.1/README.md)
until publication; a source candidate does not establish PyPI or npm availability.

**Versions:** MCP distribution 0.3.2 pins Runtime 0.6.1, which supports MCP
Python SDK 1.x and 2.x (`mcp>=1.30,<3`). The four scoped tools and stdio
launch arguments are the same for both SDK majors. The commands below use
these exact versions. Release
artifacts are available through the [distribution PyPI page](https://pypi.org/project/qdrant-memory-mcp/)
and [Runtime PyPI page](https://pypi.org/project/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/).
See [release checklist](docs/publishing.md) for the publishing sequence.

Runtime, [optional Agent Skill](https://github.com/cnkang/skills/tree/main/qdrant-memory)
and MCP distribution versions are independent. The Skill is usage guidance,
not a runtime dependency. Hermes retains its native MemoryProvider, automatic
extraction and prefetch. Ordinary MCP performs only explicitly requested memory
operations. It does not automatically extract every conversation turn.

## Harness support matrix

Verification levels: configuration example only, protocol-level tested, official
SDK/CLI tested, real host tested, real desktop GUI tested, not verified.

| Host | Native Provider | Explicit MCP tools | Automatic capture | Automatic recall | Shared Owner | Remote access | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hermes | Yes | Yes (via standalone) | Yes | Yes | Opt-in | Yes | Real host tested |
| OpenCode | No | Yes | No | No | Via Owner | Yes | Real host tested (dual-device) |
| Pi | No | Yes (extension) | Opt-in adapter | Opt-in adapter | Via Owner | Yes | Real host tested |
| DeepSeek Harness | No (lifecycle adapter) | Yes (DSH bundle) | Opt-in preview | Opt-in preview | Via Owner | Yes | DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 CI host tested; real model/GUI unverified |
| WorkBuddy | No | Yes (connector) | No | No | Via Owner | Yes | Real desktop GUI tested |
| Codex | No | Yes | No | No | Via Owner | Yes | Official CLI tested |

This distribution does not auto-extract conversations for any MCP host. Automatic
capture and recall require a native provider or a lifecycle adapter. The DSH
native preview is opt-in and source-merged, but its npm package is private and
Runtime 0.6.1 is published. Real DSH AgentLoop, model, and desktop GUI evidence
remains pending.
See the [Codex validation record](docs/codex-plugin-verification.md) for the
tested CLI, source revisions and model providers; desktop GUI and native-memory
adoption are separate verification boundaries.

## Install and initialize

For the shortest currently supported local setup, follow the
[Ollama quickstart](docs/quickstart.md) ([中文](docs/quickstart.zh-CN.md)).
It covers an existing model, installing a missing model, a separate WorkBuddy
profile, connection settings and a first save/search check. No Qdrant server,
Docker, cloud account or embedding API key is needed for that local path.
Python/uv and one-time profile configuration are still required for this
direct route. The managed WorkBuddy connector and DSH bundle prepare those
dependencies from Node.js instead.

Requires Python 3.11+ and either [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) or a Python
virtual environment. You must configure storage and an embedding service.
For the example below, run Ollama and install `qwen3-embedding:4b` yourself.

Create an operator-owned profile directory and save `qdrant-memory.json` inside:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "scope": {"user_id": "my-user", "agent_id": "my-agent"},
  "qdrant": {"mode": "embedded", "collection": "qdrant_memory"},
  "embedding": {
    "mode": "plugin", "provider": "ollama", "model": "qwen3-embedding:4b",
    "base_url": "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "dimensions": 2560, "distance": "Cosine"
  }
}
```

Initialize, then launch (replace `/path/to/profile` with your absolute path):

```bash
uvx --from qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2 qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile init
uvx --from qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2 qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile mcp
```

The command without `--home` uses `~/.qdrant-memory`, independent of Hermes.
Configure and initialize that directory before letting a Registry client launch
`uvx --from qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2 qdrant-memory-mcp mcp`.
The executable name matches the package name.
The Registry's positional `mcp` selects protocol mode. Its optional named
`--home` precedes `mcp` when a client supplies a custom profile.

Alternatively:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2
.venv/bin/qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile init
.venv/bin/qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile mcp
```

On Windows use `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` and
`.venv\Scripts\qdrant-memory-mcp.exe`.

Qdrant embedded, self-hosted server and Cloud, plus Ollama and OpenAI-compatible
embeddings, are configured in the Runtime's [configuration reference](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/configuration.md).
Keep credentials in operator environment variables (`QDRANT_API_KEY`,
`EMBEDDING_API_KEY`, or configured names). Never commit their values.
Initialization against an existing collection requires explicit operator choice.
Do not use a production destination for a first test.

## Connect a client

Codex `config.toml` example:

```toml
[mcp_servers.qdrant_memory]
command = "uvx"
args = ["--from", "qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2", "qdrant-memory-mcp", "--home", "/path/to/profile", "mcp"]
```

OpenCode `opencode.json` example:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "qdrant_memory": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["uvx", "--from", "qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2", "qdrant-memory-mcp", "--home", "/path/to/profile", "mcp"],
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

Pi needs a separately installed MCP client/extension. In that extension, use
`command: uvx` and the same argument list. No built-in Pi MCP support or universal
extension config format is claimed. These are configuration examples. This
protocol acceptance tests use the official Python MCP SDK. Host-specific evidence
is recorded separately in the [architecture and support boundaries](docs/cross-harness-architecture.md)
and the Runtime's [client evidence and limits](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/mcp.md).

## Tools and boundaries

| Tool | Input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `qdrant_memory_search` | `query`, optional `category` | Scoped memories with IDs, scores and provenance |
| `qdrant_memory_add` | `text` | Durable memory ID |
| `qdrant_memory_update` | exact `id`, replacement `text` | Scoped replacement |
| `qdrant_memory_delete` | exact `id` | Scoped deletion |

Scope is fixed by the operator's profile (`user_id`, `agent_id`). Model inputs
and MCP client identity cannot override it. Knowing an ID does not grant access.
Migration, export, reset and bulk deletion remain trusted operator CLI commands.
See [standalone maintenance](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/standalone.md).
No resources or prompts are advertised. This is a local subprocess, with no
public HTTP/SSE listener or remote authentication service. Stdout is reserved
for protocol messages, with sanitized diagnostics on stderr.

Data flows from client → Runtime → embedding provider → Qdrant and the local
SQLite ledger. With local Ollama and embedded Qdrant, memory processing stays
local. Cloud embedding receives memory/query text, and cloud Qdrant receives
vectors and stored payloads. The client/model may also receive recalled text.
The operator must authorize retention and access and protect the profile files.

One writer lease coordinates a profile/destination. Do not overlap MCP, CLI
or Hermes processes writing to it. Separate profiles or machines do not provide
a distributed lock. This package does not support uncoordinated multiprocess
writes, auto-extraction, an HTTP transport, or implicit credential discovery
from Hermes. It preserves the Runtime's ledger, IDs and recovery semantics.

## Concepts and evidence

- Sharing vs Portability vs Backup: [Runtime portability guide](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/portability.md)
- Cross-harness architecture: [docs/cross-harness-architecture.md](docs/cross-harness-architecture.md)
- Shared Owner status: [docs/universal-owner-status.md](docs/universal-owner-status.md)
- Validation limits: [docs/dsh-validation.md](docs/dsh-validation.md)

Validation reports apply to their recorded versions, workloads and host
environments. Short protocol or cloud runs do not establish 24-hour acceptance
for a new release.

## Verification and development

CI builds wheel/sdist, checks metadata and ownership marker. It runs installed
protocol tests with temporary profiles, embedded Qdrant and a deterministic
loopback embedding fixture on Linux/macOS/Windows, Python 3.11 and 3.14.
No test connects to personal Qdrant, Hermes profiles or memory data. These tests
cover initialize, discovery, four tools, persistence, recovery, scope isolation,
error redaction and protocol stdout. Provider/cloud compatibility evidence
belongs to the [Runtime](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/validation.md).

CI prefers the immutable Runtime PyPI release. Before a Runtime release reaches
PyPI, CI builds a wheel from the immutable revision recorded in `runtime-source.json`. This is only a preparation fixture:
published dependency metadata always uses the exact PyPI version. Release
workflow acceptance requires installation from PyPI and never uses that fallback.

See [CI and dependency maintenance](docs/ci.md), [publishing](docs/publishing.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md), and
the optional [Skill](https://github.com/cnkang/skills/tree/main/qdrant-memory).

## Dependency boundary

The runtime dependency is only `hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory[mcp]`. The sdist includes the
Python acceptance tests, apart from harnesses that need an external Runtime checkout, DSH
client assets, or Node fixtures the sdist does not carry; selected harness lockfiles and
Node-only `.mjs` tests are excluded. The wheel remains metadata-only. Development
dependencies are declared under `[project.optional-dependencies].dev` and are not installed
for end users.

## WorkBuddy and DeepSeek Harness

Use the [WorkBuddy connector](integrations/workbuddy/README.md) or the
[DSH installation guide](docs/dsh-integration.md) for explicit durable memory.
Both reuse the Python Runtime, the four MCP tools and the canonical Skill. The published [managed launcher](integrations/managed/README.md) prepares private Python
and CPU-model dependencies with Node.js. Thus, the managed routes do not require a
system Python, uvx or Ollama installation. The DSH Bundle is
distributed as `@cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle`. Existing Hermes profiles
and defaults are unchanged. See [architecture and version matrix](docs/cross-harness-architecture.md)
and [validation limits](docs/dsh-validation.md).

# Qdrant Memory native lifecycle adapter for DSH

This Host-only Cordis bundle adds optional automatic recall, memory injection,
and completed-turn capture to DeepSeek Harness. It uses the existing Python
Runtime through its authenticated HTTPS Owner endpoint. It does not open
Qdrant, create a second ledger, or change the four public MCP tools.

The package targets the pinned DSH prerelease `0.2.2-rc.1`, Node.js 24.9 or
newer, and Python Runtime 0.6.1 or newer. Runtime 0.6.1 supports the versioned
candidate event and durable receipt retry used by this adapter. The DSH package
remains private canonical source. The reviewed packer includes it in the existing
`@cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle` candidate; do not publish a separate Native
package. See [Bundle storage modes](../bundle/README.md#candidate-storage-modes).

## Install

After installing a compatible Runtime, install this local bundle into one DSH
profile with the official Plugin Manager:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/integrations/dsh/native
```

The bundle keeps all three features disabled. Set them through the DSH Plugin
Manager only after the Owner service and capture policy are configured:

```yaml
auto_recall:
  enabled: false
auto_capture:
  enabled: false
memory_injection:
  enabled: false
```

Recall requires both `auto_recall.enabled` and `memory_injection.enabled`.
Capture is independent. Set a value to `true` only for an explicitly approved
profile.

## Configure the Owner connection

Start the existing Runtime Owner with its lifecycle endpoint enabled and an
explicit write grant with a capture rule. Set these environment variables
before launching DSH:

| Variable | Required value |
| --- | --- |
| `QDRANT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_PYTHON` | Absolute path to the Python interpreter with the Runtime installed |
| `QDRANT_MEMORY_DSH_OWNER_URL` | Owner HTTPS endpoint with the exact `/mcp` path |
| `QDRANT_MEMORY_DSH_OWNER_TOKEN` | Provisioned Owner write token; never put it in profile YAML |
| `QDRANT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_CA_FILE` | Optional absolute path to a private CA bundle |

The adapter passes only the Owner token and basic process paths to the Python
child. It launches the child in isolated mode (`-I -S` plus a fixed
site-packages bootstrap) from the interpreter's own directory, so project
content and site startup files cannot shadow the installed Runtime. It does not
inherit unrelated DSH credentials, print request contents, or fall back to
another identity after an authorization failure. The Runtime derives scope from
the Owner grant. Owner setup and TLS policy remain governed
by the [shared security guide](https://github.com/cnkang/qdrant-memory-mcp/blob/main/docs/shared-deployment-security.md).

## Lifecycle behavior

- Recall runs once at `agent/pre-step` when a new direct user message is
  present. It calls the existing scoped `qdrant_memory_search` tool through
  the Owner and appends a logged user message tagged `qdrant-memory`. Captured
  memory text is JSON-escaped and marked as untrusted data.
- Capture accepts only completed turns. It uses the recorded provider/model
  route, asks DSH's own LLM facade for strict candidate JSON, then sends only
  versioned candidates to the Python Owner. If a candidate explicitly replaces
  an older fact, the request also carries one exact user-text excerpt (at most
  2 KiB); Owner retains it only until the write settles so Runtime can verify
  replacement intent. DSH sends both user and assistant turn text to its own
  extraction call. The Owner event has no assistant field, but its candidates
  can contain facts derived from assistant text and are sent to Runtime. The Runtime performs
  authority checks, scope filtering, relation review, deduplication, ledger
  recovery, and Qdrant writes.
- It ignores tool output, non-user injected messages, interrupted assistant
  output, and all non-completed turn endings. Credential-shaped transcripts
  and candidates are skipped.
- Before capture it awaits DSH's public session flush and reads the validated
  session log. On resume it checks the completed turns that follow the saved
  activation boundary against Owner receipts, batched in eight turns, and skips
  turns already resolved through the durable recovery-progress marker. For
  `ACCEPTED` and `PENDING` receipts, it retries by event ID only; the Runtime
  reuses the original immutable candidate plan. `FAILED` and `QUARANTINED`
  receipts remain for explicit Owner-operator recovery. Candidate data stays
  out of the DSH session log, and the adapter does not re-extract under that ID.
- The queue is bounded. A full queue or a failure before an Owner receipt can
  leave an uncaptured turn in the DSH log. Successful DSH flush plus an Owner
  receipt is the recovery boundary; this adapter makes no zero-loss claim
  before that point.

## Configuration recipes

All three switches are off in the package defaults and bundled patch. The
Plugin Manager controls the selected profile's values. These examples contain
no credentials:

**Everything off (default):**

```yaml
auto_recall:
  enabled: false
auto_capture:
  enabled: false
memory_injection:
  enabled: false
```

**Recall only:**

```yaml
auto_recall:
  enabled: true
memory_injection:
  enabled: true
auto_capture:
  enabled: false
```

**Capture only:**

```yaml
auto_recall:
  enabled: false
memory_injection:
  enabled: false
auto_capture:
  enabled: true
```

**Capture and recall:**

```yaml
auto_recall:
  enabled: true
memory_injection:
  enabled: true
auto_capture:
  enabled: true
```

Recall requires both recall and injection. Capture is independent. A compatible
Runtime Owner must be ready before enabling either write or recall behavior.

## Choose the Owner embedding and deployment

Embedding selection belongs to the Python Owner profile, not DSH. Create a new
Owner destination using the [Runtime embedding guide](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/local-embedding.md)
and [shared Owner setup](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/shared-memory/README.md).
Runtime 0.6.1 provides the versioned candidate-event and retry contract used by
the adapter and is publicly available on PyPI. The commands below install the
released `0.6.1` wheel. On replay, the adapter automatically retries Owner
receipts in `ACCEPTED` or `PENDING` state by event ID, reusing the Owner's
stored plan. `FAILED` and `QUARANTINED` events require explicit Owner-operator
recovery.

For a new local CPU Owner, explicitly install the Runtime's `local` extra and
create a separate profile:

```sh
python -m pip install 'hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory[remote,local]==0.6.1'
qdrant-memory setup --profile /absolute/private/dsh-owner --embedding-provider fastembed --agent-id dsh-owner
```

For an existing Ollama model, the Runtime `local` extra is not needed:

```sh
python -m pip install 'hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory[remote]==0.6.1'
qdrant-memory setup --profile /absolute/private/dsh-owner --embedding-provider ollama --model qwen3-embedding:4b --dimensions 2560 --agent-id dsh-owner
```

For an Owner operated at another HTTPS host, configure a protected destination,
TLS proxy, and profile-scoped grant as described in the [HTTPS Owner guide](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/shared-memory/remote-owner.md).
Set the endpoint and a unique token for each DSH profile in the trusted DSH
process environment. Do not copy the Owner's Qdrant or embedding credentials
to DSH:

```text
QDRANT_MEMORY_DSH_OWNER_URL=https://memory.example.com/mcp
QDRANT_MEMORY_DSH_OWNER_TOKEN=<profile-specific secret from a secret manager>
QDRANT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_PYTHON=/absolute/path/to/compatible-runtime/bin/python
```

Use a separate profile and provisioned token for each unrelated DSH identity.
The Owner determines what that token can read or write. The native adapter does
not combine private data from DSH, Hermes, or WorkBuddy automatically.

## Migration, rollback, and troubleshooting

The published Bundle and Python/uvx overlay remain explicit MCP routes. To try
the native preview later, retain the existing profile and data, add the native
plugin, and leave all switches off until the matching Runtime and Owner grant
are ready. Keep at most one published MCP route (Bundle or overlay) per profile.
The native plugin can be added alongside that one route after the candidate
Runtime is available.

Rollback by disabling the three switches, removing only the native plugin,
then restarting that DSH profile. For example:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-native
```

This does not delete profile files, Owner receipts, Ledger entries, Qdrant
records, or embedding caches. Do not delete those resources as part of plugin
rollback. If capture is pending, check its exact Owner receipt before taking
another action; a transport error alone does not prove that the event failed.

If recall is missing, first confirm both switches are enabled, the profile's
Owner grant allows search, and the endpoint certificate and token work. For
capture, confirm `auto_capture.enabled`, the Runtime candidate-event version,
the Owner write grant, and an active capture rule. The adapter fails open for
ordinary DSH conversation when recall is unavailable and does not queue a
second write under an uncertain event ID.

The adapter runs the Runtime with `-I -S` plus a bootstrap that adds the
interpreter's site-packages without processing `.pth` files or `sitecustomize`,
so `QDRANT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_PYTHON` must name an interpreter whose `site-packages`
contains the Runtime: a dedicated venv, a `uv tool` environment, or a venv
created with `--system-site-packages` whose base interpreter has the Runtime
installed. `--user` and `PYTHONPATH` installs are not visible to the child.

`-I` isolates the working tree, `PYTHONPATH`, and user site-packages; `-S` skips
site initialization, so project-controlled startup code and `.pth` files cannot
run while `QDRANT_MEMORY_DSH_OWNER_TOKEN` is present. The bootstrap honors the
venv's `include-system-site-packages` setting. The interpreter binary and its
installed packages remain a trusted installation; never use a virtual
environment stored inside the DSH project.

## Diagnostics

The plugin keeps in-process counters for recall requests, hits, failures, cache
hits, injected memory count and characters, capture turns seen, eligible and
committed, capture failures, backlog drops, recovery scans, and cumulative
recall latency. The disposer returned by `apply()` exposes a `metrics()` snapshot
for programmatic hosts and tests; DSH has no native status command for it.
Counters never include transcript text or credentials. Runtime receipts expose
status only, so mutation action breakdown and dedupe rate are not available.

## Validation

Run `npm ci` and `npm test` in this directory. These tests exercise bounded
event projection, strict candidate validation, prompt-safe formatting, and
disabled defaults. They use synthetic fixtures and do not represent a live
model, a configured Owner, a GUI check, or a published Runtime acceptance run.
See the [native design](https://github.com/cnkang/qdrant-memory-mcp/blob/main/docs/dsh-native/design.md),
[validation report](https://github.com/cnkang/qdrant-memory-mcp/blob/main/docs/dsh-native/validation.md), and
[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md).

# Qdrant Memory MCP

**One Memory. Multiple Agents. No Lock-in.**

The [Codex plugin candidate](plugins/qdrant-memory/README.md) adds guided local
setup, read-only native-memory import and verified JSON/Markdown handoff. It is
versioned independently and does not add a second Runtime. See the
[executed validation and limits](docs/codex-plugin-verification.md). Exports remain
readable without this plugin or a subscription; native adoption is verified
separately from file creation.

Durable, portable, and permission-aware memory for AI agents — distributed as
an MCP adapter over the Qdrant Memory Runtime.

For shared production deployments, read the [deployment security guide](docs/shared-deployment-security.md). Owner-only database write credentials are required independently of MCP grants. Configure destination protection and shared doctor before deployment. See the [Owner support record](docs/universal-owner-status.md) for support limits.

## One Memory, Multiple Agents — opt-in shared owner

The distribution adds an opt-in single-owner service and stdio bridge. Install Runtime 0.6.1 to use them. See [shared integration guide](integrations/shared/README.md). Private defaults are unchanged. Native Provider automatic shared extraction is deferred.

<!-- mcp-name: io.github.cnkang/qdrant-memory -->

A [WorkBuddy connector](integrations/workbuddy/README.md) and a
[DeepSeek Harness bundle](integrations/dsh/bundle/README.md) reuse this stdio
MCP, the managed launcher and the canonical Skill.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Persistent, scoped memory for AI agents through four explicit **stdio MCP** tools.
This repository distributes the existing [Python Runtime](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory).
Its metadata-only wheel contains no Python business implementation. The console
script points directly to `qdrant_memory.standalone:main` and depends on
`hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory[mcp]==0.6.1`.

See [0.3.2 release notes](docs/releases/0.3.2.md) for the Runtime pin and upgrade guidance.

Before using an exact-version installation command, confirm that version on
the [PyPI release page](https://pypi.org/project/qdrant-memory-mcp/0.3.2/).
If unavailable, these package commands cannot run yet. Use the
[published 0.3.1 guide](https://github.com/cnkang/qdrant-memory-mcp/blob/v0.3.1/README.md)
until publication; a source candidate does not establish PyPI or npm availability.

**Versions:** MCP distribution 0.3.2 pins Runtime 0.6.1, which supports MCP
Python SDK 1.x and 2.x (`mcp>=1.30,<3`). The four scoped tools and stdio
launch arguments are the same for both SDK majors. The commands below use
these exact versions. Release
artifacts are available through the [distribution PyPI page](https://pypi.org/project/qdrant-memory-mcp/)
and [Runtime PyPI page](https://pypi.org/project/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/).
See [release checklist](docs/publishing.md) for the publishing sequence.

Runtime, [optional Agent Skill](https://github.com/cnkang/skills/tree/main/qdrant-memory)
and MCP distribution versions are independent. The Skill is usage guidance,
not a runtime dependency. Hermes retains its native MemoryProvider, automatic
extraction and prefetch. Ordinary MCP performs only explicitly requested memory
operations. It does not automatically extract every conversation turn.

## Harness support matrix

Verification levels: configuration example only, protocol-level tested, official
SDK/CLI tested, real host tested, real desktop GUI tested, not verified.

| Host | Native Provider | Explicit MCP tools | Automatic capture | Automatic recall | Shared Owner | Remote access | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hermes | Yes | Yes (via standalone) | Yes | Yes | Opt-in | Yes | Real host tested |
| OpenCode | No | Yes | No | No | Via Owner | Yes | Real host tested (dual-device) |
| Pi | No | Yes (extension) | Opt-in adapter | Opt-in adapter | Via Owner | Yes | Real host tested |
| DeepSeek Harness | No (lifecycle adapter) | Yes (DSH bundle) | Opt-in preview | Opt-in preview | Via Owner | Yes | DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 CI host tested; real model/GUI unverified |
| WorkBuddy | No | Yes (connector) | No | No | Via Owner | Yes | Real desktop GUI tested |
| Codex | No | Yes | No | No | Via Owner | Yes | Official CLI tested |

This distribution does not auto-extract conversations for any MCP host. Automatic
capture and recall require a native provider or a lifecycle adapter. The DSH
native preview is opt-in and source-merged, but its npm package is private and
Runtime 0.6.1 is published. Real DSH AgentLoop, model, and desktop GUI evidence
remains pending.
See the [Codex validation record](docs/codex-plugin-verification.md) for the
tested CLI, source revisions and model providers; desktop GUI and native-memory
adoption are separate verification boundaries.

## Install and initialize

For the shortest currently supported local setup, follow the
[Ollama quickstart](docs/quickstart.md) ([中文](docs/quickstart.zh-CN.md)).
It covers an existing model, installing a missing model, a separate WorkBuddy
profile, connection settings and a first save/search check. No Qdrant server,
Docker, cloud account or embedding API key is needed for that local path.
Python/uv and one-time profile configuration are still required for this
direct route. The managed WorkBuddy connector and DSH bundle prepare those
dependencies from Node.js instead.

Requires Python 3.11+ and either [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) or a Python
virtual environment. You must configure storage and an embedding service.
For the example below, run Ollama and install `qwen3-embedding:4b` yourself.

Create an operator-owned profile directory and save `qdrant-memory.json` inside:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "scope": {"user_id": "my-user", "agent_id": "my-agent"},
  "qdrant": {"mode": "embedded", "collection": "qdrant_memory"},
  "embedding": {
    "mode": "plugin", "provider": "ollama", "model": "qwen3-embedding:4b",
    "base_url": "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "dimensions": 2560, "distance": "Cosine"
  }
}
```

Initialize, then launch (replace `/path/to/profile` with your absolute path):

```bash
uvx --from qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2 qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile init
uvx --from qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2 qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile mcp
```

The command without `--home` uses `~/.qdrant-memory`, independent of Hermes.
Configure and initialize that directory before letting a Registry client launch
`uvx --from qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2 qdrant-memory-mcp mcp`.
The executable name matches the package name.
The Registry's positional `mcp` selects protocol mode. Its optional named
`--home` precedes `mcp` when a client supplies a custom profile.

Alternatively:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2
.venv/bin/qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile init
.venv/bin/qdrant-memory-mcp --home /path/to/profile mcp
```

On Windows use `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` and
`.venv\Scripts\qdrant-memory-mcp.exe`.

Qdrant embedded, self-hosted server and Cloud, plus Ollama and OpenAI-compatible
embeddings, are configured in the Runtime's [configuration reference](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/configuration.md).
Keep credentials in operator environment variables (`QDRANT_API_KEY`,
`EMBEDDING_API_KEY`, or configured names). Never commit their values.
Initialization against an existing collection requires explicit operator choice.
Do not use a production destination for a first test.

## Connect a client

Codex `config.toml` example:

```toml
[mcp_servers.qdrant_memory]
command = "uvx"
args = ["--from", "qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2", "qdrant-memory-mcp", "--home", "/path/to/profile", "mcp"]
```

OpenCode `opencode.json` example:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "qdrant_memory": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["uvx", "--from", "qdrant-memory-mcp==0.3.2", "qdrant-memory-mcp", "--home", "/path/to/profile", "mcp"],
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

Pi needs a separately installed MCP client/extension. In that extension, use
`command: uvx` and the same argument list. No built-in Pi MCP support or universal
extension config format is claimed. These are configuration examples. This
protocol acceptance tests use the official Python MCP SDK. Host-specific evidence
is recorded separately in the [architecture and support boundaries](docs/cross-harness-architecture.md)
and the Runtime's [client evidence and limits](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/mcp.md).

## Tools and boundaries

| Tool | Input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `qdrant_memory_search` | `query`, optional `category` | Scoped memories with IDs, scores and provenance |
| `qdrant_memory_add` | `text` | Durable memory ID |
| `qdrant_memory_update` | exact `id`, replacement `text` | Scoped replacement |
| `qdrant_memory_delete` | exact `id` | Scoped deletion |

Scope is fixed by the operator's profile (`user_id`, `agent_id`). Model inputs
and MCP client identity cannot override it. Knowing an ID does not grant access.
Migration, export, reset and bulk deletion remain trusted operator CLI commands.
See [standalone maintenance](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/standalone.md).
No resources or prompts are advertised. This is a local subprocess, with no
public HTTP/SSE listener or remote authentication service. Stdout is reserved
for protocol messages, with sanitized diagnostics on stderr.

Data flows from client → Runtime → embedding provider → Qdrant and the local
SQLite ledger. With local Ollama and embedded Qdrant, memory processing stays
local. Cloud embedding receives memory/query text, and cloud Qdrant receives
vectors and stored payloads. The client/model may also receive recalled text.
The operator must authorize retention and access and protect the profile files.

One writer lease coordinates a profile/destination. Do not overlap MCP, CLI
or Hermes processes writing to it. Separate profiles or machines do not provide
a distributed lock. This package does not support uncoordinated multiprocess
writes, auto-extraction, an HTTP transport, or implicit credential discovery
from Hermes. It preserves the Runtime's ledger, IDs and recovery semantics.

## Concepts and evidence

- Sharing vs Portability vs Backup: [Runtime portability guide](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/portability.md)
- Cross-harness architecture: [docs/cross-harness-architecture.md](docs/cross-harness-architecture.md)
- Shared Owner status: [docs/universal-owner-status.md](docs/universal-owner-status.md)
- Validation limits: [docs/dsh-validation.md](docs/dsh-validation.md)

Validation reports apply to their recorded versions, workloads and host
environments. Short protocol or cloud runs do not establish 24-hour acceptance
for a new release.

## Verification and development

CI builds wheel/sdist, checks metadata and ownership marker. It runs installed
protocol tests with temporary profiles, embedded Qdrant and a deterministic
loopback embedding fixture on Linux/macOS/Windows, Python 3.11 and 3.14.
No test connects to personal Qdrant, Hermes profiles or memory data. These tests
cover initialize, discovery, four tools, persistence, recovery, scope isolation,
error redaction and protocol stdout. Provider/cloud compatibility evidence
belongs to the [Runtime](https://github.com/cnkang/hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory/blob/main/docs/validation.md).

CI prefers the immutable Runtime PyPI release. Before a Runtime release reaches
PyPI, CI builds a wheel from the immutable revision recorded in `runtime-source.json`. This is only a preparation fixture:
published dependency metadata always uses the exact PyPI version. Release
workflow acceptance requires installation from PyPI and never uses that fallback.

See [CI and dependency maintenance](docs/ci.md), [publishing](docs/publishing.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md), and
the optional [Skill](https://github.com/cnkang/skills/tree/main/qdrant-memory).

## Dependency boundary

The runtime dependency is only `hermes-plugin-qdrant-memory[mcp]`. The sdist includes the
Python acceptance tests, apart from harnesses that need an external Runtime checkout, DSH
client assets, or Node fixtures the sdist does not carry; selected harness lockfiles and
Node-only `.mjs` tests are excluded. The wheel remains metadata-only. Development
dependencies are declared under `[project.optional-dependencies].dev` and are not installed
for end users.

## WorkBuddy and DeepSeek Harness

Use the [WorkBuddy connector](integrations/workbuddy/README.md) or the
[DSH installation guide](docs/dsh-integration.md) for explicit durable memory.
Both reuse the Python Runtime, the four MCP tools and the canonical Skill. The published [managed launcher](integrations/managed/README.md) prepares private Python
and CPU-model dependencies with Node.js. Thus, the managed routes do not require a
system Python, uvx or Ollama installation. The DSH Bundle is
distributed as `@cnkang/qdrant-memory-dsh-bundle`. Existing Hermes profiles
and defaults are unchanged. See [architecture and version matrix](docs/cross-harness-architecture.md)
and [validation limits](docs/dsh-validation.md).
