evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# AI Diagram Studio

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns Indonesian or English requirements into validated **ERD**, **flowchart**, **UML class/use-case/activity/state**, **sequence**, and **software architecture** diagrams.

It does not stop at emitting diagram text. Every request runs:

**GENERATE → VALIDATE → RENDER → INSPECT → REFINE → EXPORT → VERIFY**

The canonical model is a versioned JSON IR. SVG is rendered locally, without a cloud service. PNG and vector PDF are produced with an installed Chromium, then checked before they are reported as artifacts.

## What works

| Family | Support |
| --- | --- |
| ERD | entities, attributes, types, PK/FK/UQ, composite keys, one-to-one/one-to-many/many-to-many, optional participation, associative entities, crow's-foot notation |
| Flowchart | start/end, process, input/output, decision, labelled branches, rejection, retry/loops, subprocess, notes |
| UML class | classes, abstract classes, interfaces, enums, attributes, methods, inheritance, realization, association, dependency, aggregation, composition, multiplicities |
| UML use case | actors, use cases, system boundary, association, include, extend, generalization |
| UML activity | initial/final, actions, decisions, merge, fork/join, guards |
| UML state machine | initial/final, states, choices, guarded transitions, actions |
| Sequence | actors/participants, lifelines, ordered sync/async/return/self messages, activations, alt/opt/loop/par/break/critical frames |
| Architecture | clients, frontends, gateways, APIs, services, databases, caches, queues, workers, storage, external and infra components, boundaries/groups |

Exports: **SVG**, **PNG**, and **PDF**. PDFs preserve the vector SVG through Chromium printing.

## Requirements

- Node.js **20 or newer** (tested on Node 26).
- Chromium/Chrome for PNG and PDF export. Resolution order:
  1. `DIAGRAM_CHROMIUM` / `CHROMIUM_PATH`
  2. Playwright's `chromium-*/chrome-linux64/chrome`
  3. `/usr/bin/chromium`, `/usr/bin/chromium-browser`, `/usr/bin/google-chrome`
- Optional: Poppler `pdfinfo` and `pdftoppm` for deeper PDF verification. If absent, PDF structural checks still run and the missing optional tool is disclosed.

SVG generation and all semantic validation work without Chromium. PNG/PDF requests fail with the bounded error code `renderer_unavailable` when no browser is found.

## Install in DSH

From the DSH workspace:

```text
plugin_manager action:"install_bundle" target:"/absolute/path/to/ai-diagram-studio"
```

The package carries `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml` inserts `ai-diagram-studio`). Installing copies it into the profile and activates the six host tools. A DSH restart is not normally required.

Manual fallback: add the same row to the profile composition through the normal plugin manager; do not hand-edit a running profile's generated files.

## Host tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `generate_diagram` | Create a diagram from a requirement or `structured_specification`. Passing `existing_diagram_id` revises instead. |
| `revise_diagram` | Apply a natural-language or structured patch to a stored diagram. |
| `validate_diagram` | Re-run semantic and IR checks without rendering. |
| `export_diagram` | Re-export a stored diagram in one or more formats. |
| `list_supported_diagrams` | Types, formats, themes, renderer availability, and stored diagrams. |
| `list_diagram_revisions` | Revision history and change summaries. |

Example:

```json
{
  "requirement": "Buatkan ERD untuk sistem perpustakaan yang memiliki anggota, buku, peminjaman, pengembalian, dan denda. Tampilkan PK dan FK, lalu ekspor ke PDF.",
  "diagram_type": "auto",
  "output_formats": ["svg", "png", "pdf"],
  "theme": "professional",
  "language": "auto"
}
```

Revision:

```json
{
  "diagram_id": "dg-erd-...",
  "instruction": "Tambahkan tabel payments dan hubungkan dengan orders. Jangan ubah relasi lainnya. Ekspor PNG dan PDF."
}
```

The `revise_diagram` tool also accepts `structured_patch` operations: `add_node`, `add_edge`, `remove_node`, `rename_node`, `update_node`, `update_edge`, `set_cardinality`, `set_style`, `set_title`.

## CLI

```bash
node src/cli.js generate "Flowchart approval cuti: mulai, ajukan cuti, periksa berkas, jika lengkap setujui, jika tidak tolak, selesai" \
  --formats svg,png,pdf --theme professional --title "Approval Cuti"

node src/cli.js revise <diagram-id> "Ganti tema menjadi dark dan gunakan landscape" --formats svg,png

node src/cli.js validate <diagram-id>
node src/cli.js export <diagram-id> --formats svg,pdf
node src/cli.js list
node src/cli.js revisions <diagram-id>
```

Useful flags: `--type`, `--formats`, `--theme`, `--orientation`, `--density`, `--language`, `--scale`, `--spec`, `--store`, `--workspace`, `--json`.

## Storage

By default a workspace gets:

```text
.diagram-studio/
  registry.json
  diagrams/<diagram-id>/
    diagram.ir.json
    history/revision-000N.json
    exports/<diagram-id>-r<revision>-<stamp>-<nonce>.<ext>
```

Every artifact path is normalized and checked to stay inside the workspace. Re-export never overwrites an earlier file. The IR, not an SVG, is the source of truth for revisions.

## Status model

- `SUCCESS` — all applicable mandatory checks passed.
- `SUCCESS_WITH_WARNINGS` — blocking correctness/render/export checks passed; nonblocking assumptions, limits, or unavailable optional checks are disclosed.
- `NEEDS_CLARIFICATION` — a material ambiguity or contradiction prevents faithful generation.
- `FAILED` — a blocking semantic, rendering, security, or export check failed.

The quality report lists semantic, rendering, layout, refinement, and export checks. Visual review is **programmatic** (geometry, PNG pixels, SVG/PDF validity); the plugin never claims a human visual inspection.

## Tests and samples

```bash
npm test                 # 24 automated scenarios
npm run smoke            # one end-to-end flowchart
npm run build:samples    # regenerate outputs/samples + manifest
```

`examples/requests.json` contains eight reproducible requests covering every family. `outputs/samples/manifest.json` records the exact status, warnings, sizes, checks, and SHA-256 of each generated SVG/PNG/PDF.

## Documentation

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [IR schema](docs/ir-schema.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Test report](docs/test-report.md)
- [Known limitations](docs/limitations.md)
- [Live DSH verification](docs/live-verification.md)

# dsh-plugins

Profil **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** `web` sebagai kode: manifest profil, patch konfigurasi, dan tiga plugin lokal yang dipakai sehari-hari.

Repo ini adalah sumber kebenaran untuk komposisi profil Web. `git clone` lalu `pnpm install` cukup untuk membangun kembali profil yang sama di mesin lain — tidak ada langkah build.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Remote | `git@github.com:nyxsr/dsh-plugins.git` (branch `master`) |
| Profil tujuan | `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web` (default `~/.dsh/profiles/web`) |
| Versi DSH | `0.2.2-rc.2` |
| Node | >= 20 (lihat `engines.node` setiap plugin) |
| pnpm | 11.x, `nodeLinker: hoisted` |

## Isi repo

```
.
├── package.json            # dependensi + dsh.profile.bundles (urutan layer)
├── pnpm-lock.yaml          # versi terkunci seluruh dependensi
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml     # nodeLinker: hoisted, izin build script
├── cordis.patch.yml        # patch pengguna, diterapkan setelah semua layer bundle
├── .gitignore
└── plugins/
    ├── ai-diagram-studio/   # 6 tool diagram: ERD, flowchart, UML, sequence, arsitektur
    ├── ai-pdf-studio/       # 10 tool PDF: generate, preview, inspect, edit, redesign, ...
    └── storage-insights/    # pemindai 10 file/folder terbesar
```

Tiga plugin lokal di-link lewat path relatif, bukan disalin:

```json
"@local/ai-diagram-studio": "link:./plugins/ai-diagram-studio"
```

Path relatif inilah yang membuat repo portabel. Jangan diganti menjadi `link:/home/...`.

## Prasyarat

| Kebutuhan | Dipakai oleh |
| --- | --- |
| Node.js >= 20, pnpm 11 | semua |
| DSH `0.2.2-rc.2` terpasang | semua |
| Chromium/Chrome | render PNG/PDF (`ai-diagram-studio`, `ai-pdf-studio`) |
| Poppler (`pdfinfo`, `pdftoppm`, `pdftotext`) + `python3` dengan Pillow | inspeksi & metrik halaman PDF |
| Opsional: browser Playwright | bundle `playwright-browser` |

Deteksi Chromium: `DIAGRAM_CHROMIUM` / `CHROMIUM_PATH` → Playwright `chromium-*/chrome-linux64/chrome` → `/usr/bin/chromium` → `/usr/bin/chromium-browser` → `/usr/bin/google-chrome`. Tanpa Chromium, SVG dan seluruh validasi semantik tetap berjalan; permintaan PNG/PDF gagal dengan `renderer_unavailable`.

Poppler biasanya tersedia lewat paket distro `poppler-utils`; Pillow lewat `python3-pil` atau `pip` bila tersedia.

## Pasang di mesin baru

```bash
git clone git@github.com:nyxsr/dsh-plugins.git "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web"
cd "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web"
pnpm install
dsh web
```

`pnpm install` mengambil enam bundle pihak ketiga dari npm/GitHub dan me-link tiga plugin dari `plugins/`. Lockfile menjamin versi yang sama dengan mesin asal.

Verifikasi komposisi tanpa boot:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep '^# =='
```

Setiap bundle muncul sebagai komentar layer, dengan urutan yang sama seperti `dsh.profile.bundles`.

## Bundle yang aktif

Urutan array di `dsh.profile.bundles` adalah urutan layer: bundle berikutnya boleh meng-override baris dari bundle sebelumnya.

| # | Bundle | Sumber |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` | instalasi DSH |
| 2 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` | instalasi DSH |
| 3 | `@local/storage-insights` | `plugins/storage-insights` |
| 4 | `dsh-plugin` | npm `^2.3.6` |
| 5 | `billion-context` | npm `^0.1.213` |
| 6 | `dsh-better-sidebar` | npm `0.30.1` |
| 7 | `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` | npm `1.4.2` |
| 8 | `@local/ai-pdf-studio` | `plugins/ai-pdf-studio` |
| 9 | `dsh-ops` | npm `0.5.2` |
| 10 | `playwright-browser` | `github:whklwhkl/dsh-playwright` |
| 11 | `@local/ai-diagram-studio` | `plugins/ai-diagram-studio` |

Dua entri pertama milik instalasi DSH, bukan isi repo ini. Jangan mengubah urutan tanpa alasan: ia menentukan layer mana yang menang saat ada baris yang sama.

## Konfigurasi

`cordis.patch.yml` adalah layer terakhir dan milik pengguna, bukan milik bundle.

| Row | Efek |
| --- | --- |
| `ui-settings-general` | `welcomeNoticeVersion: 2026-09-28.1` |
| `agent-default-model` | provider `deepseek-account`, model `deepseek-flash` |
| `llm-pi-ai` | provider `zai` dengan `apiKeyEnv: ZAI_API_KEY` |
| `ui-theme` | `preference: dark` |
| `better-sidebar` | `agentOpenTools: true` |
| `codex-subscription` | `quickQuotaMode: percent` |

`apiKeyEnv` hanya menyimpan **nama** variabel environment; nilainya tidak pernah masuk repo. Kredensial DSH berada di `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` dan tidak ikut di-commit.

## Yang tidak di-commit

| Path | Alasan |
| --- | --- |
| `node_modules/` | hasil `pnpm install`, ~515 MB di profil lengkap |
| `plugins/*/outputs/` | artefak generate, dibuat ulang oleh tiap plugin |
| `plugins/*/tests/.tmp/` | scratch test (~54 MB di `ai-pdf-studio`) |
| `*.log`, `coverage/`, `.env*` | log, laporan, dan rahasia |

Di luar repo dan tidak perlu di-backup sebagai kode: `~/.dsh/sessions`, `~/.dsh/storages`, `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, `~/.dsh-wallpaper-engine` (state plugin wallpaper), dan `.diagram-studio/` (registry diagram).

Commit pertama berisi ~155 file, pack ~780 KiB. Kalau `git status` tiba-tiba menampilkan puluhan MB, `.gitignore` sedang tidak berlaku — periksa sebelum `git add`.

## Alur kerja

### Mengubah plugin

```bash
cd ~/dsh-config
# sunting plugins/<nama>/...
cd plugins/ai-pdf-studio && node --test        # atau: pnpm test
cd ~/dsh-config
git add -A && git commit -m "pdf: perbaiki X"
git push
```

Perubahan langsung terpakai oleh DSH karena profil menunjuk ke direktori ini lewat link; boot ulang hanya perlu bila plugin menambah baris Host baru.

### Menambah plugin pihak ketiga

```bash
cd "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web"
dsh plugin --profile web add <nama-paket>
```

Perintah itu memperbarui `package.json` (dependensi + `dsh.profile.bundles`) dan lockfile. Di mesin ini, salin perubahan itu ke repo atau jalankan profil langsung dari repo (lihat bagian berikut), lalu commit.

### Menambah plugin lokal

1. Taruh paketnya di `plugins/<nama>/` dan pastikan `package.json`-nya mendeklarasikan `dsh.bundle.patch`.
2. Tambahkan dependensi `"@local/<nama>": "link:./plugins/<nama>"`.
3. Tambahkan `@local/<nama>` ke `dsh.profile.bundles` pada posisi yang diinginkan.
4. `pnpm install`.

### Menjalankan tes

```bash
cd plugins/ai-diagram-studio && node --test tests/*.test.js
cd plugins/ai-pdf-studio && node --test
```

Tes yang merender atau mengukur PDF membutuhkan Chromium dan Poppler.

## Memakai repo ini di mesin ini

Repo berada di `~/dsh-config`, sedangkan DSH membaca profil di `~/.dsh/profiles/web`. Keduanya harus saling menunjuk. Dua pilihan:

**A. Profil menunjuk ke repo (path absolut).** Sederhana, tetapi `package.json` profil berbeda dari repo sehingga perlu disalin setiap kali plugin berubah:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm remove @local/ai-diagram-studio @local/ai-pdf-studio @local/storage-insights
pnpm add "link:$HOME/dsh-config/plugins/ai-diagram-studio" \
         "link:$HOME/dsh-config/plugins/ai-pdf-studio" \
         "link:$HOME/dsh-config/plugins/storage-insights"
```

**B. Repo menjadi direktori profil.** Tidak ada salinan kedua: `dsh plugin add` dan editor konfigurasi menulis langsung ke file repo.

```bash
mv ~/.dsh/profiles/web ~/.dsh/profiles/web.backup
ln -s ~/dsh-config ~/.dsh/profiles/web
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm install
```

Opsi B paling dekat dengan "satu sumber kebenaran", tetapi belum diuji pada instalasi ini: pastikan DSH mengikuti symlink direktori, lalu periksa `dsh --profile web --dump-config`. Opsi A paling aman karena hanya mengubah satu dependensi.

Pada kedua opsi, symlink `node_modules/@local/*` harus menunjuk ke `~/dsh-config/plugins/*`:

```bash
readlink -f ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@local/ai-pdf-studio
```

Sebelum salah satu opsi dijalankan, profil lama masih menunjuk ke path workspace yang sudah tidak ada, sehingga ketiga plugin lokal tidak termuat.

## Troubleshooting

| Gejala | Penyebab & tindakan |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin lokal tidak muncul setelah direktori dipindah | symlink `node_modules/@local/*` dangling. Jalankan `pnpm install` di direktori profil, lalu cek dengan `readlink -f`. |
| `ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND` | nilai `link:` menunjuk path yang tidak ada. Perbaiki menjadi `link:./plugins/<nama>`. |
| Perubahan `package.json` tidak berpengaruh | layer belum dikomposisi ulang. Boot ulang DSH; cek dengan `dsh --profile web --dump-config`. |
| `renderer_unavailable` saat PNG/PDF | Chromium tidak ditemukan. Set `CHROMIUM_PATH` ke binary yang valid. |
| Metrik PDF kosong / inspeksi dangkal | `pdfinfo`/`pdftoppm` atau Pillow tidak terpasang. |
| `git status` menampilkan `node_modules` | `.gitignore` tidak terbaca (mis. file terhapus). Kembalikan sebelum commit. |

Untuk melihat kenapa sebuah baris menang, bandingkan seluruh layer:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | less
```

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# AI PDF Studio Ultimate

Mesin produksi, inspeksi, kritik, perbaikan, dan desain ulang PDF yang adaptif untuk DeepSeek Harness.

Ini bukan konverter PDF. Plugin ini menyusun Document IR bertipe, memilih keluarga desain, merender PDF yang teksnya bisa dicari melalui Chromium headless, lalu mengukur hasilnya dengan Poppler dan Pillow. Setelah itu ia menjalankan beberapa putaran tinjauan spesialis secara berurutan, memperbaiki cacat tata letak yang benar-benar terverifikasi, dan menerbitkan keputusan rilis bersama buktinya.

## Yang benar-benar berjalan di sini

Diuji di lingkungan ini pada 10 November 2026:

| Kemampuan | Status | Bukti |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime Node | Terverifikasi | Node v26.13.0 |
| Pipeline cetak Chromium | Terverifikasi | Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.4 |
| Inspeksi PDF | Terverifikasi | `pdfinfo`, `pdftotext -bbox`, `pdffonts`, `pdfimages` |
| Pratinjau halaman | Terverifikasi | `pdftoppm` 24.02.0 |
| Penyuntingan PDF | Terverifikasi | `pdf-lib` 1.17.1 |
| Pemuatan konfigurasi | Terverifikasi | `yaml` 2.9.1 |
| Metrik gambar | Terverifikasi | Pillow (Python sistem 3.12) |
| Plugin DSH Host | Terverifikasi terpasang dan bisa dipanggil | `plugin_manager` aplikasi `applied`, 10 tool terlihat |
| OCR | **Tidak didukung** | Tidak ada biner `tesseract` |
| Model visi di dalam mesin | **Tidak tersedia** | Tinjauan visual per halaman harus diberikan secara eksplisit |
| Bookmark PDF | **Belum diimplementasikan** | Outline Chromium hilang saat penggabungan |
| PDF bertag setelah penggabungan | **Tidak dipertahankan** | Penggabungan pdf-lib membuang pohon struktur |
| Pustaka PDF Python / pip | **Tidak tersedia** | Tidak ada pip, tidak ada PyMuPDF/WeasyPrint/reportlab |

Jadi implementasinya memakai Node + Chromium + Poppler + `pdf-lib`, bukan tumpukan Python seperti pada rancangan awal. Pilihan ini diambil karena kondisi lingkungan, dan alasannya terdokumentasi.

## Arsitektur

```
request
  → intent / content planner (generate, transform, preserve)
  → Document IR validation and normalization
  → adaptive design selection (8 families, 6 category templates)
  → reference profile / brand kit resolution
  → HTML cover + body composition
  → Chromium PDF export
  → pdf-lib metadata merge
  → Poppler previews + geometry / font / link inspection
  → Pillow page metrics
  → 10 sequential review roles
  → mandatory gates + weighted scoring
  → targeted repair plan (max 3 iterations, no content deletion)
  → release decision + evidence bundle
```

Model acuannya ada di `src/core/models.js`. Setiap blok yang dirender membawa `data-component-id` yang stabil. Temuan inspeksi dan aksi perbaikan bisa ditelusuri kembali ke IR.

## Mulai cepat (CLI)

```bash
cd ai-pdf-studio
node src/cli.js capabilities
node src/cli.js list-templates
node src/cli.js generate \
  --input examples/01-business-performance-report.json \
  --out outputs/01-business-performance-report
```

Keluaran dari generasi yang berhasil berisi:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "document_id": "demo-business-performance-report",
  "pdf_path": ".../demo-business-performance-report.pdf",
  "preview_paths": ["..."],
  "page_count": 7,
  "quality_report_path": ".../quality_report.json",
  "quality_score": 98.4,
  "release_status": "approved",
  "warnings": []
}
```

Perintah lain:

```bash
node src/cli.js preview --pdf outputs/.../document.pdf --out outputs/previews
node src/cli.js inspect --pdf outputs/.../document.pdf
node src/cli.js edit --input outputs/.../document.pdf --operations ops.json
node src/cli.js redesign --pdf source.pdf --theme premium_editorial --out outputs/redesign
node src/cli.js analyze-reference --reference source.pdf --fidelity inspired
node src/cli.js apply-brand --input document.json --brand brand.json
node src/cli.js validate --input document.json
node src/cli.js export --pdf generated.pdf --out export/final.pdf
```

## Plugin DSH

Bundel `@local/ai-pdf-studio` terpasang di profil Web saat ini dan membuka sepuluh tool:

`generate_pdf`, `preview_pdf`, `inspect_pdf`, `edit_pdf`, `redesign_pdf`, `list_templates`, `analyze_design_reference`, `apply_brand_kit`, `validate_document`, `export_pdf`.

Contoh panggilan dari sisi model:

```json
{
  "name": "generate_pdf",
  "arguments": {
    "document_path": "ai-pdf-studio/examples/01-business-performance-report.json",
    "output_dir": "ai-pdf-studio/outputs/from-harness"
  }
}
```

Pemanggilan Harness yang sudah diverifikasi: `generate_pdf` menghasilkan PDF tiga halaman sungguhan di `outputs/tool-generation/dsh-tool-smoke-test.pdf` dengan kualitas 93.7. `preview_pdf` merender 7 halaman, dan `list_templates` mengembalikan 6 template. Plugin mengambil workspace dari `workingDirectory` sesi pemanggil.

## Keluarga desain

Setiap keluarga punya komposisi sampul, irama bagian, sistem huruf, perlakuan tabel, palet grafik, dan bahasa callout serta kutipan yang berbeda:

1. Modern Corporate, sampul terbelah, garis teal, pita KPI.
2. Premium Editorial, kertas krem, folio oxblood, huruf display Gelasio, drop cap.
3. Minimalist Clean, ukuran baris sempit, garis rambut, banyak ruang kosong.
4. Creative Bold, tipografi poster, blok asam dan kobalt, folio besar.
5. Technology Futuristic, panel instrumen gelap, telemetri mono, garis sinyal sian.
6. Luxury Elegant, gading dan tinta, bingkai emas, komposisi serif di tengah.
7. Academic Professional, badan Charter, bagian bernomor, pita abstrak, referensi.
8. Infographic Visual, kanvas krem, kartu fakta modular, aksen data oranye.

Template yang tersedia: laporan bisnis, proposal strategis, e-book edukasi, presentasi investor, brosur produk, dan makalah akademik. Gambar pratinjau ada di `templates/previews/`.

## Model kualitas

Gate wajib, terpisah dari skor:

- `file_valid`, `page_geometry`, `text_searchable`, `content_complete`
- `fonts_embedded`, `no_critical_clipping`, `no_critical_collisions`
- `no_unexpected_blank_pages`, `layout_audit`, `no_javascript`

Dimensi berbobot:

| Dimensi | Bobot |
|---|---:|
| Kualitas konten | 25% |
| Tata letak | 25% |
| Tipografi | 15% |
| Desain visual | 15% |
| Konsistensi merek | 10% (tidak dievaluasi bila tidak ada brand kit) |
| Teknis / aksesibilitas | 10% |

Gate yang gagal tidak bisa dikalahkan skor tinggi. Skor hanya alat diagnosis. Skor bukan bukti kualitas profesional.

## Artefak demonstrasi

Keenam dokumen contoh bersifat sintetis, fiktif, dan diberi label terbuka. Tiap dokumen punya PDF, pratinjau halaman, inspeksi teknis, kritik visual, keputusan rilis, laporan kualitas, metadata, arah desain, dan IR yang diarsipkan.

| No | Dokumen | Kategori | Tema | Halaman | Skor | Rilis |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 01 | Q3 2026 Operating Review | report | Modern Corporate | 7 | 98.4 | approved |
| 02 | Strategic growth proposal (ID) | proposal | Premium Editorial | 9 | 98.7 | approved |
| 03 | The Attention Practice | ebook | Minimalist Clean | 16 | 95.3 | approved |
| 04 | Vela investor deck (ID) | presentation | Creative Bold | 9 | 95.3 | approved |
| 05 | Aurelia No. 07 | brochure | Luxury Elegant | 7 | 96.2 | approved |
| 06 | Spacing, Not Novelty | academic | Academic Professional | 10 | 95.1 | approved |

Demonstrasi berbasis referensi ada di `outputs/reference-guided/`. Sebuah sampul laporan orisinal dianalisis menjadi profil dengan keyakinan 57%, lalu dipakai untuk menghasilkan dokumen baru empat halaman dengan skor 96.1. Tebakan gayanya meleset. Sistem menebak `luxury_elegant` pada sampul navy gelap beraksen teal. Keterbatasan itu dicatat di dalam artefak, dan itulah alasan profil buatan pengguna didukung.

## Tes

```bash
node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/unit tests/integration tests/visual
```

Hasil yang diamati: **41 tes, 41 lulus, 0 gagal** (111 detik).

Cakupannya meliputi validasi skema, keenam rendering contoh, pemilihan desain, brand kit, analisis referensi, struktur dokumen, validasi data grafik, penyuntingan, desain ulang, konten stres (tabel 60 baris, URL panjang, campuran Indonesia dan Inggris, Ångström/日本語/العربية), penghentian loop perbaikan, pelestarian konten, path traversal, pemblokiran aset jarak jauh, escaping skrip, kontrak pesan agen, dan baseline piksel untuk regresi sampul.

## Batasan

- OCR tidak tersedia. Desain ulang PDF hasil pindai gagal dengan error `ocr_not_supported` yang eksplisit.
- Mesin tidak memanggil VLM. Tinjauan visual subjektif hanya dicatat kalau diberikan. Evaluator bawaannya metrik halaman yang deterministik.
- Bookmark PDF tidak dibuat. Struktur PDF bertag hilang saat sampul dan badan digabung.
- Nilai tipografi dan grid dari referensi hanya perkiraan. Nilai palet diambil dari hasil render, bukan dari token sumber.
- Penyuntingan PDF bersifat struktural dan **tidak lossless**. Anotasi rumit dan field formulir bisa terpengaruh.
- Desain ulang hanya memulihkan teks. Tabel, grafik, gambar, dan tata letak persisnya dilaporkan sebagai kehilangan.
- Judul bagian berjalan di header halaman tidak dinamis. Yang dipakai satu header tingkat dokumen.
- Perbaikan dibatasi tiga iterasi. Artefak yang gagal tidak pernah dilabeli approved.
- Contoh bawaan memakai aset SVG orisinal dan referensi terbitan nyata hanya di tempat yang memang diberi label referensi.

## Peta repositori

```
ai-pdf-studio/
  index.js                 DSH Host plugin (10 tools)
  src/
    api/service.js         stable operations
    core/                  models, pipeline, config, paths, errors
    agents/orchestrator.js 10-role sequential review
    content/planner.js     generate/transform/preserve
    design/                themes, selector, reference analyzer, contrast
    render/                components, CSS, Chromium, PDF merge, previews
    visuals/               SVG charts/diagrams, safe assets
    quality/               inspector, page metrics, scoring, repair, reports
    editing/               pdf-lib editing, redesign
    branding/              brand kit validation
    templates/             template registry
  templates/               6 templates + previews
  assets/                  original brand marks and illustration
  examples/                6 Document IR files
  tests/                   unit, integration, stress, visual regression
  outputs/                 actual generated artifacts
  docs/                    architecture, API, testing, limitations, report
  config/                  default.yaml, quality_rules.yaml
```

# dsh-plugins

Repo ini adalah sumber kebenaran untuk komposisi profil Web. `git clone` lalu `pnpm install` cukup untuk membangun kembali profil yang sama di mesin lain — tidak ada langkah build.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Remote | `git@github.com:nyxsr/dsh-plugins.git` (branch `master`) |
| Profil tujuan | `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web` (default `~/.dsh/profiles/web`) |
| Versi DSH | `0.2.2-rc.2` |
| Node | >= 20 (lihat `engines.node` setiap plugin) |
| pnpm | 11.x, `nodeLinker: hoisted` |

## Isi repo


| `ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND` | nilai `link:` menunjuk path yang tidak ada. Perbaiki menjadi `link:./plugins/<nama>`. |

| Metrik PDF kosong / inspeksi dangkal | `pdfinfo`/`pdftoppm` atau Pillow tidak terpasang. |
| `git status` menampilkan `node_modules` | `.gitignore` tidak terbaca (mis. file terhapus). Kembalikan sebelum commit. |

Untuk melihat kenapa sebuah baris menang, bandingkan seluruh layer:

```bash

```

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-chat-embed 在 **DeepSeek Harness（dsh）桌面版**里开一个**多标签 AI 聊天面板**。 左侧导航有「聊天」入口，点开后**中央主面板就是聊天页**：顶部一排标签 —— DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT、MiniMax、Kimi、Gemini、Grok —— 每个标签是一个真实的桌面 webview，**各自独立登录**；切标签不重载页面。同一个聊天页也能放到**右栏**（会话头「⧉」按钮 / 右栏启动器），两处互斥，**哪边点哪边接管**。 ![左栏「聊天」入口，中央主面板里是 DeepSeek 聊天页](assets/screenshots/01-deepseek-left-panel.png) --- ## 项目名称与组成 | 名称 | 说明 | | --- | --- `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:active-tab']`； - 调试日志开关存在 `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:log']`（`1` 开 / `0` 关，默认关）； - 最近一次检测到的持久化状态存在 `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:persist']`，重启后无需等 guest 挂载即可显示。 ### 桌面壳补丁（可选，跨重启免登录） ```powershell node tools/shell-patch/patch-asar.cjs build # 自动探测安装目录并生成 app.asar.new node tools/shell-patch/patch-asar.cjs build --resources "D:\DeepSeek Harness\resources" node tools/shell-patch/patch-asar.cjs --help # 查看参数 # 关闭 DSH 后由 watchdog 自动替换，或手动替换 resources\app.asar ``` > 通过 npm 安装时脚本位于 `/node_modules/<包名>/tools/shell-patch/`；也可以在「⚙ → 跨重启保持登录」里点「复制补丁说明」拿到步骤。 ### 补丁状态与自检（0.6.0 起） 设置菜单里的「跨重启保持登录」有四种状态，**风险提示与「复制补丁说明」只在未生效时出现**： | 状态 | 含义 | 菜单里额外提供 | | --- | --- | --- | | 已开启（`persist:` 分区） | 补丁生效，重启后仍登录 | —（已是最优，只留「检查补丁配置」） | | 未开启（内存分区） | 从没打过补丁 | 风险提示 + 复制补丁说明 | | **已失效**（升级覆盖） | **打过补丁，但桌面壳升级覆盖了 `app.asar`** | 同上；这一状态专门告诉你"该重打了" | | 尚未检测 | 还没打开过聊天页 | 同上 | 「检查补丁配置」是一行**开关样式**的控件，任何状态下都在。打开它不会在菜单里铺开报告——那会把面板撑宽——而是： 1. 读取一次 Host 侧只读探针（见下）； 2. **打开一个新会话**，把已知事实（安装目录、可写性、补丁点、是否已打补丁、确切命令）预先写进输入框； 3. 你点「发送」即可。agent 会调用 `dsh_chat_embed_patch_check` 工具核对，然后说明现状和该执行的命令。 这条路径用的就是 DSH 自己「创建你的插件」入口的同一个 API（`uiWorkspace.startSession`），所以行为与原生一致：已有草稿时追加而不是覆盖。没有 `uiWorkspace` 的宿主会退化成把说明复制到剪贴板。 背后是 Host 侧只读探针 `GET /dsh-chat-embed/patch-check`：安装目录、`app.asar` 是否可写、是否已打补丁、补丁点是否还在（壳版本是否兼容）、备份与待替换文件、大小与内容哈希。 **不需要自己装 Node.js**：探针会找出桌面版自带的 Node 运行时（`~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependencies/node/`），并把一条完整可复制的命令写进草稿——含正确的 Node 路径、补丁脚本路径和 `--resources` 安装目录（自定义/便携安装也能用）。 Host 侧还注册了只读工具 **`dsh_chat_embed_patch_check`**：可以直接问 agent「我的聊天为什么重启后要重新登录」，它会自己去查这些事实，而不是让你跑命令再贴输出——上面第 2 步的草稿就是让它这么做的。 补丁做两件事：`persist:` 固定分区（登录落盘）+ `cache:false`（不落 Chromium 缓存）。 没有补丁也能用，只是每次重启要重新登录。细节与风险见 [已知限制](#已知限制)。 ### 界面语言 面板文案**跟随 DSH 的语言设置**（设置 → 通用设置 → 语言：中文 / English 等）：插件注册 `zh` / `en` 两套词典，通过 DSH 的 locale 服务解析当前语言，**切换后立即生效，不需要刷新或重启**（监听 `locale/change` 事件重渲染）。 - 当前语言没有对应翻译时（例如日语、西班牙语），回落到**中文**； - 诊断卡片里的席位、状态、最近事件、自检读数也随语言切换； - 插件管理器里的标题与描述（`locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`）同样是 DSH 系统界面的一部分，跟随系统语言。 --- ## 目录结构 ```text dsh-chat-embed/ ├── slot**：`main`（中央聊天页）、`sidebar.panellist`（左栏图标）、`sidebar.right.pane.tab`（右栏 tab body）、`sidebar.right.pane.tab.title`（右栏 chip 标题）、`conversation.session.header.utilities`（会话头「⧉」）。 2. **租约握手**：点标签 → `window.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspace)` → 拿到一次性 `lease` 与 `partition` → 建 ``。三个属性必须完全一致，否则壳在 `will-attach-webview` 拒绝。 3. **导航**：只能从 guest 文档内部导航（`executeJavaScript('location.href = …')`），`loadURL()` / 改 `src` 无效。 4. **内联席位**：聊天页渲染在席位布局盒里（`width/height:100%`），拖分隔条由浏览器布局，零 JS 测量；切标签只切 `display:none`，元素不移动。 5. **席位接管**：席位挂载即认领 guest；另一席位若仍挂载则显示移交卡片。宿主变化时丢弃旧 guest 并重建（Electron 无法搬移 webview），再用 `startUrlFor()` 回到上次会话地址。 6. **隔离**：每服务一个 workspace、一个分区、一个 guest、一条租约；一个标签失败不影响其它。 > 想看证据、契约细节与升级检查清单：**[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)**。 --- ## 开发 ```powershell # 获取最新代码（当前仓库未配置远程地址，按你实际的 remote 替换） git clone dsh-chat-embed cd dsh-chat-embed # 无需安装依赖；直接跑门禁与测试 npm run check # 语法 + 清单 + 显示资源 + 服务注册表 + 85 项测试（CI 同样会跑） npm test # 只跑测试 ``` **没有构建步骤**：`client.js` 就是最终产物。改完后重装一次让浏览器拿到新 generation： ```jsonc plugin_manager { "action": "remove_bundle", "target": "dsh-chat-embed" } plugin_manager { "action": "install_bundle", "target": "<本仓库克隆路径>" } ``` scripts/release.mjs 0.6.7 --summary "这次改了什么" node scripts/release.mjs 0.6.7 --summary "..." --dry-run # 只看计划 ``` 发版细节、CI 与 dependabot、插件列表投稿：见 **[docs/publishing.md](docs/publishing.md)**。 --- ## 已知限制 1. **跨重启登录需要壳补丁**：壳默认给内存分区（`dsh-sidebar-browser-`，无 `persist:`，每次启动随机），登录态不落盘。`tools/shell-patch/` 可修；客户端升级会覆盖 `app.asar`，需要重打——菜单里的「检查补丁配置」会告诉你现在是哪种情况、命令是什么。 2. **左右互斥**：右栏聊天依赖会话视图；中央打开聊天面板时右栏不可用。同一时刻只有一处显示聊天页，切换会重建一次（自动回到上次会话，不用重新登录）。 3. **中心面板会被切走**：选另一个主面板时中央聊天页随 DOM 卸载，回来要重建；右栏 tab 带 `keepMounted`，切标签/切会话不卸载。 4. **内存**：每点亮一个标签 = 一个渲染进程；7 个全开会明显吃内存。 5. **Google / Apple 登录无法在内嵌面板完成**：GSI 依赖 `window.opener` 交回凭据，面板无弹窗上下文；插件识别死路后自动退回入口并提示用邮箱登录。 6. **人机校验**：ChatGPT 首次打开可能要求过一次。 7. **仅 Electron**：无 Tauri / 第三方壳适配；Web GUI 降级为说明卡片。 8. 聊天页宽度依赖席位布局盒（`.dce-inline` 100%）；若 dsh 改掉主面板 / tab body 结构需复核。 --- ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 处理 | | --- | --- | | 侧栏没有「聊天」图标 | 插件未启用 / 未加载：看 **设置 → 插件**，或重装一次 | | 左栏入口打开是空白/卡片 | 确认右栏聊天是否开着（互斥）；看「⚙ → 标签页诊断… → 席位 evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-pighub

**PigHub（猪猪库）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：**在侧边栏养一个猪圈。每天领一只猪猪，重复的升星，攒够了把猪拖到桌面上遛。

猪猪素材来自 [PigHub](https://pighub.top) 与它的开源镜像，但**每个版本都冻结一次**：本版本用哪几只猪、每只是「死猪」还是「活猪」、怎么裁、怎么去白底，全部写在 `assets/manifest.json` 里。插件不打包图片字节，只用冻结下来的判定与参数。

## 它长什么样

- **侧边栏入口**：一只朝右看的小猪，与已有入口同尺寸、同描边。
- **猪圈面板**：左边带围栏的正方形猪圈；右上像素风标题（手写 5×7 位图字模），其下「今日猪猪」；再往下是可排序的猪猪清单。
- **设置按钮**在面板整体右上角：星级显示三档（关闭 / 默认 / 常驻）、素材库版本与来源、下一版候选池、数据目录。
- **每日一只**：一天抽一次，池子是本版本冻结库；重复获得同一只升一星，分别记录「首次获得」与「最近升星」。
- **抽取动画**：从你按下的按钮弹出（缩放回弹 + 火花），再旋转着飞进猪圈，**落点就是这只猪真实的落点**（不是估算，见「验证」里的 landGap）。
- **死猪 / 活猪**：判定为死猪的**完全静止**，只能由用户拖动；活猪会自己游走、偶尔发呆，点一下有弹性回弹。
- **桌宠**：把猪拖出猪圈即成为置顶桌宠，可拖动；活猪会自己溜达（约三成落脚点落回猪圈），双击回圈。哪些猪在猪圈外，记录在 `state.json` 的 `pets` 里，清单上会标「桌宠」。

## 素材：冻结、逐图判定、定制切分

```text
assets/sources.json     候选池（从公开目录里挑出来的候选）
assets/judgements.json  逐图判定：kind(live/dead) + 裁切框 + 去白阈值 + 判定理由
assets/manifest.json    冻结产物：上面两张 + 每张源图的 sha256/bytes + assetVersion
```

构建：`npm run assets:build`。它有两条硬约束：**候选池里每一张都必须有判定**（少一条或多一条都直接失败），**每一张都必须有理由**。所以「逐图判定」是构建的前置条件，不是口号。

同一套流程里还有**矢量图化**：判定为平涂卡通的图会被描摹成自包含 SVG（量化 → 等值线 → 简化 → 路径），以 `data:image/svg+xml` 渲染，**放大不模糊**；场景/照片类整图保留位图，因为描出来只会更脏。是否描摹同样逐图记录在判定表里。

去白底在浏览器里做：Host 半开一条同源代理 `GET /pighub/image?src=...`（白名单主机、限大小、不落盘），前端拿到字节后用 canvas 漫水填充把「与边框连通的白」抠成透明。走同源代理的原因很具体——**上游图片不带 CORS 头**，直接读像素会把 canvas 标成 tainted。裁切框与阈值逐图不同，所以同一张源图在任何机器上切出同一个结果。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-pighub
```

装完重启 DSH：Host 半负责数据与抽取，浏览器半在启动时进图。

## 数据放在哪

所有本地数据都在用户主目录的 `/.PigHub/：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `state.json` | 拥有哪些猪（含活/死判定与切分参数）、星级、首次获得与最近升星、每日抽取记录、**桌宠列表** |
| `catalog.json` | 下一版候选池的目录缓存（只有 id/标题/文件名/URL） |
| `prefs.json` | 排序偏好与星级显示档位 |

状态文件损坏时不会静默覆盖：原文改名为 `state.json.corrupt-<时间戳>` 留着，插件退回空状态继续可用。

## 结构

```text
dsh-pighub/
├── lib/index.js             Host 半：读盘、POST /pighub、GET /pighub/image、pighub_about
├── lib/store.js             抽取 / 升星 / 排序 / 原子写盘
├── lib/assets.js            冻结库读取（抽猪池只认它）
├── lib/client.js            浏览器半：closure-factory bundle，注册三个槽位
├── assets/                  冻结素材库（候选 / 判定 / 产物）
├── scripts/build-assets.mjs 冻结库构建（逐图判定校验）
├── test/                    离线测试 + test/demo 版面验证台
└── .github/workflows/       pack → OIDC 发布
```

浏览器半只用官方增量槽位：`sidebar.panellist`（入口）、`main`（面板，key 与入口 id 相同）、`shell.overlay`（页面级桌宠层）。

## 与其他桌宠插件共存

插件市场上的桌宠（例如 [dsh-pet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pet)）都是页面级浮层，所以按同一套既有约定来：容器 `pointer-events: none`、自有 z-index 层、样式标签与类名全带 `dsh-pighub` / `.pighub-` 前缀、尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

## 验证

```sh
npm test                  # 四份离线测试共 57 项断言
npm run demo:build        # 从冻结库生成版面验证台
```

界面验证台 `test/demo/pighub-demo.html` 按宿主契约把 `lib/client.js` 挂到普通页面上，并埋两个探针，读数写进 `<title>`：

- **alpha 探针**：把渲染出来的图重画到 canvas 上逐像素读四角 alpha，证明白底真的被抠掉；
- **motion 探针**：记录 4.2 秒前后的落脚点，分别统计活猪/死猪/桌宠移动了多少只；
- **reveal 探针**：自动点一次「今日猪猪」，采样动画阶段，并解析飞行目标的最终中心与猪的 DOM 中心作差（当前基线 **landGapPx = 0**）。

```sh
msedge --headless=new --disable-gpu --virtual-time-budget=16000 \
  --dump-dom "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/test/demo/pighub-demo.html"
```

## 发布

走 **GitHub Actions + npm Trusted Publishing**，仓库里不放长期 token：`pack` job 无凭据校验 tag 与版本并跑全部测试，`publish` job 消费同一份 tarball，用 OIDC 换短期凭据发布并生成 provenance。npm 后台三项匹配（仓库 / `publish.yml` / `npm-publish`）任一不符都会被拒。

## 许可

- **本插件代码**：MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。
- **上游 PigHub 素材**：未声明数据许可。本包**不含图片字节**，只含判定与参数；图片由用户浏览器按冻结 URL 直取。若上游给出许可条款，以它为准。

版本变化见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-sub-limits

Shows subscription quota usage in the sidebar footer, directly above Settings: native DSH accounts read through the running `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` controller and, when a key is available, the OpenCode Go plan.

## What it shows

- **Native DSH accounts.** The host reads provider-metered quotas from the running `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` controller through its authenticated local API, without invoking OMP, reading OMP accounts, or creating a second authentication controller.
- **OpenCode Go.** The host reads the subscription directly from its own gateway with the `OPENCODE_API_KEY` credential, resolved through the credentials service with the process environment as a fallback.
- **Independent pools.** Antigravity Gemini and Claude/GPT pools stay separate, and each account is its own row. Daily windows are labeled `24H`, not `5H`.
- **Known gaps stay visible.** Unavailable or unreported quota is shown as a dash, never as unlimited or zero usage. OpenRouter has no account-quota family in the native controller, so a configured OpenRouter provider is explicitly shown as unsupported/unknown instead of importing a balance from OMP. Ollama accounts whose native usage endpoint supplies no usable quota windows are similarly unknown.

## HTTP endpoint

`GET /api/sub-limits/providers` serves the normalized snapshot; `?refresh=1` forces a native refresh for every supported account. `GET` and `HEAD` only (`405` otherwise).

The route is registered on `ctx.webServer` and gated by `ctx.connection.requestRejection(req)`; a missing `connection` service fails closed with `503`. A failed native read answers `200` with `ok: false` and `code: "NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE"`, keeping the previous snapshot marked stale, so the browser keeps its previous data. `502` with a null timestamp and an empty report list is returned only on an unexpected handler error.

Sanitized snapshots, without credentials or raw provider errors, are atomically stored in `$DSH_HOME/sub-limits-provider-usage.json` with private file permissions.

## Refresh, stale data and last-good values

The browser polls once a minute and concurrent reads share a request. Automatic polling refreshes supported native account quotas once their successful reading is at least a minute old, or when it is missing or not ready. `?refresh=1` refreshes every supported account regardless of age. The loopback destination is pinned to the actual server port, forwards only the current authenticated request's cookie, and refuses redirects.

Account failures retain the last good values and their successful-update time, marked stale; a bridge failure retains the whole previous snapshot. A successful account enumeration removes logged-out accounts. Quotas older than five minutes are also marked stale. A reset timestamp in the past marks that window stale — the adapter never invents a new zero-usage window. Native USD allowances with no declared duration remain period-unknown rather than being fabricated into a 5H or monthly limit; their used/limit amounts and purchased USD currency are preserved in the details.

## UI

The browser half registers into `sidebar.footer.action`. The compact rail shows the highest consumed percentage for the selected period and expands into account rows with per-window percentages, reset countdowns, balances where supplied natively, stale warnings, check times, and refresh controls. It defaults to `5H` and remembers the selected `5H`, `7D`, or `All` filter in the browser. `All` selects the highest consumed percentage across reported periods; stale readings remain available in details but do not outrank current readings in the summary. A missing 5H reading stays unknown rather than silently substituting a weekly percentage. Percentages accept only finite numbers or nonblank numeric strings. Colours come from the host tokens, and percentages are announced through a polite live region.

OpenCode Go supplies rolling five-hour, weekly and monthly spend meters in micro-cents from `GET https://opencode.ai/console/api/go/status`, with `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` as the percent-and-reset fallback for keys the console route rejects. A rejected key and no stored key are different: the first stays visible as unknown, the second shows no row at all. A failed read keeps the preceding percentages marked stale, and the key itself is never written to the snapshot.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/root/DSH/dsh-sub-limits
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Native account quotas require `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` in the same profile; without a stored `OPENCODE_API_KEY`, the OpenCode Go row is simply absent.

# session-title-template

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Catalog](../../README.md)

A configurable `[date][type] topic` title provider for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Dates come from session creation timestamps; the type vocabulary, template, time zone and prompt language are configurable. Two current-session tools support explicit rename and regeneration.

## Install

Requires Node.js 22+. Tested against the installed DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.2-rc.1` and `0.2.2-rc.2` services; declared compatibility is `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.6.0`.

The package is `@redheartsecretman/session-title-template`, version `0.1.2`. Install the [Release archive](https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins/releases/download/session-title-template-v0.1.2/session-title-template-0.1.2.tgz) through the plugin manager (`install_bundle`) or the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins/releases/download/session-title-template-v0.1.2/session-title-template-0.1.2.tgz
```

To install from a checkout instead:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugins/plugins/session-title-template
```

Use `<clone>/plugins/session-title-template` as the plugin manager's target, not the repository root.

The bundle disables the shipped `session-title-llm`. Disable other title providers too: the service accepts one provider. Follow the Host's application outcome; a restart-required result means fully quit and reopen Desktop.

## Configure

Override `id: session-title-template` in your profile's user patch. The whole `config` object is replaced, not recursively merged; omitted fields use plugin defaults. Do not insert another provider merely to change its settings.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `template` | `[{date}][{type}] {topic}` | Each placeholder exactly once; order and literal separators are configurable |
| `dateFormat` | `MMDD` | Complete `YYYY`, `YY`, `MM`, `DD` tokens and `- / . _` separators; month/day required |
| `timezone` | `Asia/Shanghai` | IANA zone for the creation timestamp |
| `language` | `zh` | `zh` or `en`; selects prompt language, not translated type labels |
| `types` | Nine Chinese types | Array of strings or `{ key, hint, provisional? }` objects |
| `fallbackType` | `探索` | Local fallback type when no route is available; must exist in the vocabulary |
| `cjkSpacing` | `true` | Space between Han text and adjacent Latin letters/digits |
| `topicMinChars` | `8` | Prompt guidance; a useful short topic is not rejected just to reach this target |
| `topicMaxChars` | `18` | Unicode code-point limit for the topic |
| `provider` / `model` | unset | Supply both or neither; otherwise use the session route |
| `maxInputBytes` | `4096` | Final framed JSON UTF-8 byte budget, including escaping and wrapper text |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `4096` | Output cap; uses the lowest supported reasoning effort; the cap includes hidden reasoning, while topic length is validated separately |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Deadline for one candidate-route attempt |
| `maxProvisionalRefinements` | `4` | For summarized provisional titles, refine within the first N eligible messages; **not a rewrite counter**. Recognizable fallbacks remain retryable |
| `agentsInstructions.enabled` | `true` | Read applicable AGENTS naming excerpts and add main-agent naming coordination; `false` disables both |
| `agentsInstructions.maxBytes` | `4096` | Final supplemental guidance UTF-8 byte limit; integer from `256` to `65536` |
| `backfill.enabled` | `false` | Run one historical maintenance pass after startup |
| `backfill.fallbackRoute` | unset | `{ provider, model }`; also the backup for ordinary title requests |
| `backfill.retitle` | `[]` | Targets `[{ id, hint }]`, executed only while backfill is enabled |

Unknown keys produce an activation error rather than silently discarding settings.

```yaml
- id: session-title-template
  config:
    template: '[{date}] {type}: {topic}'
    dateFormat: YYYY-MM-DD
    language: en
    cjkSpacing: false
    types:
      - { key: feat, hint: New capability }
      - { key: fix, hint: Bug fixes }
      - { key: explore, hint: Understanding current behaviour, provisional: true }
    fallbackType: explore
```

The default Chinese vocabulary is 功能, 设计, 修复, 优化, 发布, 运维, 探索, 文档, 研究. `探索` is provisional. A canonical concrete title with the correct creation date is retained while the adaptive policy sees no reason to evaluate; summarized provisional titles refine when new substantive input arrives. Deterministic first-message fallbacks, including legacy provider-labelled fallbacks and Host-truncated fallbacks without model provenance, remain retryable. Retaining a title preserves its model provenance. Model output is leniently normalized, but stored titles require canonical syntax and the correct date, so malformed legacy dates are not frozen as settled.

## Automatic refresh

The provider follows the conversation automatically, but does not spend one model call per prompt. A cheap local policy decides whether a title evaluation is worthwhile:

- Always evaluate: explicit refresh/targeted retitle, a fallback/recovery title, a non-canonical title, the first provider title, or a provisional title with new substantive input.
- Evaluate on explicit topic-shift phrases, a substantive message with low lexical overlap against the current title and recent messages, and a periodic audit after six human messages or roughly 1,500 new UTF-8 bytes.
- Skip short acknowledgements and continuation messages; the same evaluated messages are not evaluated again.

When the model is called, the current title travels as a JSON anchor with explicit stability rules: a still-accurate title must be returned exactly unchanged, and only a materially changed main task justifies a rewrite. Returning the same title preserves its original provenance instead of creating a rewrite. The template, creation date, type vocabulary, length limits and explicit tools remain unchanged.

## AGENTS naming guidance

The plugin remains the automatic naming owner. When a title needs generation or provisional refinement, it reads naming excerpts from applicable `AGENTS.md` and `AGENTS.local.md` files. It lazily loads the public discovery helper from the in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions` SDK, declared as an optional peer so the real profile resolver can find it for external linked installations; no second Harness is installed. The helper discovers global `AGENTS.md` files under `DSH_HOME`, then `DSH_AGENTS_HOME`, followed by project files in its default `.git` root-to-current-working-directory scope. Other instruction filenames are not read. Discovery uses host-visible paths and the SDK's default baseline chain; it does not mirror a remote filesystem provider or additional deeper scopes discovered by the main agent's file operations.

A heading matches when it combines 会话 or 对话 with 命名 or 标题, or session or conversation with naming or title. Matching is case-insensitive for English, and headings inside fenced code blocks are ignored. For an explicit excerpt, put the intended naming guidance between these markers:

```markdown
<!-- session-title-template:start -->
Prefer a concise topic describing the user's current task.
<!-- session-title-template:end -->
```

Only matching naming excerpts enter the supplemental prompt; unrelated engineering instructions are left out. `agentsInstructions.maxBytes` bounds the final supplemental UTF-8 text, with more-specific excerpts retained preferentially. Source reads are bounded and discovery has a soft timeout. Missing rules, SDK/read failures or the timeout preserve existing naming behavior. Files are reread when generation needs them, with no filesystem cache or continuous watcher. Changing a file alone does not regenerate an existing canonical settled provider title.

AGENTS guidance may influence topic wording and provisional refinement. The configured template, creation date, type vocabulary, topic length limits and user-title pin remain authoritative. A `systemPrompt` coordination section asks the main agent to leave automatic naming to the plugin when only standing AGENTS rules request a rename; an explicit user rename should call `rename_current_session` rather than hand the task back to the GUI. This section is guidance, not a rename API restriction, and deployments that replace the complete system prompt may omit it. Set `agentsInstructions.enabled: false` to disable both the supplemental excerpts and coordination. The plugin never edits AGENTS files.

## Model errors and ownership

The provider handles `text-delta`, completed `block-end` text and terminal `finish` events. Only a normal `stop` result can be accepted. Error, cancellation, truncation and tool-call partial output never become titles. Failed calls or parsing try a distinct backup route, then reject so Harness retains the current title or its built-in fallback. With no available route, a local title can be derived from the first message.

Harness suppresses automatic updates to user-pinned titles. An **explicit UI refresh** intentionally unpins them. Backfill always skips user titles, even a configured retitle target. Auxiliary calls use the built-in `session/title-llm-request` record; diagnostic files do not contain title, prompt or raw model text.

## Explicit current-session tools

When the Host tools service is available, the plugin registers two tools globally across agent presets. Disabling AGENTS guidance does not remove them. Both keep the default exclusive scheduling and normal Harness execution policy.

- `rename_current_session({ title })` calls the official title service, cancels in-flight generation and pins the accepted title.
- `refresh_current_session_title({})` explicitly bypasses automatic stability and regenerates through `sessionTitle.refresh()`, deliberately unpinning a user title.

Targets come only from `execution.agent.session`; no session id is accepted. Missing/stale agents and extra fields are rejected. Success requires flush and read-back. If persistence fails, the error explains that memory may already have changed; retrying the same pinned title avoids duplicate rename events.

The tested Harness provider request carries no automatic/explicit trigger. The plugin does not guess from event order or words in user messages. **Use `refresh_current_session_title` for a forced regeneration**: native GUI refresh can still retain an already summarized title under the automatic stability policy. Initial/fallback recovery is unaffected. A future SDK trigger discriminator can enable direct GUI-refresh support.

Follow the Host reload outcome after upgrading; restart when required. Installing or editing the package does not prove an existing session has the new tools.

## Backfill and state

Backfill is off by default. When enabled, it starts once after 2.5 seconds. `sessionQuery.readSession` performs read-only eligibility checks before resuming anything. It skips subagents, pinned titles, canonical titles, interrupted historical turns and currently running agents. Targeted retitles can rewrite canonical provider titles, once per exact id/hint.

A candidate's title must be accepted and acknowledged by `sessions.flush()` before completion is recorded. Failures remain retryable. Only handles created by the pass are disposed. Plugin unload cancels its timer and aborts/drains running maintenance; ordinary prompts never repeatedly force a configured retitle hint.

With `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` set:

```text
$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/state/session-title-template/backfill-state.json
$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/state/session-title-template/backfill.log
```

Otherwise use `$DSH_HOME/profiles/$DSH_PROFILE/state/session-title-template/`, or the legacy `$DSH_HOME/session-title-template/` only when there is no profile. `DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`.

Exclusive locks, atomic replacement and recoverable queues protect bookkeeping across activations/processes. Corrupt state is surfaced and preserved. Lock waits are bounded; locks are never stolen. After an abnormal process exit, remove a leftover `.lock` only after confirming that no writer is active. Diagnostic logs rotate at 512 KiB with one bounded backup; logging failures do not change title/bookkeeping success.

## Development

No dependencies to install or build step. The optional AGENTS feature uses the public SDK helper shipped with Harness:

```sh
cd plugins/session-title-template
npm test
npm run check
```

Tests use isolated temporary directories, including AGENTS discovery/extraction and byte limits, config validation, naming coordination, multi-process state updates, flush failure, read-only backfill preflight and unload cancellation. `scripts/verify-runtime.mjs <runtime-root>` additionally checks the installed SessionStore, projections, title service and Cordis lifecycle; ASAR installs require Electron's Node carrier. It uses the real profile linked-peer resolver, tool registry and title service. The LLM and disk durability listener are fixtures: this does not test external model availability or production-writer restart recovery. For a real-model smoke test, `test/verify-gateway.mjs` is opt-in via `RUN_SESSION_TITLE_LIVE=1` and a gateway/model:

```sh
RUN_SESSION_TITLE_LIVE=1 SESSION_TITLE_GATEWAY=http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1 SESSION_TITLE_MODEL=auto/deepseek-flash MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY=... \
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 '/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness' test/verify-gateway.mjs
```

See [validation and behavior boundaries](docs/VALIDATION.md) for checked contracts and limits.

# dsh-plugins

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Each one is an installable bundle that lives in its own directory under [`plugins/`](plugins/) and works independently of the others.

## Catalog

| Plugin | What it does | Install path |
|---|---|---|
| [session-title-template](plugins/session-title-template/) | Template-shaped session titles with a preset type vocabulary, CJK spacing, optional AGENTS naming guidance and backfill, plus rename/refresh tools. | `plugins/session-title-template` |
| [session-video-intake](plugins/session-video-intake/) | Handles video input per model capability: native `video_url` when supported, a scene-aware storyboard fallback for image-only models, and an explicit failure otherwise. No extra provider. | `plugins/session-video-intake` |

## Install a plugin

Every plugin here is a DSH **bundle**: its `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it once applies to the whole profile and survives restarts.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins.git
```

Then, in DeepSeek Harness, use `plugin_manager` with the `install_bundle` action and the absolute path of the plugin's directory as `target`:

```
<clone>/plugins/session-title-template
<clone>/plugins/session-video-intake
```

Pass the plugin directory, not the repository root: the root is a catalog, and has no bundle of its own.

Read each plugin's own README before installing. Some of them change or disable a shipped default, and say so at the top.

## Layout

```
dsh-plugins/
├─ plugins/
│  ├─ session-title-template/     one self-contained bundle
│  │  ├─ package.json            name, exports, dsh.bundle.patch, icon
│  │  ├─ cordis.patch.yml        the loader patch this bundle applies
│  │  ├─ index.js                Host plugin entry
│  │  ├─ lib/                    plugin modules (Node builtins or public SDK helpers)
│  │  ├─ locale/                 plugin-manager title and description
│  │  ├─ test/                   node:test suites
│  │  └─ README.md               behaviour, configuration, caveats
│  └─ session-video-intake/       another self-contained bundle
├─ .github/workflows/           plugin checks, automated releases and repository checks
├─ tools/status.mjs             which plugin changed since its last release
├─ tools/check-links.mjs        relative Markdown link and anchor checker
├─ tools/check-versions.mjs     release URL / version consistency checker
├─ docs/RELEASING.md             the independent per-plugin release process
├─ README.md
└─ LICENSE
```

Each plugin directory is self-contained: no shared runtime code and no build step; the repository-level helpers are `tools/status.mjs`, `tools/check-links.mjs` and `tools/check-versions.mjs`. Copying one directory out of this repository gives you a working plugin, which is why a plugin can be published to npm or cloned on its own without dragging the catalog along.

## Adding a plugin

Create `plugins/<name>/` with its own `package.json` carrying `dsh.bundle.patch`, a `cordis.patch.yml`, an entry module, `locale/` metadata, and a README. Add a `.github/workflows/<name>.yml` caller that uses the reusable `plugin-checks.yml` workflow with `plugin: <name>`. Then add a row to the catalog table above. There is no registry file to update and no root manifest to edit: the repository root stays a catalog, so a new plugin cannot break an existing one.

## Releasing

Each plugin is versioned and released independently, under its own `<plugin>-v<version>` tag. Run `node tools/status.mjs` to see which plugin changed since its last tag; only that plugin needs a version bump and a release. The full process is in [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md).

## License

MIT, per plugin. See each plugin's `LICENSE` reference in its own directory; the repository-level [LICENSE](LICENSE) covers the catalog itself.

# session-video-intake

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Catalog](../../README.md)

The plugin decides how to hand a video to the model you already selected:

| Selected route | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Supports native video | The original video is sent as `video_url` |
| Supports images only | A storyboard image plus a time manifest is sent |
| Supports neither | The request fails before it is sent |

The plugin registers no provider and never replaces the route you chose.

Deciding "native video" needs extra information: DSH model metadata only has `text` / `image`, no `video`. The plugin therefore checks the explicit `videoRoutes` whitelist first. When that is unset, it reads the provider's model listing and looks for a `video` declaration on the current model. If neither source answers, the video takes the image path.

## Install

Requires Node.js 22+. The storyboard fallback needs a capable FFmpeg/FFprobe; an existing capable build is reused, and a pinned LGPL managed pair is downloaded only when the capability probe rejects every local candidate. Verified against the installed DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, `0.2.2-rc.1` and `0.2.2-rc.2`; declared compatibility is `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.6.0`.

The package is `@redheartsecretman/session-video-intake`, version `0.1.2`. Install the [Release archive](https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins/releases/download/session-video-intake-v0.1.2/session-video-intake-0.1.2.tgz) through the plugin manager (`install_bundle`) or the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins/releases/download/session-video-intake-v0.1.2/session-video-intake-0.1.2.tgz
```

The package ships a `postinstall` hook that resolves FFmpeg and downloads the managed pair only when no local build qualifies. Package managers that gate install scripts skip it: pnpm reports `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` and exits non-zero while still installing the package. Installing the package without running that hook is fine — the first storyboard repeats the same resolution — so approve it only if you want the download to happen at install time.

To install from a checkout instead:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugins/plugins/session-video-intake
```

Use `<clone>/plugins/session-video-intake` as the plugin manager's target, not the repository root. Follow the Host's reload outcome: a restart-required result means fully quit and reopen Desktop.

## Configure

Override `id: session-video-intake` in your profile's user patch. The whole `config` object is replaced, not recursively merged; omitted fields use plugin defaults, and unknown keys are activation errors rather than silently ignored settings.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` disables host-side capability checks and payload rewriting; the composer intake still loads and video files follow normal DSH file handling |
| `videoRoutes` | unset | Explicit `provider/model` whitelist for native `video_url`. Unset means "discover from the model listing"; `[]` disables native video entirely. Model ids may contain `/` |
| `catalogProbe.enabled` | `true` | Discovery used only while `videoRoutes` is unset |
| `catalogProbe.timeoutMs` | `2500` | Deadline for one listing request (`200`–`10000`) |
| `catalogProbe.ttlMs` | `300000` | How long a discovery answer is cached (`10000`–`3600000`) |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `32768` | Output cap applied to video-bearing requests; other requests are untouched |
| `maxVideoBytes` | `67108864` | Per-video byte limit enforced before reading the attachment |
| `maxTotalVideoBytes` | `67108864` | Per-request aggregate limit for native video payloads |
| `maxVideos` | `8` | Per-request video count limit |
| `storyboard.enabled` | `true` | `false` makes image-only routes fail instead of building a storyboard |
| `storyboard.sceneAware` | `true` | Detect scene cuts and distribute cells over content segments; `false` uses equal intervals |
| `storyboard.cells` | `9` | Maximum grid cells (`4`–`16`); short videos use at least 4 |
| `storyboard.cellEdge` | `256` | Width of one cell in pixels (`64`–`1024`) |
| `storyboard.timeoutMs` | `120000` | Deadline for one FFprobe/FFmpeg invocation |
| `storyboard.ffmpegPath` / `ffprobePath` | auto-detected | Explicit paths are authoritative. Otherwise probe `SESSION_VIDEO_FFMPEG`, `$DSH_HOME/tools/ffmpeg/bin`, profile/Homebrew/PATH; only if none can compose a storyboard, download the pinned LGPL managed pair |

Pin a route explicitly when you know it accepts `video_url`, or disable native video for a predictable all-storyboard setup:

```yaml
- id: session-video-intake
  config:
    videoRoutes:
      - magpie/zhipu/glm-5.3-flash
    # or: videoRoutes: []
    storyboard:
      cells: 6
      cellEdge: 320
```

## FFmpeg selection

The plugin does not assume a specific FFmpeg build:

1. An explicit `storyboard.ffmpegPath` is used as-is; if it is not capable, the request fails with the tried path instead of silently switching.
2. Otherwise candidates are probed in order: `SESSION_VIDEO_FFMPEG`, `$DSH_HOME/tools/ffmpeg/bin`, the profile tools directory, Homebrew/`/usr/local/bin`, then bare `ffmpeg`.
3. A candidate is accepted only when ffprobe works and the build reports `image2`, `scale`, `tile` and `mjpeg`.
4. The first accepted candidate is used without downloading anything. `glob` is the primary **image-input mode** when the build supports it; an unsupported-glob error automatically retries the image2 sequence and caches that choice. These are two ways to read the same zero-padded frame files, not different storyboard algorithms: frame extraction, scene planning, cell times, grid layout and the tile filter are identical.
5. Only when no local candidate qualifies does the plugin download a pinned LGPL FFmpeg/ffprobe pair into `$DSH_HOME/tools/ffmpeg/managed/`. The download is best-effort at install time, retries on first storyboard use, and keeps the plugin installable offline. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Input sources

Video input is normalized before the model sees it:

| Source | Handling |
|---|---|
| Drop, paste, browser file picker | pathless `File` upload, then a durable video `file` block |
| Desktop `+` picker | stable structural selector forwards a pathless `File`; it no longer becomes an `@path` text reference |
| `@/absolute/path.mp4` / Windows path / UNC | host reads the file, stores it as a durable attachment and replaces the reference token |
| `file://` local URI | same materialization path as `@` |
| Bare HTTP(S) URL with a supported extension | captured and sent as native video or a storyboard |
| Direct video `file` block | captured by extension or `video/*` media type |

Supported default containers include MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, M4V, AVI, TS/MTS/M2TS, FLV, 3GP and OGV. A video-looking reference that cannot be materialized fails as `VIDEO_UNSUPPORTED_INPUT`; it is never silently treated as ordinary text.

## How it works

```text
video message
  ↓
client intake: a File without a host path becomes a durable DSH attachment
  ↓
agent/request: resolve the current provider/model capability; fail here if it has neither
  ↓
llm/stream: capture the original FileBlock / bare URL before core's file projection
  ↓
the provider's onPayload:
  ├─ native video → replace the handle with video_url
  └─ image only   → build a storyboard, replace the handle with a manifest plus image parts
  ↓
streamed model reply
```

- [client.js](client.js) forwards the existing composer's drop, paste and file-picker events; it clones video `File` objects to strip Electron's host path while keeping every byte and all metadata.
- [lib/capability.js](lib/capability.js) resolves `video` / `image` / `injectable` per provider/model and clears its cache when the adapter topology changes.
- [lib/catalog.js](lib/catalog.js) performs the fail-soft model-listing probe and caches its answers.
- [lib/router.js](lib/router.js) validates capability before `prepareCall()`; ordinary messages never touch the route.
- [lib/capture.js](lib/capture.js) records video blocks and bare URLs before core projects them to file handles.
- [lib/request-scope.js](lib/request-scope.js) binds that record to the current request stream.
- [lib/native-video.js](lib/native-video.js) turns verified attachment bytes into a `data:` URL.
- [lib/attachment.js](lib/attachment.js) owns byte-count and SHA-256 verification shared by native video and storyboards.
- [lib/rewrite-tokens.js](lib/rewrite-tokens.js) performs token replacement for either payload shape.
- [lib/payload.js](lib/payload.js) holds the payload shapes and provider hook; it chooses `video_url` or storyboard images. Both Chat Completions `messages` and Responses `input` shapes support storyboards and native video: Chat Completions uses `video_url` with an object, Responses uses `input_video` with a `video_url` string. A route that declares native video but is serialized as an unknown shape fails with `VIDEO_SDK_UNSUPPORTED` instead of silently storyboarding.
- [lib/storyboard.js](lib/storyboard.js) probes with FFprobe, samples cells with FFmpeg, tiles one PNG and writes a Chinese time manifest.
- [lib/failure.js](lib/failure.js) owns the plugin error prefix and codes; [lib/defaults.js](lib/defaults.js) is the single source of storyboard defaults.
- [lib/config.js](lib/config.js) validates the profile patch and resolves FFmpeg paths.

The original FileBlock is never rewritten. Storyboards enter only the current request and are not written to the session log. Later follow-up turns are re-projected because the durable attachments remain in the session.

## How a route is judged

The plugin answers two questions: can this route take native video, and can it take images?

1. **Images** come from the Host metadata: `inputModalities` contains `image`.
2. **Native video** cannot come from the Host. It comes from, in order:
   - an explicit `videoRoutes` entry — when configured, nothing else is probed;
   - otherwise the provider's model listing, where a `video` declaration on the current model counts as support.

| Situation | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `videoRoutes` matches the current route | Native `video_url` |
| `videoRoutes` does not match, or is `[]` | No probing; use the image path |
| `videoRoutes` unset, listing declares `video` | Native `video_url` |
| `videoRoutes` unset, no declaration or probe failed | Use the image path |
| Images are unsupported too | `VIDEO_UNSUPPORTED` |

One more requirement: the provider must expose the pi-ai profile structure the payload hook attaches to. Without it the plugin cannot inject video or storyboard parts, so it fails instead of sending a file handle as video content.

Only `VIDEO_UNSUPPORTED` is a capability outcome. Authentication, missing credentials, rate limits, transport errors, server errors, timeouts and cancellations propagate unchanged and never trigger a fallback.

## Catalog discovery

- Only the **model selected in the current session** matters. The plugin requests the provider's `{baseURL}/models` and reads only the entry whose `id` equals the current `model`. Other entries are ignored, and no model is ever switched.
- Only OpenAI-compatible routes with an `http(s)` `baseURL` are probed. Other protocols stay unknown and use the image path.
- Credentials come from the Host credentials service, then the environment variable named by the provider profile. A missing or rejected credential only makes the probe unknown; it never fails the turn.
- Answers are cached per `provider/model` for `catalogProbe.ttlMs`, including negative answers, and are dropped with the capability cache when the adapter topology changes.
- `modalities` is not part of the OpenAI standard. Plain OpenAI and vLLM listings usually omit it, so most routes stay on the storyboard path unless you add them to `videoRoutes`.
- A listing declaration describes the backend model, not proof that this exact route accepts `video_url`; use `videoRoutes` when it must be exact.

## Storyboard fallback

- FFprobe reads duration, dimensions and audio presence; an unusable duration fails with `VIDEO_STORYBOARD_PROBE_FAILED`.
- With `sceneAware` enabled, FFmpeg decodes 64×36 RGB frames at a low rate, an HSV per-channel difference produces per-frame scores, and a rate-based threshold turns them into cut candidates. Cut times become content segments, then merge/split until the cell budget is met; each cell samples its segment centre.
- A static video therefore uses four equal cells instead of repeating the same frame, and fast-cut footage gets shorter segments instead of one uniform interval.
- When scene detection reports fewer than two cuts, a static fallback uses four equal cells. When detection is disabled or unavailable, the duration-based equal intervals use `clamp(ceil(duration / 4), 4, cells)` cells.
- One PNG is returned; the manifest names the file, duration, grid and every cell's interval, and states that this is sampled rather than continuous video.
- A missing binary fails with `VIDEO_STORYBOARD_UNAVAILABLE`; execution failure uses `VIDEO_STORYBOARD_FAILED`; a disabled fallback on an image-only route fails with `VIDEO_STORYBOARD_DISABLED`. None of these silently degrades to text.
- Attachments are verified by byte count and SHA-256 before FFmpeg runs; a temporary directory is always removed, and cancelled or timed-out processes are terminated.

## Storyboard idea source

The storyboard approach follows [dsh-video-storyboard](https://github.com/SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard): downscaled HSV scene scanning, a rate-based cut threshold, segment-aware cell placement and one addressable contact sheet. This plugin is an independent, narrower implementation with no copied upstream code; see [NOTICE](NOTICE) for what was adopted and what was not.

## Scope and limits

- Storyboards are an approximation: scene detection is a heuristic, fast motion, flicker and continuous camera movement still lose detail, and audio is not transcribed.
- The sheet is always PNG. Bare HTTP(S) links are read by FFmpeg directly and are not persisted into the attachment store.
- Supported containers are MP4 and WebM. Local files are checked for container signature, byte count and SHA-256.
- Bare links must be HTTP(S) with a supported video path; Markdown links, code spans and quoted links remain ordinary text.
- Attaching to provider internals is deliberate: the profile keeps only its own routes. If a future SDK removes the pi-ai profile structure, the plugin fails clearly instead of guessing.
- The payload hook handles the two OpenAI-compatible shapes the installed adapters produce. Native video is written into Chat Completions `messages` as `video_url` or into Responses `input` as `input_video`; an unknown payload shape fails with `VIDEO_SDK_UNSUPPORTED` rather than degrading silently.

## Development

No dependencies to install and no build step:

```sh
cd plugins/session-video-intake
npm test
npm run check
```

`npm test` runs the configuration, catalog, scene planning, payload, routing, client and storyboard suites. Storyboard unit tests inject a fake runner for determinism and additionally exercise the real runner's stdout, stderr truncation, timeout and abort handling.

`scripts/verify-runtime.mjs` checks the installed Harness: an ASAR install needs Electron's Node carrier and FFmpeg, and reads fixtures through `VIDEO_FIXTURE_ROOT`:

```sh
VIDEO_FIXTURE_ROOT=/path/to/fixtures \
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 '/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness' scripts/verify-runtime.mjs
```

It covers the three route outcomes: native `video_url` with identical bytes, a real storyboard for an image-only route, and an explicit failure for a text-only route, and asserts that no second provider is registered. It pins routes explicitly, so the catalog probe is not exercised there; [test/catalog.test.js](test/catalog.test.js) covers discovery with an injected `fetch`.

`scripts/verify-gateway.mjs` is an opt-in live check and needs `RUN_SESSION_VIDEO_LIVE=1`, `SESSION_VIDEO_FIXTURE`, `SESSION_VIDEO_GATEWAY` and working credentials; `SESSION_VIDEO_API` selects `openai-completions` (default) or `openai-responses`:

```sh
RUN_SESSION_VIDEO_LIVE=1 SESSION_VIDEO_FIXTURE=/path/to/clip.mp4 \
SESSION_VIDEO_GATEWAY=http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1 SESSION_VIDEO_MODEL=zhipu/glm-5.3-flash MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY=... \
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 '/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness' scripts/verify-gateway.mjs
```

See [validation and behavior boundaries](docs/VALIDATION.md) for checked contracts and limits.

# dsh-plugins

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Each one is an installable bundle that lives in its own directory under [`plugins/`](plugins/) and works independently of the others.

## Catalog

| Plugin | What it does | Install path |
|---|---|---|
| [session-title-template](plugins/session-title-template/) | Template-shaped session titles with a preset type vocabulary, CJK spacing, optional AGENTS naming guidance and backfill, plus rename/refresh tools. | `plugins/session-title-template` |
| [session-video-intake](plugins/session-video-intake/) | Handles video input per model capability: native `video_url` when supported, a scene-aware storyboard fallback for image-only models, and an explicit failure otherwise. No extra provider. | `plugins/session-video-intake` |

## Install a plugin

Every plugin here is a DSH **bundle**: its `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it once applies to the whole profile and survives restarts.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RedHeartSecretMan/dsh-plugins.git
```

Then, in DeepSeek Harness, use `plugin_manager` with the `install_bundle` action and the absolute path of the plugin's directory as `target`:

```
<clone>/plugins/session-title-template
<clone>/plugins/session-video-intake
```

Pass the plugin directory, not the repository root: the root is a catalog, and has no bundle of its own.

Read each plugin's own README before installing. Some of them change or disable a shipped default, and say so at the top.

## Layout

```
dsh-plugins/
├─ plugins/
│  ├─ session-title-template/     one self-contained bundle
│  │  ├─ package.json            name, exports, dsh.bundle.patch, icon
│  │  ├─ cordis.patch.yml        the loader patch this bundle applies
│  │  ├─ index.js                Host plugin entry
│  │  ├─ lib/                    plugin modules (Node builtins or public SDK helpers)
│  │  ├─ locale/                 plugin-manager title and description
│  │  ├─ test/                   node:test suites
│  │  └─ README.md               behaviour, configuration, caveats
│  └─ session-video-intake/       another self-contained bundle
├─ .github/workflows/           plugin checks, automated releases and repository checks
├─ tools/status.mjs             which plugin changed since its last release
├─ tools/check-links.mjs        relative Markdown link and anchor checker
├─ tools/check-versions.mjs     release URL / version consistency checker
├─ docs/RELEASING.md             the independent per-plugin release process
├─ README.md
└─ LICENSE
```

Each plugin directory is self-contained: no shared runtime code and no build step; the repository-level helpers are `tools/status.mjs`, `tools/check-links.mjs` and `tools/check-versions.mjs`. Copying one directory out of this repository gives you a working plugin, which is why a plugin can be published to npm or cloned on its own without dragging the catalog along.

## Adding a plugin

Create `plugins/<name>/` with its own `package.json` carrying `dsh.bundle.patch`, a `cordis.patch.yml`, an entry module, `locale/` metadata, and a README. Add a `.github/workflows/<name>.yml` caller that uses the reusable `plugin-checks.yml` workflow with `plugin: <name>`. Then add a row to the catalog table above. There is no registry file to update and no root manifest to edit: the repository root stays a catalog, so a new plugin cannot break an existing one.

## Releasing

Each plugin is versioned and released independently, under its own `<plugin>-v<version>` tag. Run `node tools/status.mjs` to see which plugin changed since its last tag; only that plugin needs a version bump and a release. The full process is in [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md).

## License

MIT, per plugin. See each plugin's `LICENSE` reference in its own directory; the repository-level [LICENSE](LICENSE) covers the catalog itself.
