evidence.readmeExcerpt: # Envoy for DeepSeek Harness This package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle for [Envoy](../../../README.md). It does three things in one install: 1. mounts Envoy's stdio MCP bridge with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; 2. registers an adapted Envoy Agent Skill on the public `ctx.skills` service; 3. listens to the `agent/pre-step` event and, on the first step of a turn whose user message contains a public link, prepends one short routing message. The adaptation keeps Envoy's reading, discovery, expansion, visual handoff, and capability behavior. It changes only the integration surface: the skill uses the `mcp__envoy__*` tool names that DeepSeek Harness assigns to the mounted server. [中文快速安装](../README.md) · [Envoy 安装指南](../../skills/envoy/INSTALL.md) ## One link in, AI-ready material out Whatever you are looking at, hand it over and get the thing you wanted out: Markdown, a wiki page, a knowledge-base entry. Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, WeChat posts, articles, PDFs and podcasts all take the same path. A read returns a source-linked transcript with timestamps, frames, and a `material_id` you can quote, so the agent writes from what was actually said, not from the title. For a whole feed, `envoy collect` checkpoints every item, so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting. Measured on 123 live links across those platforms: **80% usable as source material** — that is 93% of the links that answered at all — with **0 failures** and every gap named. Same 60 turns per arm, with and without the bundle: **ends normally without saying it could not read 22% → 92%**, **times out 68% → 0**, **answer hits at least one reference-fact keyword 23% → 82%**. That A/B is exploratory (different caps, no human correctness review); the per-read behaviour is what the tests assert. The harness is in `docs/experiments/link-compatibility.md`; rerun it with `scripts/acceptance/link_coverage.py`. The same Envoy skill ships for Codex and Claude Code; this package is the DeepSeek Harness build, and the deliverables are the same Markdown, wiki, or knowledge-base material on all three hosts. ## What changes when it is installed Same model, same links. The difference is what a read puts in front of the agent. | Ask | Harness on its own | With this bundle | | --- | --- | --- | | Long article, WeChat post, Zhihu column | Truncated text, or only the digest | Body text with headings and source locators | | PDF | First pages, or a screenshot of the page | Per-page text with page numbers and locators | | Video (Douyin, Bilibili) | Title, cover, description, danmaku | Bound player file; captions or ASR with a coverage figure; frames when the host declares it can show them | | Audio | Nothing usable | Timestamped transcript; low confidence and no-speech are stated, not hidden | | Login wall | 403, empty body, or a captcha page | `challenge_required` plus the human step: import cookies for one site scope, or sign in once | | Unreadable page | A plausible guess | `partial` with the part that was read, and the gap named | The turn-level A/B we ran is exploratory, not a claim: the two arms had different time limits (900 s and 2400 s) and one arm was graded terminal-only. Article-level citation counts came out level within noise over 60 turns per arm. What this bundle guarantees is the per-read behaviour above, and the tests assert it. ## What stays the same without the bundle Reading a link without Envoy still works. What the bundle adds is not a new capability the model lacks, but a bounded one: declared visual input, a retained material you can search instead of re-fetching, an explicit gap when a source cannot be read, and a human step instead of an executable command when the page needs one. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness with the Plugin Manager (`engines.dsh` is `>=0.1.5`). - macOS, Linux, or Windows. # DSH plugin in @1agents/acp-service

Use persistent native Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build and other locally discovered ACP Agent sessions inside DeepSeek Harness. Choose native models and settings, use advertised commands, and answer tool permissions in DSH. The plugin is embedded with the runtime and service in the single public **`@1agents/acp-service`** package. This directory is its private source module.

The CI API baseline is **DSH 0.1.7-rc.2**, commit `21638c56315ae6a2b552d6091945d3144c9af32e`. Additional installed-package and interactive checks used an isolated profile on a locally modified DSH build labeled `0.2.0-rc.1`; see the [verification record](https://github.com/scottzx/agent-workflow/blob/main/docs/marketplaces/verification-2026-10-09.md) for the exact scope. Other DSH releases require checking their plugin and preset APIs.

The same host supports opt-in A2A 1.0 delegation, disabled by default: remote text messages create or restore DSH sessions, return task IDs, and continue execution independently of HTTP clients. Configure `a2a` on the existing plugin row, set the host's `DSH_A2A_TOKEN`, and choose its public origin, default cwd and preset. Query and subscribe through the official A2A interfaces; allowed webhook origins enable completion callbacks. Waking a caller's main Agent requires its receiving host adapter. See the [service README's DSH A2A section](https://github.com/scottzx/agent-workflow/blob/main/packages/service/README.md#dsh-a2a) for configuration, metadata and recovery behavior. The shared server is exported as `@1agents/acp-service/a2a` and remains independent of DSH imports.

## Install and start a session

Requires **Node.js 22.13+**, a working DSH installation, and each selected native Agent's CLI and authentication on the DSH host. Adapter-backed Agents require their ACP adapter as well; the native Codex CLI does not replace `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp`. Ensure these executables and credentials are available to the DSH process.

Install the one public package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @1agents/acp-service@^0.7.0
```

If pnpm pauses or fails with an ignored transitive `esbuild` build script, follow its prompt or configure that individual package's approval in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then repeat the install. Approve or deny it according to your policy. A successful isolated package smoke used `--ignore-scripts`; the interactive pnpm 11 profile check approved only `esbuild`. A partial install can leave the bundle disabled, so check the Plugins page afterward.

Restart DSH after updating packages, confirm **`@1agents/acp-service`** is enabled on its Plugins page, and choose a discovered **ACP · Agent** preset for a new session. Select an existing workspace, then send a text prompt. Replace `web` with your profile name, such as `desktop`; from a DSH source checkout, use `pnpm dsh` in place of `dsh`.

For a pinned fallback, install the identical npm artifact from [GitHub Release 0.6.0](https://github.com/scottzx/agent-workflow/releases/tag/acp-service-v0.6.0).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/scottzx/agent-workflow/releases/download/acp-service-v0.6.0/1agents-acp-service-0.6.0.tgz
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and its browser entry, so installation selects the bundle automatically.

The plugin starts its bundled ACP service on `127.0.0.1:36812` when no service is listening. An existing healthy ACP service is reused. Start DSH normally; no separate service command is needed. To manage the service yourself, set `serviceMode: external` and run:

```sh
npx --yes @1agents/acp-service@^0.7.0 serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 36812 --no-report
```

Installing the package alone starts no process; activating the plugin starts the service. For local development, install the built checkout with `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/agent-workflow/packages/service`.

ACP routes are not listed as ordinary DSH models, and the adapter rejects requests from ordinary presets, including previously saved ACP routes. Before the first turn, switching the Agent preset replaces the discovery connection and its native commands. Once a turn starts, the session keeps its remote Agent and workspace; start a new session to change Agent. Native Agent binaries and authentication belong to acp-service.

### Migrate an older installation

For an existing `@1agents/dsh-acp` installation, stop DSH, remove that bundle and add `@1agents/acp-service`. Keep existing binding files and copy any custom row configuration. The same plugin and preset IDs preserve session identity. Custom preset rows now load `@1agents/acp-service/dsh/preset`. Enable only the unified bundle.

## Session behavior

The bundle registers an ACP adapter through DSH's public streaming extension and routes the ACP presets to it. It sends newly admitted messages whose source is `user` to `session/prompt`, not to `subagent-acp`; there is no coordinating DeepSeek model call. DSH-generated workspace instructions and runtime-context messages are excluded. The external Agent owns its model, prompt, tools and native history, including any project instructions it discovers itself. DSH owns its UI and local user/assistant transcript. External tool progress is preserved as display metadata on empty text blocks in DSH's existing assistant stream records and projected onto collapsed groups of peer tool cards, separated by native prose and reasoning. ACP updates retain previously supplied fields, and replay is deduplicated by the managed turn sequence. These snapshots contain no visible text and never dispatch local tools; they use the existing persisted session format so conversations can reopen normally. Only Agent thought chunks enter the thinking stream.

## Continue imported native sessions

History import is optional. Install the separate history browser only when needed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @1agents/session-reader
```

With `@1agents/session-reader` installed, choose **在 DSH 中继续原会话** on a Claude, Codex or Grok history. The original workspace must still exist. The plugin restores the native session through acp-service's `_1agents/session/import`, creates DSH history under the matching ACP preset, and attaches it to that workspace. Importing sends no prompt. Subsequent messages go to the original Agent; imported messages are never resent, including an unfinished trailing user message. Unsupported sources stay readable in session-reader.

Imported bindings use `session/resume` because the service does not own a complete ACP replay of earlier native history. Existing ordinary ACP bindings continue using `session/load`. Endpoint, source provider and native ID identify an import; repeated admission reuses its DSH session without refreshing or replacing history. Old history-only DSH copies are not adopted. Original Agent history can continue changing outside DSH; the imported DSH history is a snapshot.

The service ID is saved before DSH creation. A failed local creation or workspace attachment can be retried after restart without importing again. When the original session reports `already has an active writer`, DSH still creates and opens its historical session. The composer is disabled with an explanation; capability refresh retries the original identity and restores input after its writer releases it. A pending import survives plugin restart. Other native restoration and authentication failures are reported, never replaced by a new empty session. If the transport is lost before the import response reaches the plugin, the plugin cannot know the service ID and does not automatically retry that RPC.

### Plugin service API

`ctx.oneagentsAcpSessions` is a Cordis service owned by this plugin; consumers may declare it optional so history browsing works without ACP. Its TypeScript declarations are exported from `@1agents/acp-service/dsh/imports`. Consumers call the service from the Host and must not instantiate it or write its binding files.

- `availability(provider)` returns `{ available, agent?, reason? }` without restoring a session. It checks configuration and the service inventory; successful native restoration remains the final capability/authentication check.
- `importSession({ provider, nativeSessionId, cwd, events })` accepts current DSH events starting at sequence zero. It returns `{ success: true, dshSessionId, workspace, workspaceId, agent, continuation: 'native', writable, blocked? }` after DSH creation and workspace attachment. An active native writer returns `writable: false, blocked: 'active-writer'` while leaving history available.

Provider mapping is `claude → claude`, `codex → codex`, `grok → grok-build`. The service validates history through DSH before restoring a new native binding. No DSH Session format changes are required.

## Native commands and configuration

Opening an ACP session initializes or restores its remote session without sending a prompt. The plugin consumes `available_commands_update`, `config_option_update`, and mode updates. Advertised slash commands with names accepted by DSH (`[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*`) are registered in that session and forwarded verbatim through `session/prompt`, including their arguments. `/model` opens the model options advertised by the remote Agent. Choosing a model or reasoning setting uses `session/set_config_option`; choosing a mode uses `session/set_mode`. Unsupported options are not invented. Configuration changes are rejected while a turn runs.

A successful choice in **ACP 设置** is remembered for that absolute workspace and that ACP agent. Grok Build and Codex keep separate records, each with the mode id and config-option ids that agent accepted. The file is `agent-session-settings.json` in `stateDirectory`, beside session bindings. A later new session replays only its own record before the first prompt: model options first, then the other options against each catalog returned by `session/set_config_option`, then the mode through `session/set_mode`. A missing id or value fails before the prompt and closes the new remote session. When the record includes a mode, that mode is used. An agent with no record still receives only `initialModeId`. A record with options and no mode still applies `initialModeId`. Continuing, loading, or importing an existing session keeps the settings already on that session. `initialModeId` and untouched session defaults are not written into the file. Choosing the same option again replaces that id. `execution_submit` does not carry these values.

The bundle disables the stock `ui-model-selection` row and supplies a session-aware model selector using DSH's existing UI slot and command contribution APIs. Ordinary sessions still select their DSH provider/model and reasoning effort; ACP sessions select only native Agent options. The Agent's additional options appear under **ACP 设置**. An idle ACP connection is retained so metadata updates and controls share the same session owner. The visible browser refreshes its capability snapshot every five seconds.

The bundle registers `oneagents-acp-*` presets with DSH's preset registry. Older filesystem presets remain untouched; DSH 0.1.7 uses registry declarations instead of scanning those files. ACP bindings are stored separately under `$DSH_HOME/plugins/1agents-acp/sessions`.

## Interactions and reconnection

ACP one-shot tool permissions use DSH's approval UI and policy. Grok questions and plan approval use its question UI. Persistent grants are not synthesized. Read operations follow acp-service's `approve-reads` policy; operations requiring permission are presented to the user.

When `a2a.workbench` is configured, DSH's own tool approvals inside an A2A task (for example a `danger-full-access` escalation from `tool-bash` under the `standard` preset) become `permission` process requests on the gateway workbench. The workbench is the only place to answer them, because DSH's approval UI keeps its prompt for the request's whole lifetime and could not withdraw it after a workbench answer. Approve grants that one call, reject denies it, and an expired or closed request cancels it. If the workbench cannot be reached, DSH's approval UI answers as before. Sessions outside A2A tasks, and ACP presets (which open their own request), are unaffected.

Transport reconnects load the same service session and replay the current managed turn. Stable request IDs prevent duplicate execution, and update sequence numbers suppress duplicate output. A browser refresh leaves the Host request running. Stopping a DSH turn sends ACP cancellation. Provider errors fail the turn without automatic resubmission.

The owned ACP Adapter sanitizes provider failures before the official DSH host normalizes them. Category, provider code, retryability, outcome uncertainty, origin and request identity are persisted in the plugin's `oneagents_acp_diagnostics` domain, using official `storageDomain` and JSON storage plugins. The plugin owns their lifetime so cancellation and A2A drain before storage closes. DSH source, native `LlmFailure` and Session event schemas stay unchanged; its ordinary logs can retain only code and message. Complete diagnostics appear under A2A `metadata['1agents'].error`, with the A2A caller's operation identity. Host error properties and arbitrary in-band metadata cannot supply missing diagnostics.

Each attempt is bound to its DSH session, turn/start sequence, step/start sequence, input message identities and native request identity. Only user messages admitted in the current turn establish association; each identity is at most 256 characters and each identity list at most 128 entries. Oversized identities fail before native delivery. Records contain only bounded safe fields, never provider text, credentials or authentication URLs. A newer pending attempt cannot borrow an older failure. The storage owner-token lease rejects concurrent writers and reclaims only demonstrably dead owners after restart. Invalid versions or records fail initialization without deleting evidence. Writes resolve after durability; a storage failure fails the call instead of acknowledging diagnostics that were not saved.

Confirmed remote cancellation reports `cancelled` with `outcomeUnknown: false`. A received terminal RPC reply establishes the outcome even when local cancellation races with its delivery; no further output is emitted after cancellation. A submitted request without a terminal reply remains uncertain, while work cancelled before delivery is certain. Claimed disposal without a result remains uncertain. Root teardown waits for the official Agent idle barrier if subscriptions disappear before the final event. Cancellation does not automatically resubmit, and a racing local abort does not replace a received provider error.

A2A startup reconciles interrupted tasks using their saved context and exact task/message request identity. A durable plugin failure restores its safe fields; an unfinished submitted attempt stays unknown. Reconciliation records a failed interrupted task and never dispatches execution. Already terminal tasks remain unchanged. Historical host logs without plugin diagnostics cannot reconstruct missing fields, and other DSH providers are not classified from host error text.

This plugin supports **text prompts**. Attachments and specialized external-tool cards are not implemented. Auxiliary DSH title/compaction calls cannot use this adapter; an advertised native compaction command runs in the external Agent. Existing standard-preset sessions that selected an old ACP route must choose a normal DSH model or start a new ACP-preset session.

## Configuration

The bundle's `oneagents-acp` row accepts `serviceUrl`, `serviceMode`, `serviceStartupTimeoutMs`, `serviceShutdownTimeoutMs`, `agents`, `stateDirectory`, `diagnosticsDirectory`, `reconnectAttempts` and `reconnectDelayMs`. Change it through the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, not the DSH repository. Use a new session after changing endpoint or workspace. When `agents` is omitted, plugin startup fetches `GET /agents` from acp-service and registers presets for entries with `chat_ready: true`, using their service-provided names. Discovery runs on the service host. Restart the plugin after installing or removing a harness. An explicit `agents` list bypasses discovery and preserves manual registry selection; `[]` registers no presets. Service startup, connection errors and invalid inventory responses fail plugin initialization instead of selecting fallback agents.

Explicitly authorized unattended work can declare `sessionPolicies`, with an exact absolute `cwd`, ACP registry `agent`, and optional `initialModeId`. A policy matches only that workspace and Agent; wildcards and duplicate scopes are rejected. New sessions select the advertised native mode before sending any prompt; an unavailable mode fails without prompting. A stored ACP 设置 record for the same workspace and Agent is applied on that new session, and its mode replaces `initialModeId`. Existing sessions keep their native mode and any ACP settings already selected or imported. `permissionMode` (`approve-reads`, `approve-all`, `deny-all`) may still appear in older configs and is ignored: the bridge does not apply that three-state shield. Mode and reasoning effort come from ACP 设置 (`session/set_mode`, `session/set_config_option`) or from the native session an import resumes. For example, an authorized Codex video workspace can use `initialModeId: "agent-full-access"` without changing the host's global model or other workspaces. Remove the declaration when the authorized batch ends; existing native sessions retain their own stored mode.

Diagnostic storage defaults to `stateDirectory/diagnostics`; `diagnosticsDirectory` selects a separate explicit location. Keep this directory with the A2A state when moving a host. Its version is independent of DSH Session formats. The plugin privately mounts official storage components; it does not require a shared host storage-domain configuration. Only one plugin instance may write the directory at a time. A second DSH process, such as desktop while web already holds the lock, starts instead of failing: A2A reads the owner's records and rejects mutations, and that follower's diagnostics stay in memory so a chat turn is not failed for lack of the lock. The follower does not mark the owner's in-flight tasks failed and does not release the owner's lock. Session binding files in `stateDirectory` are outside that lock.

### Local service lifecycle

`serviceMode` defaults to `auto`. Only plain HTTP root URLs on `127.0.0.1`, `localhost` or `[::1]` can start a process. Remote URLs, HTTPS and URLs with a path or credentials remain external connections. `external` disables process management for every address. Use a stable nonzero port: native session bindings include the endpoint.

Before spawning, the plugin validates `/health`. Connection refusal permits startup; HTTP errors, authentication failures, timeouts and another application occupying the port fail explicitly. Startup waits for the child to listen and pass its health check before discovering Agent presets. `serviceStartupTimeoutMs` defaults to 15000 for each startup/health phase; `serviceShutdownTimeoutMs` defaults to 5000 before forced process exit.

Plugin disposal closes ACP connections before shutting down its owned service and awaiting process exit. Concurrent plugin instances in the same DSH process share an owned service until the last instance disposes. An existing service is never stopped. A worker also exits if its DSH parent crashes or is killed. If the worker itself crashes, requests fail through the normal ACP connection errors; restart the plugin to start a replacement. A service shared by separate DSH processes should be managed externally so stopping its owning DSH instance does not interrupt the others.

The child inherits DSH's environment, including native Agent configuration and credentials, and uses the service's existing state directory (`ACP_STATE_DIR` or `~/.1agents/acpx-state`). It starts with node reporting disabled. The plugin neither downloads executables at startup nor launches native Agents until a session needs one.

## Development and removal

Install and build from the repository root:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm link:dsh /absolute/path/DSH
pnpm build
pnpm test:integration
```

The DSH checkout must already have its dependencies installed and declaration outputs built. Development type checking links its matching packages into `node_modules/@deepseek-ai`; generated JavaScript uses the Host's public packages and services. The `dsh-zod` dependency alias pins the record-schema dialect to Zod 4.4.3 for the tested official DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 API, independently of the service's Zod dependency. A different DSH version requires its own compile and lifecycle compatibility checks. Tests cover real-WebSocket streaming, permissions, questions, cancellation, reconnection and saved bindings.

For manual service debugging on this machine, start it from `../service` with:

```sh
CODEX_PATH=/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex \
npm_config_cache="$HOME/.dsh/plugins/1agents-acp/npm-cache" \
node dist/bin/acp-service.js serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 36812 --no-report
```

For automatic startup, set these environment variables on the DSH process instead. `CODEX_PATH` selects the installed app's newer Codex runtime; the global CLI on this machine rejects its configured `gpt-6-astra` model. The separate npm cache avoids a broken pre-existing npx cache. Neither setting changes the global Codex configuration.

Remove using `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @1agents/acp-service`, then restart DSH; removing the bundle also restores the stock model-selection row. The preset registrations are removed with the bundle. Keep binding files if sessions may be reattached later.

# agent-workflow — the agent task-flow engine

[agent-workflow 发布页](https://scottzx.github.io/agent-workflow/) · [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@1agents/acp-service) · [变更日志](CHANGELOG.md)

agent-workflow is the agent task-flow engine in 一芥天地 (DreamMate World), from 一芥智能. It creates and runs A2A tasks: register a resident role or a one-off host, submit the work, and keep the job, its attempts and its results on the execution ledger. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) hosts the sessions. Codex, Claude Code, Pi and Cursor are built-in ACP agents, together with the other agents this runtime already registers.

agent-workflow dispatches that work and accepts it. In the delivery flows in this repository, a stage's output moves on when that stage's acceptance passes, and a person stays on the loop. 给 Agent 猛猛套上缰绳，库库干活。

Package names and command names are unchanged for compatibility: `@scottzx/1acp`, `@1agents/acp-service`, `@1agents/dsh-acp`, and the `1acp`, `acpx`, and `acp-service` commands. Role and state files stay under [`.1agents/`](.1agents/README.md).

A PPT script is structure-checked and, under the default policy, waits for a human decision before production starts. The deck then goes through a deterministic machine check. An independent agent reviewer is dispatched after that check passes, and the deck is delivered after that review passes. A report workflow file-checks the Markdown, then finishes when a person approves that exact file. Code checks, a separate agent reviewer and a human decision are the acceptance steps these deliveries use, each tied to its own stage.

Use Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build and other locally discovered ACP Agents inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Continue persistent native sessions, choose the models and settings exposed by each Agent, and handle tool permissions in DSH's approval UI. The same **`@1agents/acp-service`** package also provides a standalone CLI and ACP HTTP/WebSocket service.

- Keep the native Agent's workspace, tools and session identity when reconnecting.
- Select native models, reasoning settings, modes and advertised slash commands from the session UI.
- Optionally continue native history with `@1agents/session-reader`.
- Enable A2A 1.0 task delegation, status queries and completion callbacks when needed. A2A is off by default; waking a caller's main Agent requires its receiving host adapter.

## 快速开始

需要 **Node.js >= 22.13** 和 **pnpm 11**（可用 `corepack enable` 或 `npx pnpm@11`）。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/scottzx/agent-workflow.git && cd agent-workflow
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build && pnpm test
```

整个仓库可一条命令构建和测试；DSH 插件运行时依赖 DeepSeek Harness 内置的包，需在装好 DSH 的环境中使用。`@deepseek-ai/*` 包由 DeepSeek Harness 宿主提供；npm 上有同名的 rc 版本包，请不要从 npm 安装它们。

（未链接 DSH 时，`packages/dsh-plugin` 用 `types/dsh-host.d.ts` 中的宿主类型声明做类型检查；要用真实类型，先运行 `pnpm link:dsh /path/to/DSH`；未链接时，需要真实 DSH 运行时的 8 个插件测试文件和 2 个 “real Cordis” 用例会被跳过并在输出中列出。第三方依赖许可证见 [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES)。）

参与贡献请先阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

## Install in DSH

Requires **Node.js 22.13+**, DSH, and the native Agent CLI with working authentication on the DSH host. Adapter-backed Agents also need their ACP adapter; installing the native Codex CLI alone does not install `codex-acp`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @1agents/acp-service@^0.10.0
```

Restart DSH, confirm **`@1agents/acp-service`** is enabled on the Plugins page, then create a session with an **ACP · Agent** preset and an existing workspace. The plugin starts or reuses its local ACP service automatically. Replace `web` with your profile name; from a DSH source checkout, use `pnpm dsh` in place of `dsh`.

If pnpm reports an ignored `esbuild` build script, follow its prompt or configure that package's approval in the profile, then repeat the install. Approve or deny the individual script according to your policy. Check the Plugins page afterward: a partial install can leave the bundle disabled.

The current npm release is `0.10.2`. For a pinned GitHub Release artifact, install the tarball attached to the latest release on this repository, [acp-service-v0.6.0](https://github.com/scottzx/agent-workflow/releases/tag/acp-service-v0.6.0):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/scottzx/agent-workflow/releases/download/acp-service-v0.6.0/1agents-acp-service-0.6.0.tgz
```

Install `@1agents/session-reader` separately if you want to browse and continue existing Claude, Codex or Grok histories. See the [DSH user guide](packages/dsh-plugin/README.md), [service and A2A guide](packages/service/README.md), and [installation verification](docs/marketplaces/verification-2026-10-09.md).

## Screenshots and compatibility

Choose a locally discovered native Agent:

![DSH ACP Agent preset picker](packages/service/assets/dsh-agent-presets.png)

Open the native Codex model and ACP controls:

![Native Codex model and ACP settings in DSH](packages/service/assets/dsh-codex-controls.png)

These unmodified screenshots come from a fresh isolated profile on a locally modified DSH build labeled `0.2.0-rc.1`; they show discovery and native capability loading, without sending a model prompt. The CI baseline is **DSH 0.1.7-rc.2**, commit [`21638c5`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/21638c56315ae6a2b552d6091945d3144c9af32e). See the verification record for the installed-artifact, profile, Loader, browser and lifecycle checks. Compatibility with other releases requires checking their plugin APIs.

The plugin currently accepts text prompts. Available controls depend on the selected native Agent, adapter and account.

## Standalone CLI

```sh
npm install -g @1agents/acp-service@^0.10.0
acp-service --help
acp-service serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 36812 --no-report
```

The runtime and service can be used outside DSH. Installing the npm package starts no process.

## Source workspace

One published package contains the runtime, CLI, service and DSH plugin. The upstream runtime and DSH plugin remain private source modules in one repository with one pnpm lockfile. The DSH plugin communicates with the service through ACP JSON-RPC, while a managed child process loads the service when a local endpoint needs starting.

Project-owned roles, workspaces and runtime state live under [`.1agents/`](.1agents/README.md). Role definitions and public examples are tracked; local data and credentials are excluded from Git.

### Roles and skills

A resident role is a profile (`ROLE.md` plus the skill names it needs) and a fixed target that runs it in a working directory. The skills sit in that directory, where the agent runtimes already look: `<cwd>/.agents/skills/<name>/` for DSH and Codex, and `<cwd>/.claude/skills` for Claude Code, which the host links to `.agents/skills`. Before the model starts, the host checks that every named skill is present and prefixes the first message with the role text and each skill's `SKILL.md` path. Nothing is downloaded, cached or pinned: a continuation reads the directory as it is, and acceptance checks guard against drift. Copy skills into a role's directory, assets included, with:

```sh
acp-service roles sync --profile .1agents/roles/<role>/profile.json --cwd <workspace> --source <distribution-dir>
```

A fixed target runs on the `standard` preset unless its binding names another. A model is optional: a target may set a default `provider`/`model`, and each task may pass its own for that task only. Change a target's defaults with `execution_target_update`, or keep it and make a copy with different defaults with `execution_target_fork`.

# @1agents/dsh-plugin-todo

管理这台 Mac 上已经和 iPhone 同步的系统「提醒事项」和「日历」。

- DSH 插件提供侧栏里的独立页面，不注册 Agent 工具。
- 同一个 `IosAgenda.app` 以 stdio MCP 登记到本机 dreammate-node，范围是 `local`。
- 页面和 MCP 调用同一套 EventKit 方法。写入后要等 iCloud 同步才会出现在手机上。

## 构建

```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```

`npm run build` 会编译 Swift、打成 `dist/IosAgenda.app` 并签名。授权记在这个 app 上，不要改去调用裸二进制。

第一次读取会弹出「提醒事项」和「日历」的权限。如果没弹出，到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」里允许 `IosAgenda.app`（`work.1agents.ios-agenda`）。

### 为什么必须经过系统启动器

macOS 的隐私授权按「责任进程」判定，而不是看实际读数据的是谁。宿主直接 `spawn` 包内的二进制时，责任进程是整个 DSH，日历权限会被静默判成 `notDetermined`：系统既不弹框，也不会读成功。

所以页面和 MCP 都改成先用 `open -W -a IosAgenda.app --args call-file …` 交给 LaunchServices 起一个自己，这个进程才是自己的责任进程，授权和读取都正常。副作用有两条：

- 需要图形登录会话，没有 `open` 可用的环境（例如纯 ssh）跑不了。
- 每次调用要经 LaunchServices 起一个实例。首次约 3 秒，之后约 150 毫秒。

## 安装

前提：Apple 芯片的 macOS、Node.js 20 或以上、已安装的 DeepSeek Harness。提醒事项和日历只在这台 Mac 上读写。当前发布的原生程序是 arm64，Intel Mac 不能安装。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @1agents/dsh-plugin-todo@0.1.2
```

装完后重启 DSH。左侧栏「历史会话」上方出现「日程」。Host 启动时会把 MCP 登记到 `127.0.0.1:36908`。网关没在跑时，页面仍可用，Agent 搜索不到工具。当前这个对话窗口走的是 desktop profile；要在 `dsh web`（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`）里看到，安装目标是 web profile。

从源码安装时，先完成本地构建，再把仓库目录加进 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/DSH-Plugin-Todo
```

## 给 Agent 用

不要在 DSH 里再注册同名工具。已接入 dreammate-node MCP 的会话用搜索来调用：

```sh
dreammate-node cli search --agent http://127.0.0.1:36908 --query '提醒事项 日历'
```

服务名是 `mcp-ios-agenda`。操作说明在 `skills/ios-agenda/SKILL.md`。

随包发布的 `IosAgenda.app` 使用本机临时签名。换一台 Mac 后，如果系统拦截，到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」里允许 `IosAgenda.app`（`work.1agents.ios-agenda`）访问提醒事项和日历。

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

The Swift application build/signing and native-helper artifact mapping are not verified; no versioned DSH compatibility claim was found. Calendar/reminder permissions and native process execution remain untested. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # DSH Plugin Bulk Update [English](#english) · [Русский](#русский) · [简体中文](#简体中文) · [日本語](#日本語) · [Español](#español) · [Français](#français) · [Deutsch](#deutsch) · [Português](#português) ## English A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin for checking installed registry plugins for updates and applying only the versions you select. It uses DSH's built-in plugin manager; it does not install updates automatically. ### Features - Check installed registry packages for available compatible bundle versions. - Review candidates in one list. Candidates are selected by default; uncheck any you want to skip. - Apply selected updates sequentially through DSH's plugin manager. - Continue with the remaining selections if one update fails; failed items remain in the list. - Localized interface and plugin description for English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, and Portuguese. Other locale variants use their language's translation when available (for example, `zh-CN` uses `zh`); unsupported languages fall back to English. ### Install Install from the DSH CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` If your DSH build offers plugin installation in its UI, you can also add the published package from the plugin manager. ### Use 1. Open **Updates** in the left sidebar. 2. Select **Check** to scan installed packages. 3. Uncheck any candidates you do not want to update. 4. Select **Update selected** and allow the operation to finish. The panel reports how many updates were found, skipped, or could not be checked. Updates run one at a time. DSH may require a restart for some package changes to take effect. ### Scope and limitations - Checks packages for which DSH reports `update: 'registry'`. - Git, local-path, tarball, and official packages are not included in the registry version scan. - Checking and applying updates are separate user actions; nothing is installed automatically. - Availability depends on the configured registry being reachable and on DSH's plugin manager returning compatible bundle versions. - Some package changes may require a DSH restart; this plugin does not restart the application automatically. ### Compatibility Built against the DSH `0.2.2-rc.2` plugin-manager and Client UI APIs. Compatibility with other DSH versions has not been independently verified. ### Development From this package directory: ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ``` --- ## Русский Плагин DeepSeek Harness добавляет в боковую панель проверку установленных registry-плагинов и выборочное применение обновлений. Он использует встроенный менеджер плагинов DSH и не устанавливает обновления автоматически. ### Возможности - Проверяет registry-пакеты на наличие доступных совместимых версий bundle. - Показывает кандидаты в одном списке. По умолчанию они отмечены; снимите отметку с тех, которые обновлять не нужно. - Последовательно применяет выбранные обновления через менеджер плагинов DSH. - При ошибке обновления одного пакета продолжает обработку остальных; неудачные элементы остаются в списке. - Интерфейс и подпись плагина локализованы на английский, упрощённый китайский, японский, испанский, французский, немецкий, русский и португальский. Для неподдерживаемых языков используется английский. ### Установка Установите его из CLI DSH: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` Если в вашей сборке DSH доступна установка через интерфейс, опубликованный пакет также можно добавить через менеджер плагинов. ### Использование 1. Откройте **Обновления** в левой боковой панели. 2. Нажмите **Проверить**, чтобы просканировать установленные пакеты. 3. Снимите отметки с обновлений, которые устанавливать не нужно. 4. Нажмите **Обновить выбранные** и дождитесь завершения операции. Панель показывает, сколько обновлений найдено, пропущено или не удалось проверить. Обновления выполняются по одному. Для применения изменений некоторых пакетов может потребоваться перезапуск DSH. ### Область проверки и ограничения - Проверяются пакеты, для которых DSH сообщает `update: 'registry'`. - Git-пакеты, пакеты из локальных путей, tarball-пакеты и официальные пакеты не входят в registry-проверку версий. - Проверка и применение обновлений — отдельные действия пользователя; автоматической установки нет. - Доступность обновлений зависит от доступности настроенного registry и от совместимых версий bundle, возвращённых менеджером плагинов DSH. - Для применения некоторых изменений может потребоваться перезапуск DSH; плагин не перезапускает приложение автоматически. ### Совместимость Плагин собран с API менеджера плагинов и Client UI DSH `0.2.2-rc.2`. Совместимость с другими версиями DSH отдельно не проверялась. ### Разработка Из каталога пакета выполните: ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ``` --- ## 简体中文 这是一款 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，用于检查已安装的 registry 插件并由用户选择要应用的更新。插件使用 DSH 内置的插件管理器，不会自动安装更新。 ### 功能 - 检查已安装的 registry 软件包是否有可用且兼容的 bundle 版本。 - 在一个列表中查看候选更新。候选项默认勾选；取消勾选即可跳过。 - 通过 DSH 插件管理器逐个应用所选更新。 - 某个更新失败时继续处理其他所选项；失败的项目会保留在列表中。 - 界面和插件简介提供英语、简体中文、日语、西班牙语、法语、德语、俄语和葡萄牙语版本；其他语言回退到英语。 ### 安装 通过 DSH CLI 安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` 如果当前 DSH 版本支持图形界面安装，也可以在插件管理器中添加已发布的软件包。 ### 使用方法 1. 在左侧边栏打开 **更新**。 2. 点击 **检查**，扫描已安装的软件包。 3. 取消勾选不希望更新的项目。 4. 点击 **更新所选项**，并等待操作完成。 面板会显示找到、跳过或检查失败的更新数量。更新按顺序逐个执行。部分软件包变更可能需要重启 DSH 才能生效。 ### 检查范围与限制 - 仅检查 DSH 标记为 `update: 'registry'` 的软件包。 - Git、本地路径、tarball 和官方软件包不在 registry 版本检查范围内。 - 检查与应用更新是两个独立的用户操作，不会自动安装更新。 - 更新信息取决于配置的 registry 是否可访问，以及 DSH 插件管理器能否返回兼容的 bundle 版本。 - 部分更新可能需要重启 DSH；此插件不会自动重启应用。 ### 兼容性 本插件基于 DSH `0.2.2-rc.2` 的插件管理器及 Client UI API 构建。尚未单独验证与其他 DSH 版本的兼容性。 ### 开发 在此软件包目录中运行： ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ``` --- ## 日本語 DeepSeek Harness のサイドバープラグインです。インストール済みの registry プラグインの更新を確認し、ユーザーが選択したバージョンだけを適用します。DSH 標準のプラグインマネージャーを使用し、自動更新は行いません。 ### 機能 - インストール済み registry パッケージの互換性のある bundle バージョンを確認します。 - 候補を一覧で表示します。候補は初期状態で選択されているため、更新しない項目の選択を解除してください。 - 選択した更新を DSH のプラグインマネージャーで順番に適用します。 - いずれかの更新に失敗しても残りの処理を続け、失敗した項目は一覧に残します。 - UI とプラグイン説明は英語、簡体字中国語、日本語、スペイン語、フランス語、ドイツ語、ロシア語、ポルトガル語に対応します。その他の言語では英語を使用します。 ### インストール DSH CLI からインストールしてください。 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` DSH の UI からプラグインをインストールできる場合は、プラグインマネージャーから公開パッケージを追加することもできます。 ### 使い方 1. 左サイドバーで **更新** を開きます。 2. **確認** を選択して、インストール済みパッケージをスキャンします。 3. 更新しない候補のチェックを外します。 4. **選択した項目を更新** を選び、処理が完了するまで待ちます。 パネルには、見つかった更新、スキップされた項目、確認できなかった項目の数が表示されます。更新は1件ずつ実行されます。変更を反映するために DSH の再起動が必要な場合があります。 ### 対象範囲と制限 - DSH が `update: 'registry'` と報告するパッケージを確認します。 - Git、ローカルパス、tarball、公式パッケージは registry バージョン確認の対象外です。 - 確認と更新の適用は別々の操作です。更新は自動インストールされません。 - 更新情報の取得には、設定済み registry への接続と、DSH プラグインマネージャーが返す互換 bundle バージョンが必要です。 - 一部の変更には DSH の再起動が必要です。このプラグインは自動再起動を行いません。 ### 互換性 DSH `0.2.2-rc.2` のプラグインマネージャーおよび Client UI API を基にビルドしています。他の DSH バージョンとの互換性は個別に検証していません。 ### 開発 このパッケージのディレクトリで実行します。 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ``` --- ## Español Plugin de barra lateral para DeepSeek Harness que comprueba las actualizaciones de los plugins de registry instalados y aplica únicamente las versiones que elijas. Utiliza el gestor de plugins integrado de DSH y no instala actualizaciones automáticamente. ### Funciones - Comprueba si los paquetes de registry instalados tienen versiones de bundle compatibles. - Muestra las actualizaciones candidatas en una lista. Se seleccionan de forma predeterminada; desmarca las que quieras omitir. - Aplica las actualizaciones seleccionadas de una en una mediante el gestor de plugins de DSH. - Si falla una actualización, continúa con las demás y mantiene los elementos fallidos en la lista. - La interfaz y la descripción del plugin están disponibles en inglés, chino simplificado, japonés, español, francés, alemán, ruso y portugués. Los idiomas no incluidos usan inglés. ### Instalación Cuando se publique el paquete, instálalo desde la CLI de DSH: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` Si tu versión de DSH permite instalar plugins desde la interfaz, también puedes añadir allí el paquete publicado. ### Uso 1. Abre **Actualizaciones** en la barra lateral izquierda. 2. Selecciona **Comprobar** para analizar los paquetes instalados. 3. Desmarca las actualizaciones que no quieras instalar. 4. Selecciona **Actualizar seleccionados** y espera a que termine la operación. El panel informa cuántas actualizaciones se encontraron, se omitieron o no se pudieron comprobar. Las actualizaciones se ejecutan de una en una. Algunos cambios pueden requerir reiniciar DSH. ### Alcance y limitaciones - Comprueba los paquetes para los que DSH indica `update: 'registry'`. - Los paquetes Git, de rutas locales, tarball y oficiales no se incluyen en la comprobación de versiones de registry. - Comprobar y aplicar actualizaciones son acciones independientes; no se instala nada automáticamente. - La disponibilidad depende de que el registry configurado sea accesible y de que el gestor de plugins de DSH devuelva versiones de bundle compatibles. - Algunos cambios pueden requerir reiniciar DSH; este plugin no reinicia la aplicación automáticamente. ### Compatibilidad Compilado con las API del gestor de plugins y de Client UI de DSH `0.2.2-rc.2`. La compatibilidad con otras versiones de DSH no se ha verificado de forma independiente. ### Desarrollo Desde el directorio de este paquete: ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ``` --- ## Français Plugin de barre latérale pour DeepSeek Harness : il vérifie les mises à jour des plugins registry installés et n'applique que les versions que vous sélectionnez. Il utilise le gestionnaire de plugins intégré à DSH et n'installe rien automatiquement. ### Fonctionnalités - Vérifie si des versions de bundle compatibles sont disponibles pour les packages registry installés. - Affiche les mises à jour candidates dans une liste. Elles sont sélectionnées par défaut ; décochez celles à ignorer. - Applique les mises à jour sélectionnées une par une via le gestionnaire de plugins DSH. - En cas d'échec, poursuit avec les autres éléments et conserve les mises à jour échouées dans la liste. - L'interface et la description du plugin sont disponibles en anglais, chinois simplifié, japonais, espagnol, français, allemand, russe et portugais. Les autres langues utilisent l'anglais. ### Installation Après publication du package, installez-le depuis la CLI DSH : ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` Si votre version de DSH permet l'installation depuis l'interface, vous pouvez aussi y ajouter le package publié. ### Utilisation 1. Ouvrez **Mises à jour** dans la barre latérale gauche. 2. Sélectionnez **Vérifier** pour analyser les packages installés. 3. Décochez les mises à jour que vous ne souhaitez pas installer. 4. Sélectionnez **Mettre à jour la sélection** et attendez la fin de l'opération. Le panneau indique le nombre de mises à jour trouvées, ignorées ou impossibles à vérifier. Les mises à jour sont exécutées une par une. Certaines modifications peuvent nécessiter un redémarrage de DSH. ### Périmètre et limites - Vérifie les packages pour lesquels DSH indique `update: 'registry'`. - Les packages Git, issus de chemins locaux, tarball et officiels ne sont pas inclus dans la vérification des versions registry. - La vérification et l'application des mises à jour sont deux actions distinctes ; aucune mise à jour n'est installée automatiquement. - La disponibilité dépend de l'accessibilité du registry configuré et des versions de bundle compatibles renvoyées par le gestionnaire de plugins DSH. - Certaines modifications peuvent nécessiter un redémarrage de DSH ; ce plugin ne redémarre pas l'application automatiquement. ### Compatibilité Construit avec les API du gestionnaire de plugins et de Client UI de DSH `0.2.2-rc.2`. La compatibilité avec d'autres versions de DSH n'a pas été vérifiée indépendamment. ### Développement Depuis le répertoire du package : ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ``` --- ## Deutsch Ein DeepSeek-Harness-Seitenleisten-Plugin, das installierte Registry-Plugins auf Updates prüft und nur die von dir ausgewählten Versionen anwendet. Es nutzt den integrierten DSH-Pluginmanager und installiert keine Updates automatisch. ### Funktionen - Prüft installierte Registry-Pakete auf verfügbare kompatible Bundle-Versionen. - Zeigt mögliche Updates in einer Liste. Sie sind standardmäßig ausgewählt; hebe die Auswahl für Pakete auf, die du überspringen möchtest. - Wendet ausgewählte Updates nacheinander über den DSH-Pluginmanager an. - Schlägt ein Update fehl, werden die übrigen fortgesetzt; fehlgeschlagene Einträge bleiben in der Liste. - Oberfläche und Pluginbeschreibung sind auf Englisch, vereinfachtem Chinesisch, Japanisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Deutsch, Russisch und Portugiesisch verfügbar. Für andere Sprachen wird Englisch verwendet. ### Installation Nach der Veröffentlichung installierst du das Paket über die DSH-CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` Falls deine DSH-Version die Plugin-Installation über die Oberfläche unterstützt, kannst du das veröffentlichte Paket auch dort im Pluginmanager hinzufügen. ### Verwendung 1. Öffne **Updates** in der linken Seitenleiste. 2. Wähle **Prüfen**, um installierte Pakete zu scannen. 3. Entferne die Auswahl bei Updates, die du nicht installieren möchtest. 4. Wähle **Ausgewählte aktualisieren** und warte, bis der Vorgang abgeschlossen ist. Das Panel zeigt die Anzahl der gefundenen, übersprungenen und nicht prüfbaren Updates an. Aktualisierungen laufen nacheinander. Manche Paketänderungen erfordern möglicherweise einen Neustart von DSH. ### Umfang und Einschränkungen - Geprüft werden Pakete, für die DSH `update: 'registry'` meldet. - Git-, lokale Pfad-, Tarball- und offizielle Pakete sind von der Registry-Versionsprüfung ausgenommen. - Prüfung und Anwendung sind getrennte Nutzeraktionen; Updates werden nicht automatisch installiert. - Die Verfügbarkeit hängt davon ab, ob die konfigurierte Registry erreichbar ist und der DSH-Pluginmanager kompatible Bundle-Versionen zurückliefert. - Manche Änderungen erfordern möglicherweise einen Neustart von DSH; dieses Plugin startet die Anwendung nicht automatisch neu. ### Kompatibilität Erstellt mit den Pluginmanager- und Client-UI-APIs von DSH `0.2.2-rc.2`. Die Kompatibilität mit anderen DSH-Versionen wurde nicht unabhängig überprüft. ### Entwicklung Im Paketverzeichnis ausführen: ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ``` --- ## Português Plugin da barra lateral do DeepSeek Harness para verificar atualizações dos plugins de registry instalados e aplicar somente as versões selecionadas por você. Ele usa o gerenciador de plugins integrado do DSH e não instala atualizações automaticamente. ### Recursos - Verifica se há versões de bundle compatíveis disponíveis para os pacotes de registry instalados. - Exibe as atualizações candidatas em uma lista. Elas vêm selecionadas por padrão; desmarque as que quiser ignorar. - Aplica as atualizações selecionadas uma a uma pelo gerenciador de plugins do DSH. - Se uma atualização falhar, continua com as demais; os itens com falha permanecem na lista. - A interface e a descrição do plugin estão disponíveis em inglês, chinês simplificado, japonês, espanhol, francês, alemão, russo e português. Outros idiomas usam inglês. ### Instalação Depois que o pacote for publicado, instale-o pela CLI do DSH: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulk-update ``` Se a sua versão do DSH permitir instalação pela interface, você também pode adicionar o pacote publicado no gerenciador de plugins. ### Uso 1. Abra **Atualizações** na barra lateral esquerda. 2. Selecione **Verificar** para examinar os pacotes instalados. 3. Desmarque as atualizações que não deseja instalar. 4. Selecione **Atualizar selecionados** e aguarde a conclusão. O painel informa quantas atualizações foram encontradas, ignoradas ou não puderam ser verificadas. As atualizações são executadas uma por vez. Algumas alterações podem exigir a reinicialização do DSH. ### Escopo e limitações - Verifica pacotes para os quais o DSH informa `update: 'registry'`. - Pacotes Git, de caminhos locais, tarball e oficiais não fazem parte da verificação de versões do registry. - Verificar e aplicar atualizações são ações separadas do usuário; nada é instalado automaticamente. - A disponibilidade depende do acesso ao registry configurado e de o gerenciador de plugins do DSH retornar versões de bundle compatíveis. - Algumas alterações podem exigir reiniciar o DSH; este plugin não reinicia o aplicativo automaticamente. ### Compatibilidade Criado com as APIs do gerenciador de plugins e do Client UI do DSH `0.2.2-rc.2`. A compatibilidade com outras versões do DSH não foi verificada de forma independente. ### Desenvolvimento No diretório do pacote, execute: ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run build ```

# dsh-glm-zcode

ZCode-compatible GLM channel for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The bundle runs GLM on its ZCode 3.17.1 training distribution: the native channel with account login and encrypted credentials, client identity headers, Signing V4 request signatures, endpoint routing, an Anthropic Messages transport, coding-plan / start-plan plans, and a prompt and tool surface that mirrors ZCode 3.17.1 (lazy tool loading, todo reminders, compaction). It is a third-party DSH bundle: one package, five independent rows, toggled per row in the plugin manager. Disabling a row degrades the session gracefully, and non-GLM sessions are unaffected.

## Install

Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 (declared as `engines.dsh`; the plugin manager checks it and refuses incompatible versions).

Once published:

```
dsh plugin add dsh-glm-zcode
```

Together with the orchestration bundle (optional, model-agnostic):

```
dsh plugin add dsh-glm-zcode dsh-hourness
```

Until published, install from a checkout:

```
dsh plugin add <checkout>/packages/glm <checkout>/packages/hourness -w
```

The settings section and the GLM pill under the composer are the package's own client face (`ui/`); installing the package is enough. First use: `/glm-login` authorizes in the browser and stores the credential encrypted in the DSH user directory; `/glm-status` reports credential state and per-row health; the model selector then lists the `glm-zcode` route. Desktop DSH loads new code only after a full restart.

## Rows

Declared in `cordis.patch.yml` (DSH Loader dialect). Row ids keep the `glm-hourness/` prefix so profile overrides match by id.

| Row id | What it does | Ships |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `glm-hourness/glm-llm` | the native channel: login credential, identity headers, signing, endpoint routing, transport, coding-plan / start-plan | disabled |
| `glm-hourness/glm-login` | `/glm-login`, `/glm-status`, `/glm-logout` | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/glm-prompt` | prompt and tool-surface mirror, local tool search, todo reminders | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/glm-compact` | compaction mirror | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/glm-ui` | client face: GLM pill and settings section | enabled |

`glm-llm` ships disabled; enable it in the plugin manager once you accept it on your profile.

## License

The repository's own code is licensed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 (licensor NorthGod): noncommercial use is granted, commercial use needs a separate grant (northgod@qq.com). Third-party material this bundle carries — in particular ZCode 3.17.1 prompt text reproduced verbatim and parts ported from TriDefender/zcode-api (CC BY-NC-SA) — is inventoried in the repository's `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` and is not covered by that license. Both files ship inside the package (`LICENSE`, `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`).

## 简体中文

`dsh-glm-zcode` 让 GLM 按 ZCode 3.17.1 的训练分布住进 DeepSeek Harness：原生通道与账号登录（加密凭证）、身份头、Signing V4 请求签名、端点路由、Anthropic Messages 传输、coding-plan / start-plan 双档，以及逐字镜像 ZCode 3.17.1 的提示词与工具面（工具懒加载、todo 提醒、压缩）。五个独立行按 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明，在插件管理器逐行启停，停用任意一行会话优雅降级，非 GLM 会话不受影响。发布后 `dsh plugin add dsh-glm-zcode` 安装（可与 `dsh-hourness` 一起装）；发布前用检出路径安装（见上）。首次使用 `/glm-login` 浏览器授权，`/glm-status` 看凭证与各行健康，模型选择器选 `glm-zcode` 路由。许可：本仓自有代码按 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 授权（`LICENSE`，商用需另行联系 northgod@qq.com）；逐字复现的 ZCode 文本与移植部分的出处见 `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`。

# GLM-Hourness

GLM + House + Harness，两个目标各由一个包实现（`docs/CHARTER.md` §3）。House：GLM 以 ZCode 3.17.1 的训练分布住进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），质量与官方 ZCode 一致，由 GLM 通道包 `dsh-glm-zcode`（`packages/glm`）实现。Harness：任何模型在 DSH 里沿项目图干活，开发体系由 harness 保证实施，由编排层包 `dsh-hourness`（`packages/hourness`）实现。两个包同仓，都是 DSH 第三方 bundle，各自多行，按各自的 `cordis.patch.yml` 独立启停，可以只装其中一个；GLM 方言不影响非 GLM 会话。

## 分层

| 包 | 层 | 行 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-glm-zcode` | 底层 · 通道 | `glm-llm`、`glm-login` | 原生 ZCode 客户端通道：账号登录与加密凭证、身份头、签名 V4、端点路由、Anthropic Messages 传输、coding-plan / start-plan 双档；`/glm-login`、`/glm-status`（凭证状态与各行健康）、`/glm-logout` |
| `dsh-glm-zcode` | 底层 · 方言 | `glm-prompt`、`glm-compact` | 提示词与工具面镜像 ZCode 3.17.1、local 工具检索（LocalToolSearch / DeferredToolCall）、todo 提醒 10/10、压缩镜像 |
| `dsh-hourness` | 编排层 | `data`、`guard`、`memory`、`workflow`、`hourness`、`graph`、`graph-panel` | 数据目录服务、执行边界、记忆与审计流水、决策日志与晨报、用量报告、项目图；`/hourness`、`/hourness-status`（两个包各行的健康） |
| `dsh-glm-zcode`（客户端面） | 呈现 | `glm-ui` | 设置页与会话输入框 pill（默认启用） |
| `dsh-hourness`（客户端面） | 呈现 | `ui` | 右侧栏项目图面板 |

编排层的完整设计（项目图即主 Agent、设计循环、决策卡、规范体系等）见 `docs/ORCHESTRATION.md`，目前大部分处于规划阶段。

## 文档

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/CHARTER.md` | 宪章：目标、三问四答、分层、调校原则、工程美学、度量 |
| `docs/DESIGN.md` | 总体架构与底层设计 |
| `docs/ORCHESTRATION.md` | 编排层设计 |
| `docs/ROADMAP.md` | 实施路线 |
| `docs/FACTS.md` | 外部事实账 |
| `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` | 开发与交付流程 |
| `docs/HANDOFF.md` | 当前状态与已知问题 |

## 门禁

```
npm run build      # tsc（含 adapter 契约检查），产物在 packages/glm/dist/、packages/hourness/dist/
npm run preflight  # 目录表、两包清单与 patch、产物齐全、client 半一包一源
npm test           # preflight + 逐字门禁 + 检查器门禁 + 全部 spec
npm run lint       # ESLint、knip、jscpd 对照基线（只减不增）；lint:update 缩小基线
npm run deps:check # pnpm outdated 与 pnpm audit，标出处理方式（docs/DEVELOPMENT.md §11）
npm run smoke      # 免登录真网探针
npm run smoke:authorized  # 需凭证：coding-plan 端到端请求
```

安装前后均须通过 build、preflight、test；涉及 loader 组合、新包、新行的改动先在临时 profile 用 headless 沙盒验证（`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` §3）。

## 安装

两个包各自的 `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 是 Loader 方言（`insert` 行）；根 `package.json` 只是开发工作区，不是 bundle。先 `npm run build`，再把两个包装进 profile（`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` §3）：

```
dsh plugin --profile <名字> add <本仓库绝对路径>/packages/glm <本仓库绝对路径>/packages/hourness -w
```

只要其中一层就只装那一个包。每个包的界面是它自己的客户端面（`ui/` 下），由它自己的 patch 插行，不用另装；`ui/src/` 只是客户端源码。桌面版自己的 profile `desktop` 只能在桌面版关闭时，经安装目录里的 `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd` 操作（`docs/FACTS.md` §3）。

行配置：`glm-prompt` 的 reportingDepth（汇报细度，原名 persona，旧键照读）/ tier 等在插件管理器中可调（导出了 Schemastery `Config`）；设计行的 `persona` 是主 Agent 的人设，默认为空，只作用于主 Agent；`guard` 对所有路由与模型生效，圈禁根默认取调用方 agent 的会话目录，每个会话的系统提示词末尾列出生效的规则，组合里有 `workspace-changes` 时另以影子模式记录 shell 写入（`docs/ORCHESTRATION.md` §6）；用户级目录与项目目录由 `data` 行提供，`memory`、`workflow`、`hourness` 配了 `home` 时以行配置为准（`docs/DESIGN.md` §2.4）。首次使用在任意会话输入 `/glm-login` 完成浏览器授权，`/glm-status` 确认后在模型选择器中选 `glm-zcode` 路由；`/glm-status` 同时按包列出各行在本会话是否生效及原因，`/hourness-status` 只列这张表，不装 GLM 通道包时也能看（`docs/DESIGN.md` §2.5）。激活期任何行都不抛错。

## 许可

本仓库自己的代码按 PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 授权（全文见 `LICENSE`，授权人 NorthGod）：任何非商业用途都已授予，商业用途需要另行取得授权，联系 northgod@qq.com。

许可只管本仓库自己写的代码。仓库携带或依赖的第三方材料（含源码里逐字复现的 ZCode 3.17.1 提示词文本、依赖的许可清单）见 `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`；参考源与移植来源另见 `docs/FACTS.md` §4。

## Vendored schemastery

`src/shared/schemastery.ts` is vendored from DeepSeek Harness `vendor/schemastery` @ 3.18.5 (MIT, upstream https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, directory `vendor/schemastery/src/index.ts`). The DSH plugin manager only projects native Schemastery `Config` exports into its forms, and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` is not resolvable from an installed profile bundle, so the dialect row ships the schema factory itself. Local divergences from upstream, kept minimal and listed here: (1) the refs-branch `options.list`/`options.dict` assignments are guarded conditionals because the upstream `x = x && f(x)` form fails this repo's `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`; (2) `ValidationError` assigns `this.options` explicitly after `super()` instead of a TypeScript parameter property, which Node strip-type mode cannot execute. Runtime dependency: `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` (peer).

# dsh-hourness

The orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), for any model. It organizes work around a project graph (a project is its graph directory; one main agent per project), enforces execution boundaries (guard), keeps audit journals (dispatched-work decisions, memory, violations), aggregates them into the `/hourness` morning report and usage panel, and adds boards for project rules (with peak modes) and loops (what runs when something happens or the time comes). The design row makes one session the project's main agent via `/wish`. It is a third-party DSH bundle: one package, seventeen independent rows, toggled per row in the plugin manager; disabling a row degrades the session gracefully. Works without `dsh-glm-zcode`.

## Install

Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 or compatible (declared as `engines.dsh ^0.2.2-rc.1`; the plugin manager checks it and refuses incompatible versions).

Once published:

```
dsh plugin add dsh-hourness
```

Together with the GLM channel bundle (optional, GLM only):

```
dsh plugin add dsh-glm-zcode dsh-hourness
```

Until published, install from a checkout:

```
dsh plugin add <checkout>/packages/glm <checkout>/packages/hourness -w
```

The project graph tab of the right sidebar is the package's own client face (`ui/`); installing the package is enough. `/hourness` prints the morning report, `/hourness-status` lists per-row health for both packages, `/rules`, `/loops` and `/wish` drive their rows. Row config (`home`, `projectHome`, `persona`, `dir`) is set per row in the plugin manager. Desktop DSH loads new code only after a full restart.

## Rows

Declared in `cordis.patch.yml` (DSH Loader dialect). Row ids keep the `glm-hourness/` prefix so profile overrides match by id.

| Row id | What it does | Ships |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `glm-hourness/data` | data directory service: the user-level directory and the project `.llm` | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/guard` | execution boundary for tool calls | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/memory` | memory tools and the audit journal | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/lessons` | lessons board: pitfalls and fixes per project, `/lessons` | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/workflow` | decision journal of dispatched work | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/hourness` | `/hourness` morning report and usage panel | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/graph` | project graph tools for agents | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/graph-panel` | the person's run-control commands for the project graph panel (`/graph-run`); the panel itself only reads | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/rules` | rules board with peak modes, `/rules` | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/design` | `/wish` main-agent mode | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/execute` | the execution line: `dispatch_task`, the dispatched chain's execution boundaries, plan and communication tools, the handback review loop, the merge gate and the drive (goals, idle and peak stops) | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/loops` | loops board: entries, events, run lock | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/metrics` | per-project metrics journal under `.llm/metrics/`, the event service the other rows send through, and the `metrics-files-only` file rule | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/env` | environment branch reminder, the checks that run after edits, and the scratch area (`.llm/scratch/`) | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/transcript` | plain-text session export after a GLM compaction, under the project's git-ignored `.llm/transcripts/`, credential-shaped strings redacted | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/bootstrap` | takeover of a project: `/wish` and `/hourness-init` open a takeover that scans the project and walks the main agent to a consented baseline | enabled |
| `glm-hourness/ui` | client face: right sidebar project graph panel | enabled |

The `data` row ships without a project directory; each session resolves its workspace `.llm` (set `projectHome` per row in the plugin manager to override).

## License

The repository's own code is licensed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 (licensor NorthGod): noncommercial use is granted, commercial use needs a separate grant (northgod@qq.com). Third-party material this bundle carries is inventoried in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` and is not covered by that license. Both files ship inside the package (`LICENSE`, `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`).

## 简体中文

`dsh-hourness` 是 DeepSeek Harness 的编排层，对任何模型生效：项目图及其右侧栏面板（一个项目一张图，一个项目一个主 Agent）、执行边界（guard）、审计流水（派遣决策、记忆、违规）、`/hourness` 晨报与用量面板，以及规范板（规则与峰值模式）与循环板（何时做什么）。设计行用 `/wish` 让一个会话成为项目的主 Agent。十七个独立行按 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明，在插件管理器逐行启停，停用任意一行会话优雅降级；不装 `dsh-glm-zcode` 也能用。发布后 `dsh plugin add dsh-hourness` 安装；发布前用检出路径安装（见上）。`data` 行的项目目录默认指向开发检出，装好后按行配置自己的 `projectHome`。许可：本仓自有代码按 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 授权（`LICENSE`，商用需另行联系 northgod@qq.com）；第三方材料见 `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`。

# GLM-Hourness

GLM + House + Harness，两个目标各由一个包实现（`docs/CHARTER.md` §3）。House：GLM 以 ZCode 3.17.1 的训练分布住进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），质量与官方 ZCode 一致，由 GLM 通道包 `dsh-glm-zcode`（`packages/glm`）实现。Harness：任何模型在 DSH 里沿项目图干活，开发体系由 harness 保证实施，由编排层包 `dsh-hourness`（`packages/hourness`）实现。两个包同仓，都是 DSH 第三方 bundle，各自多行，按各自的 `cordis.patch.yml` 独立启停，可以只装其中一个；GLM 方言不影响非 GLM 会话。

## 分层

| 包 | 层 | 行 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-glm-zcode` | 底层 · 通道 | `glm-llm`、`glm-login` | 原生 ZCode 客户端通道：账号登录与加密凭证、身份头、签名 V4、端点路由、Anthropic Messages 传输、coding-plan / start-plan 双档；`/glm-login`、`/glm-status`（凭证状态与各行健康）、`/glm-logout` |
| `dsh-glm-zcode` | 底层 · 方言 | `glm-prompt`、`glm-compact` | 提示词与工具面镜像 ZCode 3.17.1、local 工具检索（LocalToolSearch / DeferredToolCall）、todo 提醒 10/10、压缩镜像 |
| `dsh-hourness` | 编排层 | `data`、`guard`、`memory`、`workflow`、`hourness`、`graph`、`graph-panel` | 数据目录服务、执行边界、记忆与审计流水、决策日志与晨报、用量报告、项目图；`/hourness`、`/hourness-status`（两个包各行的健康） |
| `dsh-glm-zcode`（客户端面） | 呈现 | `glm-ui` | 设置页与会话输入框 pill（默认启用） |
| `dsh-hourness`（客户端面） | 呈现 | `ui` | 右侧栏项目图面板 |

编排层的完整设计（项目图即主 Agent、设计循环、决策卡、规范体系等）见 `docs/ORCHESTRATION.md`，目前大部分处于规划阶段。

## 文档

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/CHARTER.md` | 宪章：目标、三问四答、分层、调校原则、工程美学、度量 |
| `docs/DESIGN.md` | 总体架构与底层设计 |
| `docs/ORCHESTRATION.md` | 编排层设计 |
| `docs/ROADMAP.md` | 实施路线 |
| `docs/FACTS.md` | 外部事实账 |
| `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` | 开发与交付流程 |
| `docs/HANDOFF.md` | 当前状态与已知问题 |

## 门禁

```
npm run build      # tsc（含 adapter 契约检查），产物在 packages/glm/dist/、packages/hourness/dist/
npm run preflight  # 目录表、两包清单与 patch、产物齐全、client 半一包一源
npm test           # preflight + 逐字门禁 + 检查器门禁 + 全部 spec
npm run lint       # ESLint、knip、jscpd 对照基线（只减不增）；lint:update 缩小基线
npm run deps:check # pnpm outdated 与 pnpm audit，标出处理方式（docs/DEVELOPMENT.md §11）
npm run smoke      # 免登录真网探针
npm run smoke:authorized  # 需凭证：coding-plan 端到端请求
```

安装前后均须通过 build、preflight、test；涉及 loader 组合、新包、新行的改动先在临时 profile 用 headless 沙盒验证（`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` §3）。

## 安装

两个包各自的 `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 是 Loader 方言（`insert` 行）；根 `package.json` 只是开发工作区，不是 bundle。先 `npm run build`，再把两个包装进 profile（`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` §3）：

```
dsh plugin --profile <名字> add <本仓库绝对路径>/packages/glm <本仓库绝对路径>/packages/hourness -w
```

只要其中一层就只装那一个包。每个包的界面是它自己的客户端面（`ui/` 下），由它自己的 patch 插行，不用另装；`ui/src/` 只是客户端源码。桌面版自己的 profile `desktop` 只能在桌面版关闭时，经安装目录里的 `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd` 操作（`docs/FACTS.md` §3）。

行配置：`glm-prompt` 的 reportingDepth（汇报细度，原名 persona，旧键照读）/ tier 等在插件管理器中可调（导出了 Schemastery `Config`）；设计行的 `persona` 是主 Agent 的人设，默认为空，只作用于主 Agent；`guard` 对所有路由与模型生效，圈禁根默认取调用方 agent 的会话目录，每个会话的系统提示词末尾列出生效的规则，组合里有 `workspace-changes` 时另以影子模式记录 shell 写入（`docs/ORCHESTRATION.md` §6）；用户级目录与项目目录由 `data` 行提供，`memory`、`workflow`、`hourness` 配了 `home` 时以行配置为准（`docs/DESIGN.md` §2.4）。首次使用在任意会话输入 `/glm-login` 完成浏览器授权，`/glm-status` 确认后在模型选择器中选 `glm-zcode` 路由；`/glm-status` 同时按包列出各行在本会话是否生效及原因，`/hourness-status` 只列这张表，不装 GLM 通道包时也能看（`docs/DESIGN.md` §2.5）。激活期任何行都不抛错。

## 许可

本仓库自己的代码按 PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 授权（全文见 `LICENSE`，授权人 NorthGod）：任何非商业用途都已授予，商业用途需要另行取得授权，联系 northgod@qq.com。

许可只管本仓库自己写的代码。仓库携带或依赖的第三方材料（含源码里逐字复现的 ZCode 3.17.1 提示词文本、依赖的许可清单）见 `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`；参考源与移植来源另见 `docs/FACTS.md` §4。

## Vendored schemastery

`src/shared/schemastery.ts` is vendored from DeepSeek Harness `vendor/schemastery` @ 3.18.5 (MIT, upstream https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, directory `vendor/schemastery/src/index.ts`). The DSH plugin manager only projects native Schemastery `Config` exports into its forms, and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` is not resolvable from an installed profile bundle, so the dialect row ships the schema factory itself. Local divergences from upstream, kept minimal and listed here: (1) the refs-branch `options.list`/`options.dict` assignments are guarded conditionals because the upstream `x = x && f(x)` form fails this repo's `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`; (2) `ValidationError` assigns `this.options` explicitly after `super()` instead of a TypeScript parameter property, which Node strip-type mode cannot execute. Runtime dependency: `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` (peer).

# dsh-tool-switch

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的**会话级工具开关**：点开输入框下方的「工具」按钮，按分组勾选这个会话里模型
**可以**用哪些工具。关掉的工具会从系统提示词的工具清单里消失，模型也调不到（调用得到 `UNKNOWN_TOOL`），
改完下一条消息生效，随时可以再改。

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 本会话可用工具                     328/330  ×  │
│ [ 搜索工具… ]              展开 收起 │ 全开 全关 │
│ ▸ 会话与计划            12/12      [全关] 全开 │
│ ▸ 终端与执行             4/4       [全关] 全开 │
│ ▾ rea · MCP            205/207     [全关] 全开 │
│    ☑ mcp__rea__open_binary                   │
│    ☐ mcp__rea__analyze_function              │
│ 改动从下一条消息开始生效；被关闭的工具模型既看不到也调用不了。│
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 功能

- **按钮**：输入框**正下方那一行**的最右端（`⚙ 工具` 描边胶囊，紧挨 `56%` 上下文档位左边）。
  关过工具后变强调色 + 数字徽章（`工具 3` = 关了 3 个）。
- **默认全收起**：打开面板、切换会话都回到「只列分类头」，点 `▸` 展开；工具栏 `展开/收起` 一次铺开或收拢，
  搜索时命中项自动展开。
- **一键整组**：每个分类右侧 `全关/全开`，一次关掉/恢复整组（`· 会话固定` 的自动跳过，已是目标状态的按钮置灰）。
- **分组**：内置能力按 会话与计划 / 终端与执行 / 文件与检索 / 网络检索 / 子代理与编排 / 文档与演示 /
  图像与音视频 / MCP 资源 / 社交与发布 / 工具链与维护 分类；MCP 工具按服务器（`mcp__<server>__*`）单独成组；
  认不出来的按名字前缀兜底。
- **按会话记忆**：选择存在 `state.json`（按 sessionId 记「关掉了哪些」），重启后仍生效；对话中途随时改。
- 面板 `Esc` 或点面板外关闭；`Esc` 被面板在捕获阶段吃掉，**不会**顺手把正在跑的回合停掉。

## 三个入口，同一份状态

按钮只是壳。下面三条路径写同一份 `state.json`、走同一个重装逻辑：

| 入口 | 谁用 | 依赖 |
|---|---|---|
| `⚙ 工具` 按钮 | 桌面版 / 网页版 | 页面（客户端 bundle） |
| `/tools` 斜杠命令 | 有命令适配器的交互式入口（CLI、网页 composer） | `ctx.commands`；不需要 webServer，也不进模型上下文 |
| `tool_switch` 工具 | **任何入口，含 QQ / headless** | 只需要模型能调工具 |

```text
/tools                       看分组和当前开关
/tools off rea               关掉 rea 整组（也认 终端与执行 / mcp:rea / mcp__rea__* / 精确工具名 / all）
/tools on mcp__rea__         按前缀整片打开
/tools all off | all on      全关 / 全开（动词在前后都认）
/tools reset                 全部恢复
```

用户说「把 XX 类工具关掉」时，模型会调 `tool_switch`（`action: list|off|on|reset` + `target`）。
`tool_switch` 自己**永远不会被关掉**，所以即使 `all off` 也留着一条回来的路。

脚本/外部程序用 HTTP（挂在框架 `webServer` 上，只监听回环；`/api` 那套鉴权不覆盖它）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/tool-switch/state?session=<id>` | 工具目录 + 当前选择（分组、描述、是否可关闭） |
| `POST` | `/tool-switch/state` | body `{ session, disabled: [工具名…] }`，空数组=全部启用 |

## 原理

用的是框架自带的按 agent 遮罩：

```js
// 只有通过 agent 作用域上下文调用，遮罩才只作用于这个 agent
agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow: [...这个会话允许的工具名] })
```

- 遮罩同时作用于「提示词里的工具清单」「PTC 绑定」和「执行时的工具集合」——不是把 UI 藏起来，
  而是模型真的看不到、也调不到。
- 记的是**关闭集合**而不是开启集合：`allow = 可限制工具 − 关闭集合`，所以后来才连上的 MCP 工具默认可用，
  不会被悄悄吞掉。
- 监听 `agent/created` / `agent/disposed` / `tools/change`：新会话、工具集合变化（MCP 晚到、插件热插拔）
  自动重算；只有 allow 真的变了才重装，避免白白让提示词前缀失效。
- 卸载时撤掉自己装的所有遮罩（插件不在，就不该继续改会话能力）。

客户端半侧是手写的 bundle（`lib/client.js`，与官方插件产物同构的
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`），注册进 `conversation.composer.dock` 这个 slot。

## 安装

已在 npm 上：**`dsh-tool-switch@0.2.1`**（[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-switch)）。

**① 插件页装（推荐）**：DSH 左侧栏 **插件 → 安装**，填 `dsh-tool-switch`（或本仓库地址、或本地目录的
绝对路径），确认后刷新页面。它会调用 pnpm，并把包记进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

**② 自己用包管理器装**：

```powershell
cd <PROFILE_DIR>                                   # …\harness\profiles\web
pnpm add dsh-tool-switch                           # 或 github:suqing114/dsh-tool-switch#v0.2.1
                                                   #    file:<本地 tgz>
                                                   #    link:<本地仓库目录>
# 再把 "dsh-tool-switch" 加进本目录 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组
```

`pnpm add` 只负责把包放进 `node_modules`；profile 还得知道这个组合包要参与组合——**两步都要做**
（插件页替你做了第二步）。仓库自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 负责把 Host 入口接进插件树。

**卸载**：插件页里取消选择 / 移除；或 `pnpm remove dsh-tool-switch` 并从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉。
移除后刷新页面，按钮消失，装过的遮罩会一起撤销。

状态文件：`~/.dsh-tool-switch/state.json`，格式
`{ version, sessions: { "<sessionId>": { disabled: [...] } } }`；删掉它等于全部恢复「全开」。

## 装完怎么验

```powershell
# 1) Host 路由活着：200；不带 session 应 400；随便一个路径应 404
curl.exe "http://127.0.0.1:43129/tool-switch/state?session=test"
curl.exe "http://127.0.0.1:43129/tool-switch/state"

# 2) 客户端启动图里有这一行（bundle 也能取到）
node test\probe-client-graph.mjs
```

3. 页面里：输入框正下方那行最右端出现 `⚙ 工具`。看不到就先 Ctrl+R，再查下面常见问题。

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| `/tool-switch/state` 返回 **404** | 插件没被组合进来：确认它在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里且已启用；看 `<HARNESS_DIR>\logs\harness.log` |
| 路由 200 但**没有按钮** | 客户端半侧没加载：Ctrl+R；再跑 `node test\probe-client-graph.mjs` 看启动图 |
| `resolves from multiple active Loader sources` | 同一份插件被两个来源解析到（装了两遍），删掉一处 |
| 改了代码没反应 | 客户端 bundle 按 mtime 热替换；Host 侧 `index.js` 需要重启 DSH 才重新导入 |
| 面板里有灰勾选的 `· 会话固定` | agent 作用域内注册的工具，框架规定 `tools.restrict` 管不到 |
| 想一次性恢复 | 面板点 `全开`，或删掉 `state.json` |

## 自测

```bat
node test\test-host.mjs             :: Host：分组/持久化/restrict 重装/HTTP/命令/工具（12 项）
node test\test-client.mjs           :: 客户端：bundle 协议、slot 注册、默认收起、整组一键、真实 React 渲染（6 项）
node test\verify-config.mjs         :: 组合包声明（bundle patch / locale / icon / 文档）
node test\verify-client-inject.mjs  :: dsh.client.inject 点名的包确实是启动图里的行
node test\probe-route.mjs           :: 打真实实例，看 400 / 200 / 404
node test\probe-client-graph.mjs    :: 启动图里有没有这一行、bundle 能否取到
node test\probe-live.mjs            :: $env:SESSION=… 后看某个会话的目录 / agent 视图
```

路径与端口都由 [test/paths.mjs](test/paths.mjs) 解析，可用 `DSH_APP` / `DSH_HARNESS` / `DSH_URL` / `SESSION` 覆盖。

## 已知边界

- **agent 作用域里注册的工具关不掉**：框架规定「查看作用域自己的注册不受 restrict 影响」，这类工具标
  `· 会话固定` 且勾选框禁用（例如某些 preset 注册的 `ops_discover_tools`）。
- **只有按会话，没有全局默认**：新会话默认全开。
- **面板文案没走 i18n**：中文硬编码在 bundle 里。
- **HTTP 只监听回环、没有额外鉴权**：它只能改「本会话能用哪些工具」，不碰凭证、文件内容和执行权限。

## 发版（维护者）

仓库里 `.github/workflows/publish.yml` 走 npm 的 **Trusted Publishing（OIDC）**，不需要任何 token：

```powershell
# 改 package.json 的 version
git tag v0.2.2; git push --tags      # 自动发布 + provenance
```

前提是在 npmjs 的包设置里配过 trusted publisher（`suqing114` / `dsh-tool-switch` / `publish.yml` /
`npm publish`）。两个已踩过的坑：`npm publish` 会先把版本放进 staged 队列、**一两分钟后**才出现在注册表
（同版本重发会 `E409 Cannot publish over previously staged version`）；bypass-2FA 的令牌**做不了
`npm unpublish`**（403）。
